companies.description:
&us is an independent innovation and transformation consultancy that collaborates with organizations to develop breakthrough products, services, and adaptable teams. The company focuses on modernizing workflows and fostering customer-centric strategies, helping clients become future-ready.

The consultancy specializes in innovation and transformation, product and service development, and team building. It aims to create platforms for growth and encourages organizations to embrace customer-centric approaches. &us is recognized as a Great Place to Work in the UK, reflecting its commitment to a positive workplace culture. Through its services, &us supports clients in navigating future challenges and enhancing their operational capabilities.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
10 Days London, officially known as 10 Days Studio Ltd, is an innovative advertising agency based in London, founded by brothers Jolyon, George, and Dominic White. The agency specializes in delivering comprehensive creative campaigns in just 10 days, significantly reducing the typical timelines of traditional advertising processes. With offices in London, Amsterdam, and New York City, 10 Days was established to address frustrations with lengthy project durations, exemplified by their initial work for the restaurant Peach.

The agency offers a range of bespoke advertising solutions, including full campaigns from brief to final ad, custom-built projects, and flexible services tailored to specific client needs. Their expertise spans strategy, creative development, production, media planning, and music composition. Recent projects highlight their ability to leverage AI in advertising, showcasing their commitment to speed and creativity. Notable clients include Vinterior, Purdy & Figg, and Gett, reflecting the agency's focus on impactful and effective campaigns.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
10x Banking Technology Holdings Limited, based in London, is a fintech company founded in 2016. It offers a cloud-native SaaS core banking platform called SuperCore, designed to help banks launch personalized products and customer experiences efficiently and cost-effectively. The platform serves retail, SME, and corporate banking sectors, supporting over 100 million accounts with high performance and reliability.

The company's mission is to create customer-centric banks using advanced technology, aiming to be the preferred global banking operating system. With offices in London and Sydney, 10x Banking operates in multiple regions, including Australia, the UK, the US, and Africa. It achieved B Corporation certification in November 2023, reflecting its commitment to positive social and environmental impact. The SuperCore platform features modular scalability, compliance with global regulations, and integration capabilities, making it suitable for various banking needs. Notable clients include Chase UK, Westpac, and Old Mutual, along with partnerships with firms like Deloitte and LTI Mindtree.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
11:FS is a London-based fintech consultancy founded in 2016. The company specializes in building and launching digital financial services for a range of clients, including challengers, incumbents, startups, and institutions in the financial services sector. With a team of over 150 experts, 11:FS combines corporate experience with startup agility to drive transformations and create customer-focused digital ventures.

The firm offers comprehensive consulting services that include strategy development, product design, engineering, and digital transformation. Their key offerings encompass ventures and digital transformation, research and insights, media and content, and embedded finance strategies. Notably, 11:FS Pulse is their platform for UX research and financial services trends, providing valuable insights and performance analysis.

11:FS has collaborated with over 100 clients globally, impacting 75 million customers. Their notable projects include work with RBS, Metro Bank, Standard Chartered, and Monzo, among others. The company is recognized for its expertise in areas like Banking-as-a-Service and user experience design, contributing to the success of fintech unicorns such as Monzo and Starling.

companies.description:
1GLOBAL is a global telecommunications company that specializes in eSIM-based connectivity solutions. Founded in 2022 by Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, the company has quickly established itself in the market by acquiring Truphone Ltd.'s assets in early 2023. With a focus on operational profitability, 1GLOBAL has invested in its network infrastructure and now employs over 450 experts across 15 offices in more than 12 countries.

The company offers a range of services, including enterprise solutions for mobile connectivity, IoT connectivity with extensive carrier partnerships, and compliance recording for regulatory needs. 1GLOBAL also provides retail solutions for point-of-sale systems and branded global eSIM services for tech and travel sectors. With a strong presence in over 160 countries and access to more than 600 global networks, 1GLOBAL supports a diverse clientele, including major investment banks and fintech companies, facilitating millions of SIM connections daily.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
1Rebel is a premium fitness company founded in 2015, offering high-intensity, music-driven workouts in 12 luxury clubs across London and in Dubai. The company focuses on creating immersive studio experiences with expert programming and curated playlists. It employs around 330 people and generates approximately $13.3 million in revenue.

The core offerings include four main workout classes: Ride, a low-impact cycling session; Reformer, a Pilates-style workout; Reshape, a strength and conditioning class; and Rumble, a boxing-style session. Additionally, the Reset experience focuses on recovery with sauna and cold plunge options. 1Rebel provides over 100 classes weekly at select locations and features fully equipped open gyms in Dubai.

Membership options are flexible, with no long-term contracts required. New members can choose from various packages, including introductory sessions and multi-month memberships with discounts. The company also hosts themed rides and offers group bookings for events, fostering a vibrant community atmosphere.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
2020 Innovation is a UK-based accountancy support business founded in 1998. The company provides training, technical expertise, and business development services to accounting and tax professionals. It supports over 1,200 member firms with a focus on enhancing practice performance and profitability.

The services offered by 2020 Innovation include CPD training and technical resources, practice development consultancy, and digital marketing solutions such as website design and social media marketing. They also provide specialized services like file reviews and support tools tailored for accounting firms. Additionally, the company organizes community events, forums, and conferences to foster peer learning and member success.

Targeting progressive accountancy and tax professionals, 2020 Innovation operates on a membership model designed for ambitious practices looking to grow their client base and improve operations. The company's mission is to deliver exceptional value through its comprehensive range of services, creating a supportive community for accounting firms to thrive.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
24Haymarket is a private investment network and venture capital firm located in London, UK. Established in 2012, the firm focuses on partnering with exceptional entrepreneurs across various sectors, including healthcare, industrial, consumer, technology, and media. It specializes in growth equity and venture capital investments, primarily targeting small and medium-sized companies in the UK.

The company follows a strict investment thesis, emphasizing early-stage equity investments in businesses that have shown initial commercial traction. 24Haymarket adopts an active investment philosophy, providing not only financial support but also strategic guidance and operational assistance to enhance the growth of its portfolio companies. With a network of experienced investors and operators, 24Haymarket aims to identify and support promising ventures, reflecting its commitment to fostering success in high-growth sectors.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
2X Global is a membership network and field-building organization dedicated to advancing gender lens investing (GLI) and women's economic empowerment. Formed from the merger of GenderSmart and 2X Collaborative, it builds on initiatives like the 2X Challenge, which has mobilized over US$33.6 billion in gender lens investments since its launch in 2018. The organization aims to raise an additional US$20 billion over the next three years, focusing on gender and climate investments.

The mission of 2X Global is to engage investors and capital providers to scale gender-smart investments and deepen impact across various sectors and geographies. Its strategic pillars include building capacity through training and events, advancing standards with the 2X Criteria and Certification, and shifting markets through thought leadership and strategic engagements. The organization offers a range of resources, including reports, toolkits, and a knowledge hub, to support its members and promote gender-equitable investment practices.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
2i Ltd is a UK-based software testing and quality assurance consultancy founded in 2005 and headquartered in Edinburgh, Scotland. The company specializes in de-risking IT implementations and ensuring efficient program delivery for both public and private sector organizations. With a team of 50-249 employees, 2i has established itself as a leading player in the QA and software testing field, recently enhancing its capabilities through the acquisition of nFocus Testing.

The company offers a range of services, including strategic test consultancy, test automation, and non-functional testing, which covers performance, security, and accessibility. 2i also provides AI-powered user acceptance testing and test data generation, ensuring comprehensive coverage and reliability in regulated industries. Their collaborative culture has earned them recognition as a Great Place to Work, and they have received awards for their contributions to the software testing sector. 2i serves a diverse clientele, including major public sector clients and organizations in financial services, retail, healthcare, and energy.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
32Co is a healthcare technology platform based in Harlow, London, that connects general dentists and doctors with specialist clinicians to enhance local care. Founded in 2021, the company leverages AI and real-time expertise to improve access to specialty treatments, addressing the challenges of healthcare accessibility.

The primary offering from 32Co is an expert-led clear aligner system that facilitates collaborative treatment planning between general dentists and orthodontists. This system is supported by AI models and includes intensive training for dentists. Additionally, 32Co provides sleep apnoea and snoring treatment devices through its Aerox Health brand, recognized as a leading alternative to CPAP machines. The platform also integrates AI automation into dental practices, streamlining administrative tasks and enhancing clinical knowledge.

32Co serves healthcare professionals, patients seeking orthodontic care, and dental practices, with over 1,200 clinics benefiting from its services. The company has achieved significant growth, raising £2.2M in seed funding and reporting a revenue of £2.1M, along with high satisfaction ratings from UK dentists.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
360insights is a partner engagement and business optimization company based in Whitby, Ontario, Canada. Founded in 2008, it offers a unified SaaS platform and expert services to help brands manage and engage their channel partner ecosystems across B2B and B2B2C models. The company specializes in channel incentive management, processing over $4.5 billion in incentives and millions of transactions through its platform.

The core offering is the Engage SaaS platform, which supports various partner models and industries worldwide. Key features include incentive program design, payment processing, and data analytics for performance insights. The platform is designed for ease of use, with no-code configuration and global scalability. In addition to the platform, 360insights provides expert services for content creation, training, and strategic guidance tailored to client needs. The company serves sectors such as technology, consumer durables, automotive, and life sciences, focusing on enhancing channel efficiency and partner experiences.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
3P Learning Limited is a global edtech company founded in 2003, specializing in online educational software and e-books for K-12 students. The company is headquartered in Australia and employs around 350-390 people. It operates in over 130 countries, serving more than 5.5 million students and 17,000 schools worldwide.

The company is known for its flagship product, Mathletics, along with other programs like Reading Eggs, Mathseeds, Writing Legends, and Brightpath Progress. These adaptive online programs support blended learning in both schools and homes, emphasizing engaging and research-backed tools. 3P Learning has a strong presence in various regions, including Asia-Pacific, North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and focuses on providing innovative educational solutions to schools, districts, and parents.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
3S Money is a UK-based cross-border payments platform and licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) founded in 2018. It offers multi-currency business accounts and international payment solutions designed for businesses looking to expand globally. The company combines financial technology with private banking standards to provide secure tools for managing payments and currency exchange.

Headquartered in East London Tech City, 3S Money has expanded to six global offices, including locations in Amsterdam, Riga, Dubai, and Hong Kong. It partners with top-tier banks to ensure direct SWIFT and FX connectivity, safeguarding client funds. The platform supports over 65 currencies and facilitates payments to more than 190 countries, with features like batch payments, remote account management, and dedicated relationship managers for personalized support. Pricing plans cater to various business needs, from startups to larger enterprises, focusing on high-volume international transfers.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
4C LABS is a rapidly scaling healthcare, technology and pharmaceutical start-up focused on virtual prescribing, pharmaceutical distribution and clinical development in cannabis based medicinal products for human health. 

The empirical evidence for the efficacy of CBPM's as a therapeutic agent in the treatment of cancer related pain, anxiety, childhood epilepsy, spasticity and sleep disorders is now overwhelming. 

We are committed to advancing scientific research, as well as enabling the regulation, distribution and prescribing of CBPM's in the UK and Channel Islands. 

Our work with leading scientists, specialist physicians and pharmacists is underpinned with disruptive technologies that are driving an approach to treatment that prioritizes patients and evidence over stigma. 

We work closely with Drug Science, the Cannabis Industry Council,  The Home Office, The Medicines and Healthcare and regulatory Authority and the Care Quality Commission to catalyse safe, regulated change in the medical landscape. 

If you are a technologist, physician, scientist, distributor, LP or a patient and are interested in working with us, get in touch for a conversation: info@4clabs.ca
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
6sense is an AI-powered revenue platform based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2013. It supports B2B sales and marketing teams by identifying buyer intent, predicting buying behavior, and automating personalized engagement to enhance revenue growth. The company specializes in Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and sales intelligence, utilizing machine learning to improve account segmentation and provide real-time insights into buyer journeys.

The platform features a suite of products designed for revenue generation, including a core ABM platform that analyzes buyer intent signals, pipeline intelligence for monitoring performance, and sales intelligence that offers extensive B2B profiles and decision-maker data. Additionally, 6sense provides conversational email and AI agents to automate early-stage engagement. The company has achieved significant milestones, including over $200 million in annual recurring revenue and a valuation of $5.2 billion following a successful Series E funding round. 6sense serves prominent clients such as Microsoft, Salesforce, and Adobe, establishing itself as a leader in the sales and marketing technology space.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
7bridges is a London-based SaaS company founded in 2016 that specializes in AI-powered supply chain management software. The company offers a platform designed to provide end-to-end visibility, operational resilience, and data-driven optimization for complex logistics networks. With a focus on integrating diverse data sources, 7bridges enables smarter and more adaptable operations.

The core offering is a SaaS platform featuring a logistics Digital Twin that consolidates supply chain data for complete visibility and real-time performance insights. It includes AI-powered analytics for transport optimization, automating a significant portion of data entry and management tasks. The platform supports various sectors, including med-tech, healthcare, and retail, and has demonstrated the ability to reduce transport costs for customers through strategic simulation and actionable insights. 7bridges has received industry recognition and continues to enhance logistics and transportation optimization following its acquisition by IFS.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
9fin is a London-based platform that leverages AI to provide debt market intelligence. Founded in 2016, it offers a comprehensive suite of data, analytics, and tools tailored for professionals in investment banking, asset management, hedge funds, law firms, and private equity. The platform centralizes information on bonds, loans, and companies, streamlining the analysis of credits and market predictions.

The core features of 9fin's platform include over 300 credit metrics, AI-powered tools for earnings call analysis, and real-time insights across various debt instruments. Users benefit from specialized analytics, including covenant comparisons and ESG data, as well as workflow enhancements that facilitate faster research and decision-making. With a global presence and a focus on efficiency, 9fin supports over 250 major firms in the debt capital markets, including top investment banks and asset managers. The company is recognized as one of the UK's fastest-growing software firms, with significant revenue growth and substantial funding.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
A Squared Engineering Ltd, also known as A-Squared Engineering, is a technical consultancy based in Scotland, specializing in structural engineering, naval architecture, and marine operations. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Perth, the company serves the maritime, offshore energy, renewables, and shipbuilding sectors. With a focus on providing practical solutions for complex engineering challenges, A Squared Engineering aims to be a trusted partner in the evolving landscape of energy transitions.

The company offers a wide range of consultancy services, including structural engineering and analysis, naval architecture, marine equipment design, feasibility studies, lift engineering, and asset integrity assessments. Their expertise supports clients in traditional offshore energy, renewables, and shipbuilding, ensuring they navigate the demands of a changing industry effectively. A Squared Engineering is committed to fostering strong client relationships and delivering engineering solutions that reflect their technical leadership and creative culture.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
A&B Engineering is a UK-based company specializing in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP/M&E) services. Founded in 1950 and headquartered in Liverpool, the company has over 50 years of experience and employs around 200 people. With annual sales of approximately £60 million, A&B Engineering is recognized for its high-quality and reliable service in the Northwest and across the UK.

The company offers comprehensive design, installation, and commissioning of MEP systems, focusing on sustainable technologies. Their mechanical services include air conditioning, heat pumps, building management systems, and renewable energy installations. A&B Engineering also provides expertise in sustainability solutions, addressing carbon management and waste reduction. They serve various sectors, including healthcare, education, hospitality, and public infrastructure, and have a strong track record of delivering complex projects, such as a net carbon office in Salford.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
A&B Smart Materials specializes in smart materials and polymer chemistry, focusing on sustainable design solutions. The company develops bio-based super absorbent polymers (Bio SAPs) as eco-friendly alternatives to synthetic super absorbents.

Their products are used in personal care items to lock away moisture, ensuring dryness and comfort. Additionally, they offer agricultural solutions that enhance soil moisture retention, supporting plant growth in drought-prone areas. A&B Smart Materials positions itself as a sustainable choice against petroleum-based synthetic super absorbent polymers, which are non-biodegradable and can contribute to environmental pollution.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
A24 is an independent entertainment company based in New York City, founded in 2012 by Daniel Katz, David Fenkel, and John Hodges. The company specializes in the production, financing, and distribution of films and television content. A24 began as a film distribution company focused on unique stories often overlooked by major studios, quickly establishing itself as a significant player in the indie film scene.

The company has produced and distributed a range of critically acclaimed films, including *Moonlight*, which won three Oscars, and *Everything Everywhere All at Once*, which received six Oscars in 2023. A24 is known for its distinctive marketing strategies, emphasizing social media and viral content. In addition to films, A24 has a television division that has produced series like *Euphoria* and *Playing House*. The company is recognized for its commitment to inclusive storytelling and has garnered numerous awards and nominations for its work.

AB Tasty is a Paris-based software company founded in 2009 by Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert. Initially a web analytics and conversion rate consulting agency, it has evolved into a global SaaS platform focused on website optimization, personalization, A/B testing, and enhancing user experiences. The company has expanded internationally, with offices in major cities including New York City, San Francisco, and Singapore.

AB Tasty offers a comprehensive platform that enables brands to optimize their digital experiences. Key features include A/B testing and experimentation, personalized website customization, and user engagement tools. The platform also provides analytics for customer journeys and unique emotions-based segmentation. With a strong emphasis on improving user experience across various devices, AB Tasty serves a diverse range of clients, including well-known brands in luxury, retail, and entertainment. The company has experienced significant growth, generating $73.1 million in annual revenue and employing around 336-338 people globally.

ABM is a leading provider of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions, employing over 100,000 team members worldwide and generating more than $8 billion in annual revenue. Founded in 1909, the company has evolved from a small window cleaning business into a multinational organization. In the UK and Ireland, ABM operates with over 2,600 team members across more than 1,600 sites, offering customized facilities solutions across various sectors.

ABM provides a wide range of services, including facility management, technical solutions, cleanroom services, energy management, and integrated workforce programs. The company serves diverse industries such as healthcare, manufacturing, life sciences, and transportation. ABM is committed to a people-centered culture, focusing on workforce equity and inclusion, and aims to make a positive impact every day through its dedicated team. Recent strategic acquisitions have further enhanced its capabilities, particularly in the semiconductor sector.

companies.description:
ADEC Innovations is a global business solutions organization founded in 1996 and based in Irvine, California. With operations in over 20 countries, the company focuses on providing Global Business Services and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) solutions. ADEC Innovations aims to transform environmental and social risks into positive impacts and sustainable value through a collaborative approach.

The company offers comprehensive services across three main areas: Environmental Risk & Compliance, Sustainability & ESG, and Business Process & Impact Sourcing. Their solutions include environmental data management, ESG consultancy, supply chain monitoring technology, and business process outsourcing. ADEC Innovations employs over 5,000 associates and utilizes advanced tools and data analytics to enhance operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. Their subsidiaries, such as ADEC USA and FirstCarbon Solutions, further strengthen their integrated service offerings. ADEC Innovations serves a diverse clientele, including governments, enterprises, and local agencies, addressing challenges in sustainability and operational effectiveness.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: ADVANCE®AI is a global leader in AI and big data, specializing in digital identity verification, fraud prevention, compliance, risk management, and credit information services. Based in Singapore and part of the Advance Intelligence Group, the company serves over 800 enterprise clients across various sectors, including banking, fintech, retail, and e-commerce, in markets such as Asia, Africa, Latin America, and Greater China.The company offers a range of AI-powered products designed to facilitate digital transformation and automate processes. Their key services include contactless and biometric identity verification with high accuracy, advanced fraud detection technologies, compliance tools for KYC and AML, and credit information services to aid financial decision-making. ADVANCE®AI handles over 4 million API calls daily and is committed to values such as customer-centricity, data innovation, and collaboration.

AFS Group is a UK-based company founded in 2016, specializing in support services for the logistics industry. The company has evolved from a delivery service into a comprehensive provider that addresses various logistics challenges through innovative solutions. AFS Group is led by experienced professionals with a strong background in logistics and technology.

The company operates a courier service with 280 drivers, focusing on quality delivery and driver experience. AFS Group offers a range of services, including delivery, state-of-the-art vehicle repair, vehicle leasing partnerships, and unique software for managing drivers, fleet operations, scheduling, payroll, and compliance. Their mission is to provide adaptable services that meet the evolving needs of the logistics industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
AI Forge is a 12-week incubator designed for early-stage AI startups. It offers a hybrid program that combines online and in-person training to help founders develop their ideas into market-ready companies. The incubator focuses on AI-driven solutions that address real-world challenges, emphasizing rapid prototyping, validation, and go-to-market strategies.

Participants benefit from a structured curriculum that includes workshops, mentoring, and hands-on support. The program covers essential topics such as company setup, market insights, product development, and fundraising. AI Forge also provides access to a network of over 110 mentors and offers substantial operational support, including development and design assistance. With a strong track record, AI Forge has helped create 46 startups and facilitated significant founder exits, showcasing its commitment to nurturing the next generation of AI leaders.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.companies_house_name: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
companies.description:
The AI Security Institute (AISI) is a UK government research organization under the Department for Science, Innovation, and Technology (DSIT). It was rebranded in February 2025 to focus on addressing national security risks associated with advanced AI systems. AISI operates like a "startup in the government," combining governmental authority with the agility of the private sector to tackle emerging AI threats.

AISI's mission is to minimize risks posed by AI, particularly in areas such as cyberattacks, fraud, and biological weapon development. The institute conducts risk assessments of AI systems, engages in research and development to investigate AI misuse, and provides policy guidance to shape AI governance strategies. It has developed the Inspect framework, an open-source tool for testing AI systems, to foster collaboration in research. AISI primarily serves UK policymakers and international partners, working with organizations like Anthropic to balance economic growth with security measures.
companies.policy: The organisation will only sponsor "super senior" roles.

companies.description:
AJ Bell is a prominent UK-based investment platform provider, established in 1995 and listed on the FTSE 250 as AJ Bell PLC. Headquartered in Salford Quays, Manchester, with additional offices in London and Bristol, the company serves both advised and direct-to-consumer markets. AJ Bell focuses on providing accessible, low-cost investing solutions and manages investments for over 644,000 customers, all while being regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

The company offers a wide range of investment accounts, including ISAs, pensions, and dealing accounts, along with cash savings options. AJ Bell provides various investment choices, such as bonds, stocks, and low-cost funds managed by in-house experts. For financial advisers, AJ Bell features the Investcentre platform, known for its user-friendly functionality and competitive pricing, as well as the Touch by AJ Bell digital platform for streamlined investment management. AJ Bell is committed to making investing straightforward and accessible for all types of investors.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
ALL.SPACE, formerly known as Isotropic Systems, is a UK-based satellite communications company founded in 2013. The company specializes in advanced multi-orbit, multi-network terminals and software-defined platforms, providing resilient connectivity for defense, government, and critical missions. Headquartered in Reading, Berkshire, ALL.SPACE employs between 201 and 500 people and has raised $141 million in funding.

The company develops innovative multi-link terminals that enable seamless connections to all satellites, networks, and orbits. Their technology supports commercial and government space assets, focusing on applications such as comms-on-the-move for land, sea, and air. Key offerings include the Hydra Terminal Range, designed for versatile deployment in harsh conditions, and the Smart Terminal Platform, which integrates satellite and cellular networks for enhanced mobility. ALL.SPACE serves sectors like defense, aerospace, and telecom, partnering with organizations such as the UK Ministry of Defence and the US Department of Defense.
companies.policy: The company is not currently offering visa sponsorship.

companies.description:
AND Digital is a digital consulting and product development company founded in 2014. The company focuses on helping organizations enhance their digital capabilities and address the global digital skills gap. Their mission is to empower businesses to innovate and compete by developing the necessary digital expertise.

AND Digital collaborates with clients by integrating their own experts with in-house teams to create digital products and solutions. They offer services such as defining digital strategies, building stronger digital products, accelerating product development, and transferring digital skills to client teams. Their client base includes a variety of organizations, from startups to global companies, particularly in the financial, retail, and travel sectors.

Headquartered in London, AND Digital expanded its operations to Amsterdam in June 2021 to meet the growing demand for local IT and digital talent in the Netherlands.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
ANS Group Limited is a technology company based in Manchester, founded in 1996. The company specializes in cloud computing, security, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, business applications, and the Internet of Things. ANS aims to help organizations achieve their digital goals by providing practical IT solutions tailored to both public and commercial sectors.

With a team of over 750 technology specialists, ANS emphasizes a collaborative culture and invests in employee development, including an apprentice academy and mental health support programs. The company has received recognition as a "Good Company to Work For" and was named Microsoft's UK Services Partner of the Year. ANS is also committed to social responsibility, actively fundraising and supporting community initiatives.

AOC Formulations is a chemical manufacturing company based in Collierville, Tennessee. The company specializes in resins and polymer solutions that enhance product performance and optimize production processes across various industries. With a reported revenue of $675.6 million and around 706 employees, AOC Formulations is committed to partnering with customers to develop innovative products that are lighter, stronger, and more versatile.

The company operates global R&D centers equipped with advanced technology, where industry specialists work on continuous innovation to improve competitiveness. AOC Formulations produces high-quality chemical products, primarily focusing on resins for polymer applications. Their services include a comprehensive approach to new product development, helping customers increase performance and create new applications.

companies.description:
APEXX Global is a London-based fintech company founded in 2016, specializing in a payment orchestration platform for enterprise merchants in the global eCommerce sector. The platform simplifies payment processing through a single API integration, allowing businesses to optimize their payment ecosystems for cost reduction and efficiency.

Headquartered in Shoreditch, London, APEXX Global employs around 45-87 people and has reported significant financial growth, including total assets of £8.22M and revenue of approximately $44.9M. The company has raised $41M in funding, with a focus on expanding into the US market. APEXX Global's platform features dynamic routing, analytics, tokenization for secure payments, and access to various alternative payment methods. The company has established partnerships with notable organizations, including J.P. Morgan Payments Partner Network and Golfbreaks, to enhance payment solutions for their clients.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
AQA (Assessment and Qualifications Alliance) is the UK's largest exam board and a non-profit education charity. It sets and marks over half of all GCSEs and A-levels taken by more than 1 million students across 92% of UK schools. Established in 1998, AQA operates from Manchester and focuses on general secondary education, technical and vocational education, and other educational services.

With a history spanning over 120 years, AQA has evolved from earlier examination bodies to provide a range of qualifications, including GCSEs, AS and A-levels, Extended Project Qualifications, and Technical Awards. The organization also offers resources such as past paper questions, differentiated tests, and online teacher support through its community platform, Teachit. AQA is committed to advancing education by reinvesting its income into educational activities and support for disadvantaged youth.

In addition to assessment services, AQA leads in educational research and policy, providing expertise to inform curriculum development. The organization supports teachers through qualification development and custom assessments, ensuring that educational resources meet the needs of students and educators alike.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
ARC Marine is an eco-engineering company dedicated to enhancing marine biodiversity through innovative, nature-inclusive solutions. Based in Devon and Cornwall, UK, the company was established in 2015 and has gained recognition for its science-led approach to reef creation and marine infrastructure. ARC Marine's mission focuses on restoring and protecting ocean biodiversity by providing sustainable solutions for offshore and coastal developments.

The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including the design, manufacture, and installation of nature-based solutions. They assist with obtaining necessary permits and licenses, ensuring compliance with regulations, and managing stakeholder relationships. ARC Marine's product lineup features Reef Cubes, Reef Mats, and Reef Walls, all designed to protect marine infrastructure while promoting ecological health. Their Marine Matts are a notable innovation, replacing traditional concrete mattresses with a carbon-negative, plastic-free alternative that supports marine life.

ARC Marine holds several industry accreditations, including B-Corp certification and ISO standards for quality and environmental management. The company is committed to advancing the UN Sustainable Development Goals and has received investment from Mercuria to further its mission of increasing marine biodiversity globally.

companies.description:

Their investment philosophy combines a bottom-up approach, focusing on individual stock movements, with top-down risk management to navigate market corrections. ARR emphasizes avoiding capital loss during severe downturns and seeks opportunities with asymmetric risk-reward potential, maintaining low or negative correlation to global equity indices.

ARR has developed a proprietary portfolio and risk management system called PARIS, which enhances analytical insights through a structured process. The firm has received recognition for its investment excellence, winning the "With Intelligence HFM European Performance Awards 2024" in the Global Equity Under $500m category. companies.description:
Ab-Anbar is a contemporary art gallery that engages with the non-linear intersections of histories of Art and History. Often diasporic, Ab-Anbar represents artists from multiple latitudes and identities, who traverse the aesthetic and political, as well as social and psychological borders.
 
Ab-Anbar initially opened in 2014 in Tehran, Iran. The gallery is a conceptual representation of its name which means a water reservoir in Farsi. The word is made of two parts: 'ab' meaning water and 'anbar' meaning a reservoir. Thus, Ab-Anbar as a gallery is the architectural expression of a physical space that shapes malleable content, nurturing life and growth. The space, through its solidity and form, brings to sight the fluidity of art.
 
Since its inception, the gallery has presented exhibitions as well as hosted and collaborated with a variety of cultural tenants, not-for-profits, independent publishers, musicians, and performers, fashioning a year-long programme of wide-reaching cultural engagement. 
 
2020 marked the beginning of Ab-Anbar's program in London, UK. With its new permanent and sole space, open in September 2023 in London's historical Fitzrovia, the gallery intends to expand the dialogue between artists, collectors, museums and curators towards an inclusion and understanding of marginalised realities.

Advanced Electric Machines (AEM) is a company focused on electric motor technology, specializing in the design and manufacture of magnet-free electric powertrain systems. Founded in 2017 and based in the North East of England, AEM emerged from Newcastle University's electric motor research team. The company aims to provide sustainable and high-performing powertrain solutions for electric vehicles, reducing reliance on rare earth materials and copper.

AEM develops innovative electric motor technologies suitable for various applications, including passenger cars, commercial vehicles, off-highway machinery, industrial systems, and rail infrastructure. Their products are designed to enhance performance, range, and efficiency while being highly recyclable. AEM collaborates with leading vehicle manufacturers and industrial partners globally, contributing to green mobility initiatives. In 2023, the company completed a Series A investment round and launched new branding, marking significant growth in their mission to disrupt the electric vehicle industry with sustainable solutions.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
The Advanced Propulsion Centre UK (APC) is a non-profit organization established in 2013 through a partnership between the UK government and the automotive industry. Based at the University of Warwick in Coventry, APC aims to accelerate the development and commercialization of low-carbon and net-zero emission propulsion technologies for vehicles. It manages a £1 billion investment fund, with equal contributions from the government and the automotive sector, to support innovative projects over a ten-year period.

APC focuses on collaborative research and development projects that industrialize low-carbon automotive technologies. It offers bi-annual funding competitions, providing grants for projects in areas such as electric machines, energy storage, and lightweight structures. The organization has committed over £880 million to more than 50 projects, creating and safeguarding thousands of jobs while significantly reducing carbon emissions. APC also provides strategic insights and support for the automotive industry, helping to drive the transition to net-zero road transport and enhance the UK’s position as a leader in sustainable automotive innovation.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Adyen is a global financial technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, founded in 2006 by Pieter van der Does and Arnout Schuijff. The company specializes in a unified end-to-end payment platform that simplifies global transactions and enhances data insights for modern commerce. Adyen's mission is to address inefficiencies in fragmented payment systems, providing a scalable solution for enterprises.

The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including online, in-app, and point-of-sale processing. Key features include a payment gateway that supports numerous payment methods, integrated risk management tools, and unified analytics for data insights. Adyen also provides services for marketplaces through Adyen for Platforms and offers virtual card issuing with Adyen Issuing. With over 4,000 employees across 28 offices, Adyen processes significant transaction volumes and serves major global clients such as Uber, eBay, Netflix, and McDonald’s.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Adzuna is a global online job search engine and advertising platform founded in 2011 and based in London, England. The company aggregates job listings from various sources, helping job seekers find opportunities in 16 countries, including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, France, Germany, and India. Adzuna attracts tens of millions of monthly visitors by utilizing advanced technology and data aggregation to enhance the job search experience.

The core product is a job search engine that compiles vacancies from large job boards, specialized portals, and employer websites. Key features include the 'ValueMyCV' tool for CV valuation, an AI-powered interview preparation tool called "Prepper," and "ApplyIQ," an AI job search agent. Adzuna also supports job advertising for employers and provides market insights through its data services. The company has established partnerships with UK government bodies, supplying real-time job market data to various entities, including the Department for Work and Pensions and the Office for National Statistics.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Aer Compliance is a SaaS-based employee trade compliance platform focused on digital assets and cryptocurrency trading compliance. Founded in 2021 and based in New York, the company was acquired by StarCompliance in November 2024. Aer is recognized as the first solution specifically designed for employee trade compliance in the digital asset space, catering to some of the largest funds and market makers worldwide.

The platform offers a range of capabilities, including automated pre-trade clearance and post-trade monitoring, with alerts tailored to company policies. It integrates with over 1,000 exchanges, wallets, and brokers, providing global coverage across multiple regions. Aer's features include real-time risk detection, streamlined compliance workflows, and automated reporting, all aimed at enhancing efficiency and reducing manual processes. The company serves financial institutions and investment firms that require effective management of employee trading compliance for both traditional securities and digital assets.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Aermont Capital is a European asset management group based in London, specializing in real estate and related investments. Founded in 2003, the firm focuses on large, complex real estate projects across Europe, aiming for long-term value through proactive asset management. Aermont has raised five pan-European investment funds and manages assets with a reported value of approximately $2.8 billion.

The company employs an operator-oriented strategy, targeting sectors such as retail, residential, and hospitality in key European cities. Aermont's services include direct real estate acquisitions, active asset management through redevelopment and operational improvements, and advisory services for institutional investors. The firm primarily serves institutional clients, including pension funds and insurance companies, and often collaborates with local operators and developers to enhance asset performance.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
AeroCloud Systems Ltd. is a cloud-native airport management software company based in London, UK, founded in 2012. The company aims to be the leading provider of operational automation software for small to medium-sized airports worldwide. Since entering the U.S. market in 2017, AeroCloud has expanded its reach to over 70 airports, supporting more than 350 million passengers each year.

AeroCloud offers an intelligent airport management platform designed for airports of all sizes. Key features include operational automation, passenger prediction using machine learning, gate management, and common-use passenger processing systems. The platform is fully cloud-native, allowing access from any device, and incorporates advanced AI and machine learning capabilities. AeroCloud also focuses on sustainability, partnering with Carbon Neutral Britain to measure and offset its carbon footprint. Notable customers include London Luton Airport, Minneapolis St Paul International Airport, and Tampa International Airport.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Aerogel Core Ltd is a UK-based manufacturer specializing in ultra-lightweight, graphene-based aerogel materials. Founded in 2022 as a spin-out from the University of Bath, the company focuses on creating next-generation structures for aerospace, automotive, and marine applications. It combines expertise in material science with innovative research to develop products that enhance performance while reducing environmental impact.

The company designs and manufactures a range of graphene-based structures, including foils, aerogels, prepregs, and metamaterial-based products. These materials are engineered for applications such as acoustic management, thermal management, and weight reduction, offering significant advantages like reduced density and lower carbon emissions. Aerogel Core Ltd aims to automate its manufacturing processes to scale production and meet the growing demands of its target markets, particularly in aerospace and automotive sectors.

companies.description:
Aethos is a rapidly growing lifestyle hospitality brand in Europe, known for its boutique hotels, members' clubs, and wellness-focused properties. With locations in Milan, Ericeira, Monterosa, and Mallorca, Aethos emphasizes nature, community, creativity, and belonging. The brand creates a network for modern living, offering luxury accommodations that blend social, wellness, and work experiences.

Aethos properties feature unique designs in natural settings, equipped with amenities such as spas, gyms, pools, and co-working spaces. Guests can enjoy eclectic rooms with private balconies and Mediterranean-inspired dining options. Key offerings include wellness services like spa treatments and fitness classes, diverse dining experiences, and tiered memberships for the members' club that promote community engagement. Aethos also provides adaptable event spaces for various occasions, enhancing the overall guest experience.

companies.description:
Affinia is a dynamic accountancy, tax, and business advisory firm based in the UK, recognized as a Top 50 accountancy group. With over 400 employees and 10 offices across the East and South East of England, Affinia serves more than 7,000 clients. The firm was established through the integration of several founding firms and has expanded through strategic acquisitions, bringing together over 300 years of industry experience.

Founded as a unified entity in February 2023, Affinia focuses on a client-centered approach, emphasizing relationships with clients, colleagues, and the community. The firm offers a range of integrated services, including accountancy, audit, tax planning, payroll, business advisory, and corporate finance. Affinia is committed to investing in technology and data to enhance client experiences and aims to double its workforce and turnover within five years. Its core values include respect, integrity, and teamwork, reflecting its dedication to providing high-quality, personalized service to SMEs and regional businesses.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
AgDevCo is a UK-based social impact investor and project developer established in 2008, focusing on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the African agriculture sector, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. The organization aims to create jobs and income opportunities for farmers by providing financial support and advisory services. As a not-for-profit entity backed by the UK government, AgDevCo reinvests all returns into new projects.

The company offers a range of financial instruments, including debt and equity, to agribusinesses involved in primary production, crop processing, and agricultural input supply chains. With over 50 investments across ten countries, AgDevCo targets SMEs in farming, agriprocessing, and logistics. Its impact goals include reaching 550,000 smallholder farmers by 2027 and creating or sustaining 17,800 jobs. AgDevCo emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices, providing guidance to its investees to enhance compliance and local value addition.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Agilisys is a UK-based IT services and consulting company founded in 1998, specializing in digital transformation for the public sector, particularly in healthcare, local government, and social care. Headquartered in London, Agilisys employs over 1,000 specialists and is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a prominent digital venture builder in the UK.

The company focuses on delivering data-driven solutions, Generative AI products, advanced analytics, automation, and cloud IT services. Agilisys aims to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve citizen services. Its offerings include purpose-built software for local government needs, such as AI-powered tools for Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCP) and Adult Social Care (ASC). Agilisys partners with over 120 public sector organizations, including local authorities and NHS trusts, to support their digital transformation efforts.
companies.policy: The company is not currently offering visa sponsorship.

companies.description:
Agio Ratings is a London-based rating agency founded in 2022 that specializes in quantitative risk assessment for digital assets. The company focuses on exchanges, custodians, and lenders, utilizing advanced models to quantify default risk and analyze on-chain and off-chain signals. Agio Ratings provides data-driven insights that have successfully predicted significant market events, such as the high default risk of FTX prior to its bankruptcy.

The company offers a comprehensive platform for institutions to assess and monitor financial risks in digital assets, covering over 70 exchanges and custodians. Key features include near real-time tracking of risk signals, modeling of default probabilities, and customizable risk assessment parameters. Agio Ratings serves a diverse clientele, including trading firms, insurers, funds, and banks, providing them with essential credit insights and risk alerts to optimize their risk management strategies.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Agreena is a climate solutions company based in Copenhagen, Denmark, focused on promoting regenerative agriculture across Europe. Founded in 2018, it operates the continent's largest soil carbon program, helping farmers transition to sustainable practices while generating verified carbon credits. The company employs 320 people and works with over 2,300 farmers managing around 4.5 million hectares of arable land in 20 European countries.

Agreena offers a range of solutions, including AgreenaCarbon, which produces Verra-verified carbon credits, and AgreenaGro, a digital platform that provides farmers with insights and community support. The company also provides sustainability advisory services and digital agriculture tools to enhance farm management and sustainability tracking. Agreena partners with various organizations, including the Louis Dreyfus Company and Mars, to support regenerative agriculture initiatives and help businesses meet their sustainability goals.

companies.description:
Ahren Innovation Capital is a London-based venture capital firm founded in 2017. The firm focuses on investing in transformational companies at the intersection of deep technology and deep science. Ahren partners with founders from pre-seed to pre-IPO stages, aiming to create or penetrate large markets. With over $400 million in available capital, Ahren has made 21 investments across various sectors, including AI, Health Tech, Fintech, and Blockchain.

The firm targets four core domains: Brain & AI, Genetics & Platform Technologies, Space & Robotics, and Efficient Energy. Ahren takes an operator-led, data-informed approach, providing not just capital but also strategic guidance and operational support to its portfolio companies. The team emphasizes scientific rigor and interdisciplinary expertise, helping ventures that aim to redefine sectors and benefit humanity.

companies.description:
AiSolve Limited is a UK-based company founded in 2007, specializing in virtual film production and real-time visual effects (VFX). The company operates in the entertainment, gaming, and media sectors, focusing on motion picture production and post-production activities, as well as interactive leisure and entertainment software development.

With a team of approximately 17 employees, AiSolve has raised investment from The FSE Group to support its operations. The company is known for its expertise in virtual content creation and has established itself as a leading studio in the UK for these services. Its registered office is located in Brighton, UK.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Air Aware Labs is a London-based technology startup founded in 2024. The company focuses on providing personalized air quality insights using artificial intelligence and real-time data. Their mission is to make clean air accessible and to enhance public awareness of air pollution's health impacts.

The flagship product, AirTrack, launched in April 2025, offers real-time air pollution modeling and personalized exposure data based on user location and activity. It features route optimization to identify high-exposure areas and integrates with fitness platforms like Strava and Apple Health. Additionally, AirTrack Enterprise provides organizations with insights into employee air pollution exposure as part of wellness programs.

Air Aware Labs has quickly gained traction, reaching 1,000 users within its first year without advertising. The company collaborates with notable partners, including Google for Startups and the World Economic Forum's Clean Breath Alliance, to further its mission of improving air quality awareness and health outcomes.

companies.description:
Airbnb, Inc. is an American online marketplace founded in 2007, with its official launch in 2008. The company connects hosts and guests for short- and long-term accommodations worldwide, charging commissions on bookings. Headquartered in San Francisco, Airbnb started with the founders renting air mattresses in their apartment and has since evolved to offer a wide range of unique stays, including entire homes, luxury properties, and non-traditional options.

Airbnb's platform features over 5 million hosts and listings in 81,000 cities across 191 countries. In addition to accommodations, the company offers local experiences for guests to book activities and tours. Airbnb has developed a custom payments platform, introduced an app for seamless mobile bookings, and provides a host guarantee for added security. The company has seen significant growth, reaching over 2 billion guest arrivals and achieving a valuation near $80 billion by 2025.

companies.description:
Aircall is a cloud-based phone system company founded in 2014 in Paris. It was created to simplify corporate telephony by providing a reliable and scalable VoIP solution. Initially starting as a call-forwarding service for small businesses, Aircall has evolved into a comprehensive platform that delivers high-quality calls and integrates seamlessly with various business tools.

With a global presence, Aircall operates in multiple locations, including Paris, New York, Sydney, Madrid, London, Berlin, and San Francisco. The company has grown significantly, now employing around 600 team members and serving over 20,000 customers in more than 110 countries. Aircall has secured a total of $226 million in venture funding and emphasizes a culture of continuous learning and customer motivation. Its platform is designed to support remote and distributed teams, ensuring consistent service quality and performance.

companies.description:
Airfinity Ltd is a UK-based company founded in 2015 that specializes in disease forecasting and predictive health intelligence. The company focuses on real-time tracking, simulation, and prediction of population-level disease outcomes to support decision-making in the life sciences sector. Airfinity gained recognition for launching the world's first dedicated COVID-19 data platform, which has been widely cited in global media and praised for its pandemic modeling capabilities.

The company offers a range of data analytics and predictive tools, including real-time disease tracking for various infectious diseases, biorisk surveillance solutions, and scenario planning tools that utilize quantitative analytics and machine learning. Airfinity's platforms integrate data from multiple sources, including partnerships with hospitals and research institutions, to provide rapid insights that aid in resource allocation and investment decisions. With around 120 employees and an annual revenue of approximately $25.2 million, Airfinity serves clients across multiple countries, including high-profile entities like the White House Office of Pandemic Preparedness and Response Policy.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Airship is a B2B SaaS customer experience and marketing platform founded in 2009, headquartered in San Francisco. The company specializes in AI-powered automation, personalized messaging, analytics, and journey orchestration for mobile-first enterprise brands. It serves various sectors, including retail, travel, healthcare, finance, and media, with a focus on enhancing customer engagement across multiple channels such as mobile apps, web, email, and SMS.

The platform offers a comprehensive suite of services, including journey orchestration and automation, messaging and content creation, and analytics solutions. Airship's tools enable businesses to build and optimize personalized customer journeys, manage push notifications and in-app messages, and leverage real-time data for campaign optimization. Its pricing model is usage-based, ensuring reliability for high-scale, real-time delivery. Trusted by brands like Alaska Airlines, BBC, and The Home Depot, Airship is dedicated to driving revenue and loyalty through seamless cross-channel experiences.

companies.description:
Airtable is a cloud-based collaboration platform based in San Francisco, California. Founded in 2012, it combines the simplicity of spreadsheets with the power of databases, allowing users to organize, track, and manage work without coding. The platform supports no-code app development and offers features like customizable data fields, multiple views (grid, calendar, kanban), and workflow automation.

Since its public launch in 2015, Airtable has grown significantly, serving over 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100. It employs a freemium model, converting free users to paid subscribers through continuous feature updates. The platform is designed for scalability, catering to teams from startups to large enterprises, and emphasizes creativity through community-driven templates and integrations with tools like Salesforce and SAP.

companies.description:
Aize is a software company founded in 2020, specializing in industry software for managing digital representations, or digital twins, of capital-intensive heavy assets. Headquartered in Norway, with operations in the UK and US, Aize leverages decades of offshore industrial and software expertise to enhance project execution in sectors such as energy, offshore, renewables, and heavy industry.

The company offers a browser-based platform that includes modular tools for 3D visualization, advanced information modeling, and intelligent workflows. Key features enable real-time coordination of communication, data, and documents, supporting asset management, maintenance planning, and integrity management. Aize's platform is designed to improve efficiency, safety, and profitability throughout the asset lifecycle, from new builds to existing operations. With over 5,000 users globally, Aize collaborates with industry leaders like Aker Solutions and BP to drive digitalization and support the global energy transition.

Alaris Antennas is a South African company specializing in defense and security-focused antenna and RF technology. Founded in 1990, it transitioned from a consultancy to a manufacturing entity in 2002. The company is headquartered in Centurion, Gauteng, and operates as part of Alaris Holdings, which includes several subsidiaries across multiple countries.

Alaris Antennas designs and manufactures a wide range of high-quality antennas and antenna systems that operate within the 9kHz to 18GHz frequency range. Their product offerings include log periodic dipole arrays, active array antennas, and customized RF and microwave electronics. The company also provides comprehensive in-house design and engineering services, including simulation design, CAD modeling, and antenna customization. Alaris Antennas serves various sectors, including defense, homeland security, and scientific communities, with a strong focus on custom-designed solutions that foster customer loyalty.

AlbR is located at 80 Cheapside, London EC2V 6EE.

Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise (ALE) is a French software company based in Colombes, near Paris. Founded in 2014, ALE specializes in enterprise communication equipment, networking solutions, and services for businesses. The company has a rich history in telecommunications, tracing its roots back over 100 years through various mergers and innovations. ALE operates independently from Nokia and employs around 3,500 to 4,000 professionals worldwide.

ALE offers a range of communication and networking solutions designed to enhance multimedia interactions across devices. Their key products include tools for communications management and security, enterprise networking, IoT enablement, and collaboration platforms like Rainbow, a cloud-based solution. ALE focuses on delivering tailored solutions for various sectors, including healthcare, hospitality, education, transportation, and government, helping organizations adapt to the digital era with flexible cloud models.

Alcoa is a global leader in bauxite, alumina, and aluminum products, with a rich history dating back to its founding in 1888. The company was established to commercialize the Hall–Héroult process, which made aluminum production more cost-effective. In 2016, Alcoa restructured into two independent corporations, with one continuing under the Alcoa name, focusing on mining and aluminum processing.

Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and New York City, Alcoa operates in over 350 locations across 42 countries, employing approximately 129,000 people. The company offers a wide range of products, including aerospace and automotive components, packaging materials, aluminum forged wheels, cast products, and construction materials. Alcoa serves various industries such as aerospace, automotive, packaging, and building and construction, maintaining a strong presence in high-technology sectors and consumer goods.

We believe that the quality of service offered by the legal profession is woefully inadequate. It delivers bad value for money, frustrates the people it exists to serve, and lacks basic accountability.

We believe that a law firm should:

- Speak in language people actually understand
- Equip people to make informed decisions on the issues that matter to them
- Provide an empathetic, proactive service aligned with people's end goals — not billable hours

The company specializes in high-end scarves, shawls, knitwear, and home furnishings, with production facilities located in Ayr and Hawick, Scotland. Originally a handloom weaving operation, Alex Begg has evolved by investing in advanced machinery and focusing on quality craftsmanship.The company produces luxury woven and knitted textiles entirely in-house, utilizing traditional techniques alongside modern technology. Its core offerings include hand-loomed cashmere and wool scarves and shawls, a range of knitwear for men and women, and luxurious home furnishings. The in-house label, Begg x Co, features contemporary collections inspired by art, nature, and Scottish heritage. Alex Begg serves prestigious luxury fashion houses and brands globally, known for its commitment to quality and sustainability.

companies.description:
Algolia is a search-as-a-service platform that provides APIs for developers and enterprises to integrate fast and relevant search capabilities into their products. Founded in 2012 by Nicolas Dessaigne and Julien Lemoine, Algolia has become a trusted technology solution for thousands of companies worldwide. The platform is designed to meet modern application needs, particularly with its "as you type" search functionality.

Algolia offers two main product categories: AI Search, which features a quality search bar that can be quickly integrated into websites, and AI Recommendations, an automated tool for personalized product suggestions. The platform also supports hybrid search capabilities, allowing businesses to search unstructured data like text and images. With an API-driven architecture, Algolia is accessible across various platforms and languages, processing over 50 billion search queries each month. The company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and has additional offices in major cities around the world.

Alkimi is a UK-based decentralized advertising platform that operates on the Sui Network blockchain. It aims to improve programmatic advertising by enhancing transparency, reducing fees, and minimizing environmental impact. Founded by Ben Putley and Adam Chorley, the company addresses key issues in traditional advertising, such as high intermediary fees and low financial transparency.

The Alkimi Exchange is a blockchain-powered programmatic ad exchange that connects advertisers and publishers in real-time. It offers features like total financial transparency through an immutable ledger, reduced fees by cutting out intermediaries, and lower emissions compared to traditional models. Alkimi is also certified as a B Corporation™, reflecting its commitment to social and environmental performance. The company focuses on creating a sustainable ad ecosystem that benefits all stakeholders through relevant and high-quality ads.

All3Media Limited is a prominent British independent television, film, and digital production company based in London. Founded in 2003 by former ITV executives, it has grown to become one of the UK's largest TV producers, operating over 50 production labels across multiple countries, including the US, Germany, and New Zealand. The company emphasizes innovation and creative excellence in its diverse range of scripted and unscripted content.

All3Media is known for producing award-winning programming across various genres. Some of its notable productions include the reality format "The Traitors," the natural history series "David Attenborough: A Life on Our Planet," and acclaimed dramas like "Fleabag" and "Call the Midwife." The company also has a strong international distribution arm, ensuring its content reaches broadcasters and platforms worldwide.

companies.description:
Allica Bank is a UK-based digital bank that focuses on providing banking services to established small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with 5 to 250 employees. Founded in 2011 and rebranded in 2019, Allica aims to empower SMEs that are often overlooked by traditional banks. The bank operates fully digitally, without physical branches, and offers a range of products including the Business Rewards Account, savings products, and various lending options.

The Business Rewards Account features cashback and interest with no monthly fees, while the savings products include both instant access and fixed-term deposits. Allica's lending services cover asset finance, commercial mortgages, buy-to-let mortgages, and bridging finance, supported by proprietary technology and a dedicated team. With over 25,000 business customers and significant growth in deposits and loans, Allica Bank is recognized as one of Britain's fastest-growing fintech companies.

AlliedOffsets is a London-based company established in 2014, specializing in the voluntary carbon market (VCM). It offers the world's largest aggregated database and market intelligence platform focused on data transparency, analytics, and forecasting. The company tracks over 36,667 carbon offset projects, 1,082 carbon dioxide removal companies, and 22,298 corporate buyer profiles, providing comprehensive insights into the carbon offsetting landscape.

The platform features a vast VCM database, interactive dashboards for trend analysis and project ratings, and API integration for real-time data access. AlliedOffsets also utilizes AI tools for predictive insights and offers custom solutions tailored to specific client needs. Its services cater to a diverse range of stakeholders, including corporates, financial institutions, project developers, and researchers, helping them navigate the complexities of carbon offsetting and make informed decisions.

companies.description:
Alloyed is a UK-based company focused on advanced materials and digital manufacturing. Founded in 2017 as a spinout from Oxford University, Alloyed specializes in custom alloy development, additive manufacturing optimization, and metal component production. The company is headquartered in Yarnton, Oxfordshire, and has raised a total of $70 million in funding to enhance its manufacturing capabilities in the UK and the USA.

Alloyed offers a range of services throughout the metal manufacturing lifecycle, including advanced alloy production, additive manufacturing optimization, and end-to-end metal part production. Their technology portfolio features proprietary software platforms like Engine® for laser path control, Architect® for designing complex parts, and Alloys-By-Design (ABD®) for alloy composition development. Alloyed serves various industries, including aerospace, automotive, electronics, medical devices, and defense, producing components for applications such as jet engines and smartwatches.

Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Limited (AOS) is a global supplier and developer of a wide range of power semiconductor devices. The company specializes in discrete power devices, wide bandgap power devices, power management integrated circuits (ICs), and modules. AOS integrates advanced semiconductor process technology and product design to create high-performance power management solutions.

AOS offers a diverse portfolio of products, including Power MOSFETs, Silicon Carbide (SiC), Gallium Nitride (GaN), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBT), Intelligent Power Modules (IPM), and more. These products are designed for high-volume applications across various sectors, such as personal computers, data centers, automotive electronics, and consumer devices. The company operates with a focus on innovation and customer responsiveness, supported by its in-house wafer fabrication facility in Hillsboro, Oregon.

Focusing on the strategic market areas of digital signal processing (DSP), imaging systems, communications, military and aerospace and high performance computing (HPC), Space FPGA prototyping, Alpha Data has established a global customer base and reputation for leading edge design.

companies.description:
AlphaSights is a global information services company founded in 2008, specializing in connecting clients with subject matter experts for on-demand insights. The company primarily serves professionals in management consulting, investment management, private equity, and corporate strategy across various sectors, including technology, healthcare, finance, and energy.

Headquartered in London, AlphaSights has expanded its presence with offices in major cities such as New York, Hong Kong, and Tokyo. The company operates as a "knowledge broker," facilitating one-on-one consultations, phone calls, and customized research to help clients navigate unfamiliar markets. Its services include rapid expert recruitment, scheduling expert calls, and conducting surveys, all supported by strict compliance protocols to ensure confidentiality. With a focus on innovation and client success, AlphaSights has grown rapidly, employing over 2,000 people and earning recognition as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies.

Apollo focuses on generating risk-adjusted returns through innovative capital solutions for both institutions and individuals.

The company offers a range of services in alternative asset management, including private equity, credit, real estate, and retirement solutions. Its private equity division engages in leveraged buyouts and distressed investments, while its credit services include middle-market direct lending and high-yield portfolios. Appian offers a suite of software solutions that include process orchestration, automation, and intelligence. Its flagship product, the Appian Platform, features low-code design tools, artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, and intelligent document processing. This platform allows organizations to build applications and workflows quickly and efficiently. The platform features tools for invoice capture, batch payments, and generating payment links for receivables. It also provides expense cards for employees, ensuring oversight on spending. Aptiv's offerings encompass a wide range of products, such as driver monitoring systems, vehicle data platforms, and smart vehicle architecture. The company focuses on streamlining non-teaching tasks, which can take up more than 60% of staff time, ultimately enhancing productivity for educators and administrators.

Arbor offers a comprehensive suite of school management tools, including a cloud-based management information system for tracking attendance, behavior, and assessments. Their services also encompass financial and HR tools, automated timetabling, compliance solutions, and data analytics for real-time insights into school performance.
