companies.description:
Contollo is a new building consultancy that brings together built environment experts with people who know how to build a group.

The demand for energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and sustainability, coincides with increased expectations of what buildings can deliver. However, the building services sector is highly fragmented, with isolated disciplines and limited collaboration. This siloed approach reduces the effectiveness of the consultancy process and prevents developers from realising the full potential of smart buildings.

The founders of Contollo are on a journey to form a new mid-sized consultancy that works with commercial developers to offer building consultancy (MEP and Cost Management), with particular expertise in smart buildings. Contollo seeks to bridge the gaps in collaboration, allowing a more integrated and effective approach to building consultancy that unlocks the full potential of smart buildings for developers.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: ControlAI is a non-profit organization focused on AI safety advocacy. It aims to mitigate existential risks associated with advanced AI systems, including artificial superintelligence. The organization engages in public campaigns, policy proposals, and civic engagement initiatives to raise awareness about AI risks and promote regulatory measures.ControlAI publishes newsletters, articles, and updates on various AI-related topics, including recursive self-improvement and misalignment issues. It promotes the "Direct Institutional Plan (DIP)" to encourage individuals and organizations to advocate for binding regulations on powerful AI systems. The organization has garnered support from numerous politicians and experts, emphasizing the importance of addressing potential extinction risks.Through its campaigns, ControlAI seeks to establish global "red lines" on AI development, including bans on superintelligence. It also provides educational content, including a weekly newsletter and a podcast featuring discussions on AI security and alignment. The organization collaborates on policy initiatives and shares media updates to inform the public about developments in the AI landscape.

The company operates under its parent entity, Convene Hospitality Group, and includes brands like etc.venues and Club 75. Convene offers a variety of services, including premium venues for corporate meetings and events, flexible coworking spaces, and advanced event production capabilities. With a focus on customer service and visually inspiring environments, Convene aims to provide tailored experiences for organizations seeking impactful gatherings. The company aims to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability in construction, particularly through concrete optimization and decarbonization efforts. Converge serves major construction companies globally, with a diverse team representing 17 nationalities and 11 languages.

The company's flagship platform, ConcreteDNA™, offers real-time monitoring, data management, and AI insights for concrete operations. Converge also provides advanced sensor systems, including Signal Long Range™, Mesh System, and Converge Signal, which monitor concrete temperature and strength. Additional solutions like the Data Hub and StructureDNA help contractors optimize workflows and assess structural health. Converge's innovations enable faster construction, improved quality, reduced carbon emissions, and enhanced worker safety. The company employs a unique dual setup where traders and developers work together to create value. Convex Energy has been profitable since its inception and trades across three locations. Its operations include processing vast amounts of data for quick trading decisions, developing proprietary trading models, and utilizing advanced technology for executing trades. Additionally, Convex Energy offers educational resources on various energy trading topics, enhancing knowledge in areas such as power trading and market operations.

Copper.co offers a range of services designed to enhance security and efficiency in digital asset markets. Its custody solutions utilize Multi-Party Computation (MPC) technology for secure storage, ensuring assets remain protected while allowing connectivity to centralized exchanges. The company also provides prime services for trading and settlement, collateral management tools for efficient asset handling, and the Copper Platform, which facilitates secure custody and trading of crypto assets. The company offers automated infringement detection, enforcement, and resolution services at no upfront cost to clients, charging fees only upon successful outcomes. Founded on August 27, 2019, and formerly known as Visual Rights Group, Inc., Copyright Agent is headquartered in Denmark and has offices in the US, UK, Denmark, and Belgium.

As an Intellectual Property Rights as a Service (IPRaaS) platform, Copyright Agent utilizes advanced software to scan the internet for unauthorized use of clients' content. Their services include automated image search and infringement detection, comprehensive case resolution, and enforcement in multiple languages. The company serves a diverse clientele, including stock photo agencies, press agencies, and top photographers, and is recognized for its legal expertise and understanding of the image industry.

In December 2024, Connect Health merged with Healthshare to form Cora Health, creating a multi-disciplinary healthcare services provider.Connect Health offers a range of services, including assessment, treatment, and rehabilitation for MSK conditions, community-based mental health support, and pain management programs. The merger with Healthshare has expanded its offerings to include surgical and diagnostic services, enhancing its ability to provide integrated care. It was the first UK-listed investment company dedicated to digital infrastructure, raising approximately £795 million through various fundraising efforts.

The company employs a "Buy, Build & Grow" strategy, targeting high-quality, cash-flowing platforms and enhancing revenues through operational management and strategic acquisitions. Its portfolio includes essential digital assets that support major platforms and services, ensuring predictable cash flows from long-term contracts with blue-chip clients. With offices in Washington, D.C., and Tokyo, CORE POWER finances, constructs, and delivers maritime nuclear energy solutions, focusing on scalable atomic power for emission-free operations.

The company develops advanced fission technology for civil nuclear propulsion in ships, enabling zero-emission deep-sea shipping. CORE POWER designs floating nuclear power plants (FNPPs) that generate clean electricity for offshore facilities and local grids. Its Liberty Programme aims to mass-produce FNPPs with modular construction, targeting full commercialization by the mid-2030s. CORE POWER collaborates with partners like Glosten and Mitsubishi Research Institute to advance its initiatives and engage in market studies, contributing to the growth of the floating power market.

The company focuses on providing transparent and affordable credit options, helping consumers manage unexpected expenses while avoiding high-cost alternatives like payday loans and credit cards. With a commitment to borrower control and simplicity, Creditspring aims to support individuals facing financial challenges in the UK.

Crowdcube pioneered investment-based crowdfunding and has facilitated over 800 startups, raising more than £625 million. The company, acquired by Roper Technologies in 2015, serves over 6,000 hospitals and laboratories in more than 80 countries. It focuses on enhancing vendor-neutral connectivity, productivity, quality, and compliance to optimize patient care.

The company offers a range of lab software solutions, including the widely used Instrument Manager™, which facilitates device connectivity and workflow management, and EP Evaluator®, a tool for instrument performance validation and regulatory compliance. Data Innovations supports clinical labs of all sizes, helping them improve diagnostics and workflow efficiency. With around 311 employees and generating approximately $65.3 million in revenue, Data Innovations is recognized as a leader in the lab enablement software space.

Founded in 2011 and rebranded in 2023, the company is headquartered in Belfast, Northern Ireland, and operates globally with offices in the UK, US, Singapore, and Hong Kong. It employs around 250 skilled professionals, including consultants, developers, and data scientists.

The firm offers a range of services, including consulting and implementation in areas such as Kdb+ and Big Data, data science, software development, and project management. Data Intellect also provides hands-on coding workshops, mentorship, and integration with tools like PyKX and Databricks. Its proprietary software suite, TorQ, helps clients optimize database technologies and enhance data analytics capabilities. The company primarily serves global financial institutions but also supports sectors like fintech, healthcare, renewables, and telematics.

Datadog, Inc. is a cloud-native observability and security platform founded in 2010 by Olivier Pomel and Alexis Lê-Quôc. The company provides unified monitoring, analytics, and security solutions for developers, IT operations, and business users in cloud environments. Launched in 2012, Datadog has evolved from infrastructure monitoring to a comprehensive observability platform that integrates metrics, traces, and logs into real-time dashboards.

Datadog's offerings include infrastructure monitoring for various cloud services, application performance monitoring, log management, and a range of security solutions. These security features encompass code security, cloud security, and compliance management. The platform supports collaborative troubleshooting across complex cloud infrastructures, making it a valuable tool for organizations in various industries, including financial services, healthcare, retail, and technology. With a focus on customer-driven development, Datadog has established itself as a leader in the SaaS market, expanding globally and serving high-profile clients like Netflix and Spotify.

Datamaran is a London-based software analytics platform that specializes in ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) governance and non-financial risk management solutions. Founded in 2014, the company was established by Marjella Alma, JP Lecourt, and Jérôme Basdevant. With a team of approximately 130-134 employees, Datamaran has raised a total of $46.3 million in funding, including a recent Series C round of $33.0 million in 2024.

The platform offers a fully automated solution that identifies and monitors over 400 external risks, focusing on ESG risks and opportunities. Key features include dynamic materiality analysis, real-time monitoring of ESG factors, double materiality analysis, and regulatory monitoring. Datamaran utilizes AI technology to convert extensive data into actionable insights, aiding corporate executives and board members in navigating the complex ESG landscape. The company aims to embed ESG principles into the core operations of major companies worldwide.

The company specializes in innovative solutions using Google Cloud technologies, serving various industries such as telecommunications, gaming, media, health/life sciences, financial services, and retail. With a team of 201-500 employees, Datatonic positions itself as a modern consultancy that enhances data value through comprehensive services including planning, design, deployment, and training.

The company has successfully completed over 800 projects, focusing on cloud data and AI solutions. Key services include Generative AI platforms, marketing analytics, and cloud data migration. Datatonic has received multiple accolades, including several Google Cloud Partner of the Year awards and recognition as a Great Place to Work. Recent developments include the appointment of Scott Eivers as CEO and the acquisition of Syntio Ltd. to strengthen its data engineering capabilities. Datatonic collaborates with partners like Google Cloud and Atlan to deliver impactful solutions for its clients.

Datox is on a mission to transform financial regulatory reporting. Our mission is to revolutionize how financial services companies handle regulatory requirements through our AI-powered automation platform, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance across various jurisdictions.

Our Vision:

Navigating complex financial regulations from entities like the FCA and SEC can be challenging. Our vision is to bridge the gap between financial institutions and regulatory bodies, providing an intelligent, automated solution that adapts to the evolving regulatory landscape.

Datox focuses on automating the preparation and submission of a wide range of financial regulatory reports, including:

AIFMD (Annex IV)
MiFID II Transaction
EMIR Trade
Solvency II
PRIIPs KID
SEC Filings (Form 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.)
Basel III Compliance
FATCA and CRS

Our platform handles data from various sources, performs complex calculations, and ensures compliance with the latest regulations.

Innovations We're Bringing:

AI-Powered Automation: Our platform uses AI and machine learning to automate data extraction, processing, and reporting, reducing manual work and errors.
Regulatory Compliance: Continuously updated to meet the latest FCA, SEC, and global regulations, minimizing non-compliance risks.
Seamless Integration: Integrates with your existing systems and data sources, handling all formats.
User-Friendly Interface: An intuitive interface that simplifies reporting and provides actionable insights.
Comprehensive Support: Our experts offer training, consultation, and ongoing assistance.

The company focuses on enhancing online presence and driving sales through a range of customized services. These include email marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), social media campaigns, paid advertising, public relations outreach, influencer marketing, content creation, and website design and optimization.

Founded in December 2022, De Digitizers operates as a private limited company and employs a team of four. The agency adopts a collaborative approach to help clients attract new customers and achieve their business goals. Notable clients include EasyDigz, GDPR, and HalloJS, for whom De Digitizers has developed comprehensive marketing strategies and SEO services. The company is led by Hafiz Syed Ahmad Hassan, Co-Founder and Technical Lead.

De La Rue plc is a British security printing and manufacturing company based in Basingstoke, England. It specializes in secure digital and physical protections for goods, trade, and currency. As of July 2025, the company operates under private ownership by Atlas Holdings.

Founded in 1813 by Thomas de la Rue, the company has a rich history of innovation in printing. It is the world's largest commercial printer of banknotes, producing both paper and polymer banknotes for over 150 nations. De La Rue also manufactures advanced security features to combat counterfeiting, such as color-shifting ink and polymer notes. In addition to currency, the company produces passports, identity cards, and devices for counting and sorting currency. De La Rue has established itself as a leader in the security printing industry, having acquired several competitors over its long history.

Decagon is a San Francisco-based AI startup founded in 2023 by Jesse Zhang and Ashwin Sreenivas. The company specializes in generative AI agents designed for enterprise customer support and customer experience (CX) automation. With a team of around 100-200 employees, Decagon has raised approximately $200-231 million in funding, achieving unicorn status within 18 months.

Decagon offers a cloud-based SaaS platform that enables businesses to build and scale conversational AI agents. These agents provide continuous support by automating tasks such as resolving support tickets, answering product inquiries, and managing subscriptions. The platform features context-aware responses, true omnichannel automation, and analytics tools that help enterprises enhance customer engagement and loyalty while reducing costs. Decagon's technology is built on large language models and integrates seamlessly across various communication channels, making it a robust solution for modern customer experience challenges.

Decant Group is a UK-based company that specializes in wine and spirits collectables. Founded in December 2019, it operates through several interconnected "Houses" that provide tailored services in investment, consumption, and production of fine wines, premium spirits, whisky casks, and bottles. The company has achieved significant growth, generating over £100 million in sales and managing £100 million in assets while serving more than 50,000 users.

The group's specialized units include Decant Index, a digital marketplace for buying and selling fine wines and spirits; House of Decant, an online retailer with curated selections; Whisky Partners, which focuses on whisky cask sales; Decant Bond, offering secure bonded storage; and Decant Ventures, which invests in fast-growing SMEs and creates new brands. Decant Group emphasizes accessibility in alternative investments, utilizing advanced technology and client advisory services to enhance user experience and demystify the market.

The company aims to make high-quality sports products accessible to everyone through affordable pricing and expert advice. It specializes in a wide range of sporting goods, including fishing gear, camping equipment, and bicycles, and offers products under more than 20 in-house brands.

Decathlon UK focuses on outdoor activities and provides a vast selection of equipment across various sports categories. The company emphasizes sustainability with eco-designed packaging and initiatives like second-hand equipment trading. It also adopts an omni-channel approach, combining physical stores with online shopping to enhance customer experience. Decathlon UK targets a diverse audience, including families and outdoor enthusiasts, and is committed to fostering inclusivity through sport.

Deel is a global HR technology platform founded in 2019 that helps companies hire, manage, pay, and comply with regulations for international contractors and employees in 150 countries. The platform acts as an operating system for global work, offering automated payroll, HR, and compliance tools. Co-founded by Alex Bouaziz and Shuo Wang, Deel has grown rapidly, processing $17.3 billion in payments and supporting over 37,000 businesses.

Deel provides a modular software-driven platform that includes services such as Employer of Record (EOR), global payroll, and HR and compliance tools. These services facilitate compliant hiring, onboarding, and management across various countries. The company emphasizes automation and vertical integration to streamline global workforce management. Deel also offers additional services like finance, mobility, IT support, and culture-building, along with a unified platform for international payments. With a focus on a global-first strategy, Deel serves a diverse range of clients, including well-known brands like Nike, Dropbox, and Shopify.

Launched in 2024 following Deel's acquisition of Hofy, the company operates in over 120 countries, providing comprehensive solutions for managing office equipment and IT services.

Founded in 2020, Hofy aimed to address the challenges of remote work by delivering and managing office equipment for distributed teams. With a strong track record of serving over 700 businesses and achieving a 99%+ on-time delivery rate, Deel IT continues this legacy by offering end-to-end procurement, shipping, and management of devices. Their services include software provisioning, app access management, and seamless integration with HR processes, ensuring efficient onboarding and offboarding for employees.

The company focuses on building high-impact ventures that tackle global challenges in sectors such as climate, agriculture, computation, pharmaceuticals, and education. DSV operates as a venture studio, employing a unique "solution-pull" methodology that prioritizes societal outcomes by identifying pressing problems and developing scalable solutions.

With a portfolio of 56 launched companies and 37 in development, DSV has attracted £160 million in funding and achieved a portfolio valuation of £500 million. The firm emphasizes diversity through initiatives like the Venture Science Doctorate/PhD Programme, aiming for 50% representation from women and ethnic minorities. DSV collaborates with academic and corporate institutions to validate and adopt innovative solutions, focusing on neglected areas with novel intellectual property. Its ventures include advancements in sustainable agriculture, climate solutions, computational intelligence, and curative therapeutics.

DeepL is an AI company based in Cologne, Germany, specializing in high-precision neural machine translation and language solutions. Founded in 2009 as Linguee, the company launched its flagship product, DeepL Translator, in 2017. Led by CEO Jaroslaw Kutylowski, DeepL utilizes proprietary neural networks trained on extensive bilingual datasets to deliver translations that are recognized for their accuracy and context-awareness.

DeepL offers several key products, including the DeepL Translator, which supports multiple languages and is known for its natural translation results. The company also provides DeepL Pro, an enterprise subscription service that integrates translation tools into business workflows, and DeepL Agent, an AI assistant designed to automate language-related tasks. With over 200,000 business customers, including many Fortune 500 companies, DeepL is positioned to make a significant impact in the AI translation and writing assistance markets.

Founded in September 2020 by former Magic Circle lawyers Nnamdi Emelifeonwu and Feargus MacDaeid, Definely aims to enhance the efficiency of creating, drafting, reviewing, and understanding complex legal documents. The company has developed a platform that is widely adopted by leading law firms and corporate legal teams around the world.

Definely offers a suite of products as a Microsoft Word add-in, which includes Vault, Draft, Enhance, Proof, and PDF. These tools assist lawyers in managing knowledge, drafting documents, improving accuracy, proofreading, and extracting information from PDF files. The platform supports various stages of the contract lifecycle and litigation workflows, operating on a per-case pricing model. Definely serves a diverse clientele, including notable law firms and Fortune 500 companies, and is recognized as one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK.

Founded in 1969 and rebranded in January 2023, Delinian operates a portfolio of over 20 specialist information services businesses, serving customers in more than 140 countries. The company is headquartered in London, with additional offices in New York and employs over 2,200 people across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia.

Delinian's portfolio includes brands like Extel, which offers data and rankings for financial institutions, and Institutional Investor, a platform for networking events and capital introduction services. Other notable brands include Derivia, providing insights across derivatives and fixed income, and Morningstar, known for its investment research. Delinian targets professionals and institutions in competitive markets, including financial institutions, asset managers, corporate clients, and specialized industry brands, focusing on delivering critical data and expert insights to support informed decision-making.

The company connects customers with high-quality restaurant meals, delivering them directly to homes. Deliveroo was established to fill a gap in London's food delivery market, aiming to make premium restaurant meals more accessible.

The platform features web and mobile applications for easy ordering and payment, supported by a network of self-employed couriers using bicycles and motorcycles. Deliveroo partners with numerous restaurants, including those that traditionally did not offer delivery services, and has expanded its offerings with services like Deliveroo Editions and Deliveroo Plus. By 2021, the company had grown to connect customers with over 140,000 restaurants globally, establishing a strong presence in various regions, including Europe, Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.

Deloitte is a global professional services firm founded in 1845 by William Welch Deloitte in London. Initially focused on independent financial auditing, it has grown into one of the largest professional services networks, employing over 450,000 people across more than 150 countries. Deloitte offers a wide range of services, including audit and assurance, tax, consulting, financial advisory, and risk services, catering to organizations from Global 500 companies to private businesses.

The firm has a rich history, marked by significant milestones such as becoming the first independent auditor for a public company in 1849. Over the years, Deloitte has expanded internationally and evolved through mergers, notably forming Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu. Its consulting division has seen rapid growth, particularly in strategy, operations, and technology. Deloitte emphasizes making a meaningful impact through connection, collaboration, and innovation, reflecting its commitment to adapting to the needs of diverse industries.

Founded in 2005 and based in San Francisco, California, the company focuses on helping B2B organizations achieve their revenue goals through artificial intelligence. Demandbase pioneered account-based marketing, changing how B2B teams identify, engage, and convert potential customers.

The Demandbase platform offers a range of integrated solutions, including account intelligence, account identification and engagement tools, account-based advertising, website personalization, sales and marketing automation, and multi-channel orchestration. These features enable businesses to target high-value accounts effectively and streamline their marketing efforts across various channels.

Demandbase serves a diverse array of industries, including business services, financial services, manufacturing, technology, and enterprise. With a workforce of approximately 888-1,024 employees, the company has generated annual revenue between $100 million and $253.8 million and has raised a total of $330 million in funding. Based in Bracknell, United Kingdom, with additional offices in Poland, Bosnia, the United Arab Emirates, and India, Deployflow focuses on the streamlined deployment and management of software applications. The company has grown from a small two-person agency to a team of over 60 employees, led by co-founders Prakash Pilley and Thomas Radosh. 

Deployflow offers a wide range of services, including cloud services, DevOps consulting, IT consulting, AI and IT support, CI/CD pipeline optimization, cloud infrastructure management, API security, and legacy system modernization. The company serves small and medium-sized businesses across various sectors, such as finance, healthcare, and technology, providing tailored solutions that enhance efficiency and security. Depop is a circular fashion marketplace and peer-to-peer resale platform founded in 2011. It allows users to buy, sell, and discover affordable secondhand clothing, accessories, and vintage items through its app and web service. With 43.5 million registered users globally, Depop has popularized preloved fashion and generated over $2.5 billion in collective seller earnings, particularly appealing to Gen Z, with 90% of its active users under 26.

Originally a social shopping app linked to the Italian fashion magazine *PIG*, Depop was created by Simon Beckerman. The platform combines social features with a marketplace model, targeting younger audiences. Under CEO Maria Raga, who joined in 2016, Depop has focused on community engagement through events and curated programs. Now the largest online fashion resale marketplace, it operates from offices in London, New York, and Manchester, and became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Etsy in 2021. Depop emphasizes style, value, and sustainability, making circular fashion accessible and inspiring for its users.

It aims to drive positive change for its clients through innovative design solutions. The agency was formed in 2023 from the merger of Superunion and Design Bridge and has its headquarters in London, with additional studios in key cities such as Amsterdam, Singapore, New York, and Shanghai.

The agency offers a wide range of brand design services, including brand strategy, design systems, identity, and effectiveness. Design Bridge and Partners has worked on notable projects for clients like NASA Artemis, Unilever, Coca-Cola, and Aston Martin, showcasing its ability to create impactful brand identities and immersive experiences. Founded in 2001 by Chris Padfield, the company has grown to serve over 30,000 users and agents across more than 150 countries, with a dedicated team of 75 employees.

The software provides multi-channel communication management, including email, live chat, phone, and social media. It features solutions for Customer Service Management (CSM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Enterprise Service Management (ESM). Deskpro also includes ticketing, CRM, and knowledgebase functionalities, along with AI-powered tools to automate various processes. The platform supports flexible deployment options, allowing customers to choose between cloud, private cloud, or on-premise setups.

With offices in London and Austin, Deskpro is well-positioned to serve its global clientele, which includes notable organizations like Aon, Bitdefender, and the NHS. In 2024, the company secured $25 million in funding to enhance its customer experience and expand its AI capabilities.

It specializes in robotics and AI-driven logistics solutions, utilizing fully autonomous mobile robots and its digital twin platform, DexoryView. This platform provides real-time insights into warehouse inventory, enhancing visibility and operational efficiency.

The DexoryView system creates a live digital twin of facilities by scanning entire sites, including hard-to-reach areas. It offers features such as daily autonomous scanning for high inventory accuracy, significant reductions in manual stocktaking, and end-to-end visibility for inventory management. Dexory serves various sectors, including logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, food and beverage, retail, and pharmaceuticals, helping optimize inventory flow and improve order accuracy. The company has raised substantial funding to support product development and global expansion, partnering with notable clients like Maersk, DHL, and GE Appliances.

The platform utilizes AI for data capture and integrates seamlessly with over 30 accounting software partners, including Xero and QuickBooks Online.

Dext's features include various document submission methods, smart automation tools, and specialized applications tailored for professional services firms. The company focuses on premium spirits, beer, and wine, having divested non-beverage assets to concentrate on its core offerings.

With a portfolio of over 200 premium brands, Diageo includes well-known names such as Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Tanqueray, Baileys, and Guinness. The company emphasizes brand-building and strategic acquisitions, with a strong presence in high-growth markets across Asia, Africa, and the Americas. The company offers a unified business communications platform that integrates calling, messaging, meetings, and customer support, all powered by advanced AI technology. Dialpad's platform includes features like real-time transcription, sentiment analysis, and analytics, making it easy for teams to communicate and collaborate effectively.

The company has a strong history in internet telephony, with its founders previously involved in notable ventures such as Dialpad Communications and Google Voice. Dialpad serves over 3,000 customers, focusing on mid-market businesses and providing support through various initiatives like Dialpad for Startups and Dialpad for Good. It specializes in an intelligent platform designed to automate premium reconciliation, distribution, and processing for the intermediated insurance industry. The company primarily serves insurers and brokers in the United Kingdom, focusing on compliance, regulatory support, and ancillary accountancy services within the insurance value chain.

Diesta's premium processing platform connects internal systems, brokers, and insurers to a unified financial ledger. Key features include automated reconciliation of premium records, a credit control module for faster payment collection, and integration with systems like Whitespace for reliable policy administration data. The platform aims to enhance cash flow and efficiency in the insurance sector, with upcoming features designed to unlock capital and improve liquidity. Diesta is also compliant with SOC 1, SOC 2, and GDPR standards, ensuring secure operations in the financial services space.

Founded in 2016 as a spin-out from the University of Oxford, Diffblue aims to enhance software development by addressing the challenges of testing and code quality. The company has successfully raised a total of $24.4 million in funding, including significant investments from Goldman Sachs.

The flagship product, Diffblue Cover, utilizes reinforcement learning to autonomously write unit tests, achieving a 0% error rate and ensuring accuracy. It can generate a unit test every two seconds and continuously maintains tests as code changes occur. In addition to the commercial version, Diffblue offers a Cover Community Edition, which is available for both open source and commercial organizations. The company serves a diverse range of clients, including major financial and technology institutions like Goldman Sachs, Citi, and AWS.

This technology enables authentication, tracking, and automation, fostering trust in various interactions.

Founded in the mid-1990s, Digimarc has a rich history of innovation, including the launch of its first product in 1996 and the granting of its first U.S. patent in 1997. The company serves a wide range of industries, including banking, healthcare, and education, and counts 75% of the Fortune 500 among its clients.

Diligent's primary product, Diligent Boards, enables board members and management to efficiently produce, deliver, and review board materials securely. The first Dishoom opened in Covent Garden and quickly gained popularity. The group has since expanded to 11 locations across the UK, including sites in Birmingham, Edinburgh, and Glasgow. Dishoom serves over 40,000 diners weekly and employs around 900-1,000 people. The menu features a variety of Indian-inspired dishes, including chai, curries, and small plates, all presented in immersive environments that reflect Bombay's rich history. Dishpatch is now part of the Waitrose family and was established to help restaurants reach customers through direct home deliveries, especially during the first UK lockdown.

The company offers a variety of exclusive menus from over 30 partner restaurants, with meals delivered nationwide every Friday. Customers can choose from seasonal collections and enjoy dishes designed for easy heating and serving, making it ideal for date nights or family gatherings. Its mission is to enhance transparency and access in healthcare, allowing patients to search, compare, and book appointments with specialists quickly.

It operates in the UK, Australia, and globally, serving a range of clients from smallholder farms to multinational corporations.

The core offering is the Downforce® platform, an ISO 14064-2 certified and US-patented tool that utilizes advanced science and technology to measure soil organic carbon levels, monitor soil health, and assess ecosystem services. This platform provides actionable insights for regenerative agriculture, carbon sequestration, and net zero reporting. Downforce Technologies also offers analytics tools for planning carbon projects and supports sustainability managers in establishing baselines and measuring progress. The platform leverages visual neuroscience and features a patented algorithm that mimics human visual processing. It offers creative testing and optimization across various formats and channels, real-time attention prediction, attention heat mapping, video analysis, and creative benchmarking for eCommerce. Featurespace serves over 70 direct customers and supports technology for 200,000 institutions worldwide, including notable clients like HSBC, NatWest, and Worldpay. The company focuses on collaborative innovation and continuous research and development to stay ahead of evolving fraud tactics, making transactions safer for businesses and consumers alike.

companies.description:
Fedcap UK is a not-for-profit organization that operates as part of The Fedcap Group, focusing on employability solutions, health services, and community projects throughout the UK. Its mission is to enhance economic wellbeing and promote social inclusion for disadvantaged individuals. Established in 2016, Fedcap UK builds on nearly 90 years of experience from its parent organization, which was founded by World War I veterans to support those excluded from the workforce.

The organization offers tailored solutions that combine international expertise with local delivery. Its services include supported employment initiatives, health services that connect employability with wellness, and community projects aimed at fostering economic development. Fedcap UK collaborates with local authorities, businesses, and stakeholders to create impactful programs, such as the UK Government's Restart Scheme and the Scottish Government's Fair Start Scotland program. By reinvesting all revenue into frontline services, Fedcap UK is dedicated to advancing social inclusion and economic independence for those it serves.

Feed Me Light Ltd. is an independent animation studio and production company located in London, United Kingdom. The studio specializes in high-end 2D and 3D animation for a variety of projects, including commercials, games, TV series, social media content, music videos, NFTs, stop motion, short films, and charity initiatives. With a team of approximately 15 employees, the company emphasizes creativity, humor, and attention to detail in its work.

Founded with a commitment to quality and collaboration, Feed Me Light promotes open communication with clients and employees. The company also engages in corporate social responsibility by donating a portion of its proceeds to a selected charity each year. Their services range from strategic consultancy to execution, covering creative briefs, storyboarding, illustrations, filming, post-production, and more, ensuring tailored content for diverse entertainment and advertising needs.

companies.description: Fender Musical Instruments Corporation is a prominent American manufacturer of electric guitars, bass guitars, amplifiers, and related musical equipment. Founded in 1946 by Leo Fender in Fullerton, California, the company is known for introducing the first mass-produced solid-body electric guitar, the Telecaster, in 1950, followed by the Precision Bass in 1951 and the iconic Stratocaster in 1954.Fender offers a wide range of instruments and amplifiers designed for musicians across various genres, including rock, jazz, country, and funk. Their products feature innovative designs such as bolt-on necks and patented pickups, contributing to their distinctive sound and playability. The company also supports music education through initiatives like Fender Play, an online platform for beginners to learn guitar and bass. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, Fender maintains manufacturing facilities in California and Mexico, focusing on quality and innovation in the musical instrument market.

Fero is a technology-enabled supply chain financing and logistics platform focused on the drinks industry, particularly beer, wine, and spirits. Founded by industry experts, Fero aims to address challenges like slow cash flows and complex logistics through a modern fintech approach. The company has deployed $570 million in capital and facilitated the trading of 57 million bottles across over 30 global markets.

Fero's platform integrates funding, logistics, and operations into a single system, enhancing efficiency for producers, distributors, and retailers. It offers flexible, inventory-based working capital, manages freight and warehousing, and streamlines workflows for sales orders and invoicing. With a user-friendly interface, Fero supports businesses of all sizes, from small craft producers to large operations, enabling them to scale effectively without disrupting existing commercial relationships. The company is trusted by over 600 partners in the drinks sector, fostering innovation and growth within the industry.

companies.description:
Fidel API is a fintech company that provides a global financial infrastructure platform, enabling developers to create programmable, real-time experiences linked to payment card events. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in London, the company has additional offices in Lisbon, New York, and Silicon Valley, employing around 120-190 people. Fidel API has successfully raised $83 million in funding and reports $25.2 million in revenue, maintaining a strong uptime SLA and robust security features.

The company offers a suite of APIs and tools for card-linking, real-time payment data capture, and event-driven applications. Its services include card-linked offers, transaction records, digital receipts, and loyalty programs, all designed to enhance user experiences while prioritizing privacy and consent. Fidel API supports connections to major card networks like Visa, Mastercard, and American Express, facilitating rapid integrations and personalized merchant engagements. Notable clients include Google, British Airways, and the Royal Bank of Canada, showcasing its impact across various sectors.

companies.description:
Fidelity International (FIL) is a private, employee-owned investment management company that was established in 1969. It operates independently from its US counterpart, Fidelity Investments, and manages over US$437 billion in assets for a diverse range of clients, including private individuals, institutions, and financial organizations across Europe, Canada, Asia, and beyond. With its largest research and investment hub in London, Fidelity International employs over 7,000 people in more than 24 countries.

The company offers a variety of active asset management solutions, including mutual funds, pension management, and retirement services tailored for personal and institutional investors. Its investment solutions feature both proprietary funds and third-party options, supported by a team of around 300 portfolio managers and researchers. Fidelity International also provides global platform solutions, digital tools for employee engagement, and centralized benefits management, serving approximately 2.5 million clients worldwide. The firm emphasizes long-term investing and proprietary research, positioning itself as a leader in financial wellbeing and workplace culture.

companies.description:
Fidenda is an independent consultancy based in London, specializing in Integrated Business Planning (IBP) using Anaplan. The firm focuses on helping complex organizations adopt IBP to enhance collaboration across departments, enabling faster, data-driven decision-making. With a team of approximately 25 employees, Fidenda emphasizes a client-first approach, ensuring that its services are tailored to meet the unique needs of each organization.

Fidenda offers a range of services centered around Anaplan, including expert guidance for developing tailored IBP strategies, implementation and integration of custom Anaplan setups, and training and support for both new and existing users. The firm addresses common challenges in IBP adoption, providing practical solutions to connect reporting, forecasting, and strategic decisions. By leveraging its deep expertise in Anaplan, Fidenda aims to deliver quick, effective outcomes for its clients.

companies.description:
Field Energy is a UK-based renewable energy infrastructure company dedicated to financing, developing, building, operating, and optimizing grid-scale battery storage projects. The company aims to support the transition to net zero emissions, starting in the UK and expanding across Europe. Founded in 2012, Field Energy has developed a vertically integrated business model focused on battery storage infrastructure, addressing challenges like energy storage and grid intermittency.

Field Energy offers comprehensive services throughout the project lifecycle, including development, construction, operations, and financing. The company manages a diverse pipeline of projects, partnering with landowners and communities to establish battery storage solutions. Its operational portfolio is projected to reach 672 MWh by March 2026, with significant capital raised to support its growth. Key projects include a 20 MWh operational site in Oldham and several others in development across the UK and Italy, contributing to grid reliability and flexibility.

Fifth Dimension AI is a London-based technology company founded in 2023, focusing on generative AI solutions for the real estate industry. The company aims to enhance productivity by automating repetitive tasks such as data analysis, document review, and content creation. Its headquarters is located at Huckletree, 213 Oxford Street, London.

The core product, Ellie, is a generative AI assistant designed specifically for real estate professionals. Ellie automates high-volume tasks, including reading and analyzing complex documents, extracting insights with high accuracy, and generating content in the user's brand tone. The platform features tailored AI toolkits, integration with various systems, and over 50 AI models to support real estate operations. Fifth Dimension AI emphasizes collaboration between humans and AI, ensuring that professionals are empowered rather than replaced. The company has experienced significant growth, with notable clients like Grainger, Canary Wharf Group, Allsop, and Hamptons adopting Ellie into their operations.

Figma is a public American software company founded in 2012, specializing in a cloud-based collaborative design platform. Headquartered in San Francisco, Figma enables real-time creation, prototyping, and iteration of user interfaces directly in web browsers. The platform supports vector graphics, multiplayer collaboration, and developer handoff, making it a comprehensive tool for designers and developers alike.

Figma's journey began with the founders' vision to simplify creative tools for web use. It launched its public version in 2016 and quickly gained popularity due to its innovative features and freemium model. The company has made significant strides in the design space, including the introduction of Figma Community for sharing files and the acquisition of AI startup Weavy to enhance its offerings with advanced editing capabilities. With approximately 2,425 employees, Figma continues to lead in the digital product design market, serving a diverse range of global teams and organizations.

companies.description:
Figment is an independent provider of staking infrastructure for blockchain networks, focusing on Proof-of-Stake (PoS) protocols. The company helps institutional clients earn rewards on digital assets while securing networks. With a global network of PoS validators, Figment supports staking across over 40 protocols, including Ethereum and Solana, managing $17 billion in assets under stake.

Headquartered in Ontario, Canada, Figment operates as a remote-first company with a presence in 23 countries and employs between 201-500 people. The company aims to advance the digital asset ecosystem by offering secure, audited services with slashing protection and industry-leading service level agreements. Figment provides a comprehensive staking solution for institutions, including non-custodial staking infrastructure, a DataHub platform for developers, and tailored staking strategies. It serves over 1000 institutional clients, including asset managers, exchanges, wallets, and foundations, emphasizing risk reduction and optimized rewards.

companies.description:
Fimple is a financial technology company based in London, UK, founded in January 2022. It specializes in a cloud-native, composable core banking platform designed for banks, non-bank financial institutions, fintechs, and other organizations. Fimple's platform is built on a SaaS model and utilizes API-first architecture with cloud-native microservices, allowing for the efficient creation, management, and deployment of banking products and services.

The company's core offerings include a comprehensive core banking platform that supports account management, loans, deposits, payments, compliance, and customer onboarding. Fimple also provides lending solutions, Banking as a Service (BaaS), embedded finance, and tailored solutions for retail and corporate banking. Its focus on customer-centric architecture and flexible deployment options enables institutions to innovate cost-effectively and respond quickly to market demands. Fimple is trusted by over 20 financial institutions worldwide, highlighting its commitment to simplifying financial services.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Urb-it AB is a logistics company based in Europe, specializing in sustainable delivery services. Founded in 2014, Urb-it has been active in last-mile operations since 2017, utilizing a fleet of foot, bike, and e-cargo vehicles to provide environmentally friendly transportation solutions. In January 2024, Urb-it was acquired by Fin, a London-based sustainable logistics operator, which has integrated Urb-it's services into its own operations.

Urb-it has formed partnerships with several major e-commerce companies, including Cainiao, AliExpress, The Hut Group, Zara, MetaPack, and Shein. These collaborations enhance Fin's access to a diverse client base and support its growth strategy in the logistics sector. With a focus on AI-powered route optimization and logistics management, the combined company aims to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction in delivery services.

companies.description:
Financial House is a UK-based fintech company that specializes in payment solutions, card issuing, and financial infrastructure. Established in November 2016, the company is headquartered in London and operates as FINANCIAL HOUSE LIMITED. It focuses on creating efficient fintech systems with multi-currency capabilities that comply with global security standards.

As a principal member of Visa, Mastercard, and UnionPay International, Financial House offers a range of services through a single API. These include branded card issuing, secure payment processing, global payouts in local currencies, and transaction monitoring. The company also provides compliance and security services to help navigate UK regulations, along with dedicated support for finance and underwriting needs. With a team of approximately 409 employees, Financial House serves clients across over 90 countries and territories.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
The Financial Times (FT) is a prominent global business and financial newspaper, established in 1888. Known for its independent and accurate reporting, the FT covers international finance, markets, companies, and globalization. It is printed on distinctive pink paper and published daily in various editions worldwide, offering both print and digital formats.

The FT began as the *London Financial Guide* and rebranded shortly after its inception. Over the years, it has expanded its global reach, launching international editions and establishing a network of correspondents. The newspaper features a daily publication with sections dedicated to international news and market analysis. It also offers digital platforms, including a website and mobile apps, providing real-time news and multimedia content. Additionally, the FT produces specialized content such as the luxury magazine *How to Spend It* and the *Lex* column for financial commentary. The FT is recognized for its commitment to reliability and integrity, serving a diverse audience of business leaders and professionals around the world.

companies.description:
FINBOURNE Technology is a London-based FinTech company founded in 2016. It offers a cloud-native SaaS platform designed for enterprise data management, which unifies real-time financial data across public and private assets. This platform enhances investment operations, reduces costs, and supports AI-driven workflows for various financial institutions, including asset managers, banks, and capital markets firms.

The company's flagship platform, LUSID, serves as an operational data store and portfolio management system, facilitating front-to-back workflows such as compliance and fund accounting. Key features include the Enterprise Data Management (EDM+) solution for real-time data handling and Luminesce, which provides a data virtualization layer. FINBOURNE emphasizes modular, API-led services that support data unification, audit-ready analytics, and customizable workflows, all aimed at improving operational efficiency and transparency. With over 200 team members and a global presence, FINBOURNE is committed to modernizing data infrastructure in the investment management sector.

Finimize is a London-based financial media and education company founded in 2016 by Max Rofagha and Scott Tindle. The company aims to democratize financial information by providing jargon-free content tailored for modern investors, particularly millennials. With a community of over 1 million members, Finimize offers a daily newsletter that delivers a concise, 3-minute digest of global finance news.

The company also features a mobile app that serves as a community-driven platform for financial insights, analysis, and investment education. In addition to its core offerings, Finimize hosts events like the Modern Investor Summit, featuring industry leaders. The Finimize for Business service helps financial firms engage with modern investors through customized content and communication strategies. Finimize has partnered with over 300 brands, including notable firms like BlackRock and CFA, showcasing its commitment to enhancing client engagement in the financial sector.

companies.description:
Finova is a UK-based technology provider that specializes in modular, SaaS-based, cloud-native software solutions for the mortgage, lending, and savings sectors. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in London, the company employs around 350 people and generates approximately $73.5 million in revenue. Finova's technology helps banks, building societies, specialist lenders, equity release providers, and brokers streamline operations and automate processes.

The company offers a flexible, API-driven platform that simplifies lending and savings operations, enabling clients to manage significant loan originations and assets. Finova's suite includes solutions for origination, servicing, decisioning, and broker tools, all from a single adaptable platform. Key offerings include its flagship MSO platform for mortgages, a whole-market solution for various lending products, and tools for savings accounts. Finova aims to be a leading partner in the UK lending and savings market, focusing on efficiency and growth for its clients.

companies.description:
Finster AI is an AI-native platform based in London, founded in 2023 by Sid Jayakumar, a former Google DeepMind researcher. The company specializes in creating purpose-built AI tools for investment research, analysis, and workflows in the financial sector. It primarily serves investment banks, asset managers, and institutional investors, addressing challenges such as data overload and accuracy demands.

The core offering, the Finster AI Platform, is currently in beta and enhances investment research through automated workflows and AI agents that synthesize financial data. Key features include research enhancement, workflow automation, and thesis refinement, all designed to save time and improve decision-making. The platform is built on a robust technical foundation, ensuring security and compliance for complex financial decisions. Finster AI has secured funding to expand its operations and form strategic partnerships, further solidifying its presence in the financial industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Fintech Farm is a London-based fintech startup that focuses on creating and operating digital banks, or neobanks, primarily in emerging markets. Founded on March 19, 2021, by Dmytro Dubilet, Nick Bezkrovnyy, and Alexander Vityaz, the company leverages their extensive experience in the fintech sector to drive innovation in digital banking.

The company offers a range of services to assist traditional banks in establishing neobanks. This includes mobile app development, a complete technology stack for digital banking operations, advanced credit engines, and data-driven strategies for customer acquisition and retention. Fintech Farm has successfully launched neobanks in several countries, including Azerbaijan, Vietnam, India, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan, providing essential financial services to underserved populations. Their mission is to enhance financial inclusion and promote digital banking adoption in these markets.

companies.description:
FintechOS is a London-based fintech company that offers an AI-driven, no-code/low-code product engine platform. This platform enables banks, insurers, and financial institutions to innovate and manage financial products efficiently without the need to replace existing core systems. By simplifying the complexity of financial technology, FintechOS accelerates product development, allowing institutions to launch services in weeks rather than months or years.

The platform features composable business layers for comprehensive integration across various financial operations, including policy administration, customer records, claims processing, and billing. It includes over 30 pre-built templates for banking and insurance, as well as tools for personalized product design and customer journeys. FintechOS supports a range of financial services, including lending, savings, insurance, and embedded finance, enhancing customer experiences and operational efficiency. Additionally, the company provides customer success management, professional services, and online enablement to support its clients in achieving their digital transformation goals.

companies.description: Fira Landscape Ltd is a landscape architecture and urban design company based in Birmingham, UK, with an additional office in London. With over 40 years of experience, the company focuses on creating sustainable environments that connect people with nature and enhance health and wellbeing. Their design approach highlights the positive effects of the environment on individuals, aiming to develop beautiful and practical spaces through collaboration with clients and design teams.The company offers a wide range of services, including landscape design, urban design, masterplanning, and sustainability design. They also provide ecological and tree surveying, garden design, decorative paving, turfing, decking, and tree surgery. Fira Landscape Ltd has worked on various projects across the UK and internationally, earning over 60 design awards for their commitment to excellence and environmental impact. Their clients include both public and private sector organizations seeking innovative landscape solutions that support green infrastructure and promote healing environments.

Firmament is a financial services firm that specializes in providing tailored debt and equity capital solutions for lower-middle market businesses and small- to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). With over a decade of experience and offices across the United States, Firmament focuses on sectors such as Technology, Healthcare, and Environment. The firm collaborates closely with entrepreneurs and management teams to support growth through mergers, acquisitions, recapitalizations, and financings, emphasizing trust and sustainable strategies.

The firm employs versatile growth capital strategies, including private equity and private credit. Their private equity strategy offers control equity, minority equity, and growth debt for companies with scaling potential. The private credit strategy provides customized debt financing options for various market participants, including private equity firms and entrepreneur-backed businesses. Firmament is known for its deep sector knowledge and efficient execution, addressing complex funding needs effectively.

companies.description:
First Light Fusion is a UK-based research company focused on developing clean and scalable fusion energy through innovative projectile fusion technology. Founded in 2011 as a spin-off from the University of Oxford, the company has made significant strides in inertial confinement fusion (ICF) and has raised over $106 million in funding. Under the leadership of CEO Mark Thomas, First Light Fusion is working to commercialize its proprietary amplifier technology, which enhances the efficiency of fusion processes.

The company specializes in projectile fusion, which accelerates metal projectiles to achieve high pressures and speeds necessary for fusion. Their FLARE machine aims to create commercially viable inertial fusion reactors, leveraging existing technologies for faster deployment and reduced costs. First Light Fusion also offers research and development services for fusion power plants, focusing on technology licensing and partnerships to integrate their systems into current energy infrastructures, promoting zero-carbon and waste-free energy solutions.

companies.description:
Fisher Investments is an independent money management firm founded in 1979 by Ken Fisher. The firm specializes in discretionary asset management for high-net-worth individuals, families, institutions, and small business retirement plans worldwide. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, with a primary campus in Camas, Washington, Fisher Investments operates 15-16 offices across 16 countries and employs over 6,300 people. As of September 30, 2025, the firm manages more than $362 billion in assets for over 190,000 clients.

The company is structured into three main units: the Fisher Investments Private Client Group (US), which focuses on U.S. high-net-worth clients; the Private Client Group International, serving clients outside the U.S.; and the Fisher Investments Institutional Group, which provides asset management for institutions like pension funds and endowments. Fisher Investments emphasizes a top-down, flexible approach to portfolio management, utilizing macroeconomic analysis and behavioral finance research to guide investment strategies.

companies.description:
Fitch Group, Inc. is a global financial services organization known for its leadership in credit ratings, research, and risk analysis. Founded in 1913 in New York City, it has grown to become one of the "Big Three" credit rating agencies, alongside Moody’s and Standard & Poor’s. The company operates from dual headquarters in New York and London, with a presence in over 38 offices worldwide.

Fitch provides a range of services, including forward-looking credit ratings for corporations, governments, and financial instruments, as well as in-depth research and commentary on market trends and economic forecasts. The company also offers risk solutions, including analytics and advisory services, and is recognized for its transparency in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings. Fitch serves a diverse clientele, including investors, investment banks, debt issuers, and corporations across various industries, helping them assess credit risk and comply with regulatory requirements. With a workforce of over 2,000 employees, Fitch combines local expertise with a global network to deliver valuable insights.

Flagship Pioneering is a venture capital firm and company incubator based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2000 by Noubar Afeyan. The firm focuses on inventing, building, and funding first-in-category bioplatform companies in biotechnology, life sciences, health, and sustainability. With a mission to drive innovation through scientific creativity, Flagship has launched over 140 companies and manages substantial capital, including a recent $3.4 billion fund.

The firm operates through a unique model that combines pioneering ideas with systematic entrepreneurship. It emphasizes hypothesis-driven innovation and builds enduring value through patentable platforms. Flagship invests in various sectors, including therapeutics, health technologies, and clean tech, often collaborating on initiatives like Pioneering Medicines with Pfizer. Notable successes include companies like Moderna and Sana Biotechnology, which have made significant impacts in their fields. Flagship Pioneering is committed to harnessing technology for a healthier and more sustainable future.

companies.description:
Flagstone is a UK-based cash deposit platform founded in 2013 and headquartered in London. The company helps individuals, businesses, and charities maximize interest earnings on their savings while ensuring financial security through FSCS protection. As of 2024, Flagstone has achieved its second consecutive year of profitability, with revenue growing to £55 million and assets under administration reaching £16 billion.

The platform allows users to manage multiple savings accounts from over 65 UK partner banks through a single application. Key features include multi-bank access, interest optimization, and simplified account management. Flagstone is not a bank or a comparison site; it serves as an intermediary where banks list their accounts for savers. The company generates revenue by receiving a small share of interest from accounts opened through its platform. Flagstone targets UK savers aged 18 and older, as well as businesses and charities, and plans to introduce a Cash ISA and automation features in the coming years.

companies.description:
Flash Pack is a London-based adventure travel company founded in 2014. It specializes in curated group trips for solo travelers aged 30-59, focusing on social connections and unique experiences. The company was co-founded by Radha Vyas and Lee Thompson, who recognized a need for boutique-style tours that cater to professionals seeking meaningful travel experiences.

Flash Pack offers immersive group adventures for up to 16 travelers, featuring premium accommodations and dedicated local guides. The trips are designed to foster friendships among participants, with tailored itineraries that promote social dynamics and connection. The company aims to create one million meaningful friendships globally through travel and has already facilitated around 100,000. Additionally, Flash Pack supports local communities through the Flash Pack Foundation.

companies.description:
Flawless is a London-based technology company that specializes in artificial intelligence solutions for the film and television industry. Founded in 2019 by industry veterans, including director Scott Mann and CEO Nick Lynes, Flawless focuses on enhancing global storytelling through innovative visual and performance editing tools. The company aims to empower creators by overcoming traditional barriers such as language and budget constraints, making filmmaking more affordable and accessible.

Flawless offers several advanced products, including TrueSync, which visually translates foreign language films by synchronizing lip movements and facial expressions with dubbed audio. Their DeepEditor tool assists filmmakers in refining performances and visual elements without costly reshoots. Additionally, Flawless provides AI-assisted performance editing and generative AI tools for automated dialogue replacement and CGI generation. The company primarily serves filmmakers, content owners, and entertainment companies looking to expand their global reach while maintaining quality and authenticity.

Fleek is a B2B online marketplace that connects wholesale suppliers of second-hand and vintage clothing with buyers, including vintage stores, online resellers, and retailers around the world. Founded in November 2021 by Abhi Arora and Sanket Agarwal, the company is based in London, UK, with operations in Bengaluru, India, and a team of about 100 people.

The platform addresses challenges in the second-hand clothing supply chain by offering a transparent digital marketplace. It has facilitated transactions for over 10,000 resellers and retailers from 70 countries, moving 2.5 million items sourced from 1,000 wholesale suppliers. Key features include transparent grading, secure payments, logistics support, and advanced tools for trend forecasting and sourcing. Fleek is committed to sustainability, supporting the growing second-hand apparel market, which is projected to reach $350 billion by 2028.

companies.description:
Fleetcraft is a software company based in London that specializes in AI-powered tools for aircraft maintenance. Its solutions help teams reduce turnaround time (TAT) by streamlining data from maintenance and compliance records, allowing them to focus on repairs instead of paperwork. The company primarily serves Continuing Airworthiness Management Organizations (CAMO), Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) providers, repair stations, and operators.

Fleetcraft offers specialized software products, including Sonic and Trace, which enhance maintenance operations by enabling rapid technical reviews and automating data extraction for faster inspections and compliance. The TRACE tool supports detailed operational checks by efficiently pulling relevant task data. These AI systems aim to accelerate aircraft maintenance and certification processes while lowering costs. Fleetcraft is backed by investors such as Susa Ventures, Liquid 2, Entrepreneurs First, and Transpose Platform.

companies.description:
Flexciton is an AI-driven software company based in London, UK, that specializes in autonomous scheduling and planning solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Founded in 2016, the company focuses on enhancing production planning and scheduling to help chipmakers improve efficiency and move towards autonomous factory operations.

The core offering of Flexciton is its autonomous scheduling technology (AST), which optimizes scheduling decisions by capturing fab constraints. This technology allows for real-time optimization, hidden capacity discovery, and cost reduction, all while minimizing the need for manual intervention. Flexciton's solutions, known as Flex Apps, are designed for rapid implementation, typically within 6 to 12 months, and are tailored to each fab's automation level.

Flexciton has successfully partnered with industry leaders such as Seagate Technology, Renesas, and Microchip, working with over 25 fabs globally. The company is led by co-founders Jamie Potter and Dennis Xenos, who bring extensive expertise in optimization and data science. Flexciton has also secured over £22.5 million in funding to support its innovative solutions.

Flexiform Business Furniture is a prominent UK designer, manufacturer, and supplier of office furniture, storage solutions, and seating, boasting over 50 years of experience. The company, incorporated in 1990, operates from its registered office in London and has a manufacturing plant in Bradford, West Yorkshire. With around 119 employees, Flexiform generated a turnover of £22.74 million in the year ending August 2024.

The company specializes in office furniture design and manufacturing, offering a range of products including storage solutions and seating. Flexiform also provides office interior design and installation services. Additionally, it owns Asgard Secure Steel Storage, which manufactures metal storage solutions such as bike sheds and garden sheds. Flexiform is recognized for its industry credentials, holding memberships in professional organizations and maintaining quality certifications.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Flexport is a digital freight forwarder and supply chain platform founded in 2013 by Ryan Petersen. The company aims to streamline global logistics through a cloud-based software solution that connects shippers, carriers, and all parties involved in the supply chain. Flexport addresses inefficiencies in logistics, which often rely on outdated manual processes.

The core offering of Flexport is a single cloud-based dashboard that provides end-to-end visibility and control over global shipments. This includes freight forwarding and booking, real-time tracking and analytics, customs brokerage, and fulfillment services. The platform also offers additional services such as cargo insurance and trade financing. Flexport's unique approach combines software automation with human expertise, enhancing the efficiency of global trade operations.

Flexport serves over 10,000 customers across 112 countries, including major enterprises and early blue-chip clients like Saudi Aramco. The company has rapidly grown to become a significant player in the logistics industry, moving nearly $19 billion in merchandise in 2021 and achieving a revenue peak of $5 billion in 2022.

companies.description:
Flint Bishop is a prominent UK law firm based in Derby, with a history spanning over a century. The firm has evolved from a regional player to a nationally recognized legal services provider, expanding its presence across the UK. In 2024, Flint Bishop transitioned to a private limited company structure and now employs over 400 solicitors and support staff dedicated to providing practical legal advice.

The firm operates multiple offices in key locations, including Leeds, Sheffield, York, and Birmingham. Flint Bishop has a strong focus on various legal areas, including banking and finance, insurance litigation, commercial property, corporate finance, and regulatory compliance. The firm is known for its commitment to delivering high-quality advice with a personal touch, helping a diverse client base that includes government agencies, public sector bodies, publicly listed companies, SMEs, and private individuals. Flock operates as a fully digital insurer and serves B2B customers across various sectors, including finance, transportation, and data analytics.

Flock offers flexible, pay-per-use insurance tailored to actual risk exposure. Its products include pioneering pay-as-you-fly drone insurance and real-time fleet insurance for commercial motor vehicles. The company has experienced significant growth, with revenue increasing 30 times since its Series A funding in 2021. Founded in 2016, the company specializes in rapid-payout flood insurance for businesses, landlords, and residential properties. It operates as a Managing General Agent (MGA) and utilizes proprietary IoT-connected sensors to measure flood depth with millimetre accuracy. This technology allows for immediate claims processing when water levels exceed predefined thresholds, ensuring quick payouts.

The company offers a range of flexible coverage options, including full flood coverage, business interruption coverage, and additional protection beyond standard limits. FloodFlash targets landlords, property owners, businesses, public entities, and corporate clients, particularly those at higher risk of flooding or with flood histories that may be declined by traditional insurers. With operations across the UK and 15 states in the US, FloodFlash is recognized as a Lloyd's coverholder and has participated in the Lloyd's Lab Accelerator programme to enhance its offerings.

Founded in 2016, Flow Engineering operates as a B2B SaaS platform, providing annual subscriptions tailored for high-velocity hardware teams.

Flow integrates with various engineering tools through APIs, allowing for real-time data synchronization and live verification and validation tracking. Key features include collaborative requirements management, automated connections for live updates, continuous design checks, and the generation of regulator-ready reports. The platform is designed to support agile workflows, helping teams build faster, cheaper, and safer while avoiding vendor lock-in. Flow Engineering serves innovative companies, including Rivian, Joby, Astranis, and Radiant Nuclear, focusing on proof-of-concept deployments to demonstrate value before full enterprise rollouts.

The company offers a range of solutions, including market-making, liquidity provision, OTC trading, brokerage, custody, and treasury management. Flowdesk focuses on creating transparent and regulated trading infrastructure for token issuers, exchanges, institutions, and web3 players.

Headquartered in multiple global locations, including Paris and Singapore, Flowdesk provides 24/7 market access and support. The company has developed scalable trading platforms that utilize proprietary execution algorithms and risk management tools, connecting to over 140 centralized and decentralized exchanges. This platform automates client reporting for marketing agencies, significantly reducing traditional reporting time by up to 80%. Fluent connects to various data sources, including Meta, Google Ads, GA4, and TikTok, to provide fresh and accurate data without silos.

The core product offers AI-powered reporting automation that generates polished, client-ready reports quickly. It includes data analysis, narrative explanations, and visuals. Users can customize reports based on their agency's tone and style, and the platform allows for AI-assisted edits and easy export options to Google Slides or interactive links. The platform is built to support the needs of top AI labs, including teams from OpenAI and DeepMind, as well as various government and enterprise clients. The organization initially focused on Counter-Strike and has since expanded to include popular titles like League of Legends, Dota 2, and FIFA.

Fnatic fields professional teams and creators in various esports, providing engaging content and experiences that connect brands with young audiences. The organization is known for its commitment to developing top players and has achieved significant success in high-stakes competitions.
