The company specializes in helping enterprise brands leverage customer referrals and advocacy as a key growth channel, contributing over $2 billion in revenue to more than 500 brands globally. With around 123 employees and an annual revenue of $13.4 million, Mention Me has raised $32 million in funding to enhance its offerings and expand into the US market.

The platform provides several core solutions, including a referral program that utilizes A/B testing and predictive analytics, a micro-influencer tool for customer-generated content, and visual ad creative intelligence to optimize marketing efforts. Mention Me integrates with various marketing technologies and supports referrals in up to 14 languages, making it user-friendly for quick setup. The company aims to make brands "advocacy-first" by utilizing first-party data and AI to drive sustainable growth in a changing digital landscape.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
MerQube is a financial technology company based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2019. It offers a cloud-native SaaS platform designed for creating, calculating, and distributing rules-based financial indices and passive investment strategies. The company aims to provide a technology-driven alternative to traditional index providers, enabling clients to quickly develop and launch complex investment products.

MerQube's core offerings include an index design and calculation platform, API and UI platforms for quantitative investment strategies, and custom strategy development tailored for institutional clients. The company also focuses on retail-oriented indices and specialized indices, including those driven by ESG factors and biodiversity. With approximately 59 employees and reported revenue of $12.4 million, MerQube has raised $27 million in funding, including a significant Series B round led by Intel Capital. The company is committed to regulatory compliance and innovation in the financial software industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team is the official Formula One team of Mercedes-AMG, a subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz. Based in the United Kingdom, the team operates from Technology Centres in Brackley and Brixworth, employing over 1,000 specialists dedicated to designing, developing, and racing high-performance Formula One cars. Since its entry into the FIA Formula One World Championship in 2010, the team has established itself as a dominant force in the sport.

The team's history includes a lineage that traces back to Tyrrell Racing and has evolved through various iterations, including Brawn GP, which won both the Drivers' and Constructors' Championships in 2009. Mercedes-Benz has a rich F1 heritage, with its modern era marked by significant success, including eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021. The team is known for its innovative turbo-hybrid power units and advanced aerodynamics, consistently pushing the boundaries of performance in over 20 global races each season. Key personnel include Team Principal Toto Wolff and Technical Director James Allison, with drivers like George Russell and Andrea Kimi Antonelli representing the team on the track.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mermaid Subsea Services (UK) Limited is a subsidiary of the Mermaid Group, focused on providing subsea solutions for the offshore energy sector, including oil and gas, decommissioning, and offshore wind. Established in February 2020 and based in Westhill, Aberdeenshire, the company operates with a small team and leverages over 40 years of experience from its parent group in subsea engineering and offshore services.

The company offers a variety of subsea engineering services, such as inspection, repair, and maintenance (IRM), subsea installation engineering, and offshore decommissioning. It has achieved significant milestones in the North Sea, including record-breaking projects and well intervention services. Mermaid Subsea Services (UK) utilizes advanced technologies like remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) and autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) to enhance its service delivery. The company emphasizes safety, efficiency, and budget control in all its operations.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mesh-AI is a global data and AI consultancy based in London, UK. The company specializes in building and deploying production-ready data, machine learning, and AI solutions for highly regulated sectors, particularly Financial Services and Energy & Utilities. Founded as a fast-growing consultancy, Mesh-AI combines technical experts with industry specialists to tackle complex business challenges efficiently.

The firm offers a range of services, including data strategy and platform development, AI and ML deployment, and transformation consulting. Mesh-AI focuses on creating data-driven organizations and emphasizes speed, compliance, and production readiness. The company operates under its proprietary Mesh Model, which aligns teams for secure, end-to-end transformations that deliver measurable business outcomes. Mesh-AI partners with AWS and Microsoft to enhance its offerings and ensure tailored, compliant solutions for its clients.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Meta Platforms, Inc., based in Menlo Park, California, is a leading technology company known for its social media and communication platforms. Originally founded in 2004 as TheFacebook, it rebranded to Facebook in 2005 and became Meta in 2021 to highlight its focus on the metaverse and future digital interactions. Meta operates several major platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads, which collectively serve 3.24 billion daily users.

The company generates significant revenue through advertising, accounting for 97.8% of its $189.46 billion annual income. Meta is also advancing in virtual and augmented reality technologies, with innovations like the Orion AR glasses and ongoing developments in AI tools. Its mission is to create technologies that foster human connection beyond traditional screens, helping businesses grow and connect with communities.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Metaview is an AI-native platform that transforms hiring workflows by automating and analyzing recruitment processes. It focuses on helping organizations identify talent more effectively and make data-driven hiring decisions. With over 3 million interviews captured and more than 3,000 customers, Metaview has established itself as a leader in AI-powered recruiting technology.

The platform offers four main products: the AI Notetaker, which captures and structures interview notes; AI Job Posts, which generates job descriptions quickly; AI Answers, an assistant providing context on candidates and roles; and AI Reports, which delivers insights into hiring funnel optimization. Users report significant time savings, regaining up to 20 hours per week on hiring tasks. Metaview prioritizes security and compliance, maintaining SOC II Type II, CCPA, and GDPR compliance, along with robust encryption measures.
companies.policy: Sponsorship can be offered for some roles.

companies.description:
Method is a global design and engineering firm founded in 1999, with its headquarters in San Francisco. The company operates across various business sectors, providing comprehensive services throughout the product life cycle. Method's offerings are organized into three main categories: Digital Strategy & Growth, Experience Design, and Technology & Engineering. They focus on collaborating with clients to solve problems, create effective products, and ensure quality in their development.

With offices in major cities like New York City, Charlotte, Atlanta, Denver, and London, Method employs around 200 people and leverages its parent company GlobalLogic's extensive network across 12 countries. The firm serves clients in multiple industries, including financial services, healthcare, consumer goods, and industrial sectors, aiming to enhance customer experiences and drive operational efficiencies.

In addition to its design and engineering services, Method has a consumer products division that specializes in naturally-derived, biodegradable household cleaners and personal care items. This division is recognized as a leading provider of green cleaning products, emphasizing ethical sourcing and sustainable manufacturing practices.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Meticulous is an automated frontend testing platform based in San Francisco, California, with a registered office in London, England. Founded in 2021 and backed by Y Combinator, the company has around 5 employees. Meticulous specializes in generating and maintaining visual end-to-end tests using AI, eliminating the need for developers to write or manage test code manually.

The platform operates through a three-step process: record, simulate, and test. It records user sessions from applications and replays them against new code versions, quickly delivering results. Key features include AI-generated test suites that cover all code branches and user flows, an augmented Chromium browser for efficient session replay, and automatic network mocking for side-effect-free tests. Meticulous's solution integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines, allowing for continuous testing with minimal setup. The company is dedicated to enhancing the software development process for front-end developers by providing tools that support robust and reliable software creation.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Metomic is a data security platform designed to automatically detect, classify, and protect sensitive data across SaaS applications, cloud environments, and generative AI tools. It helps organizations maintain compliance and productivity without the need for complex setups or agents. The platform provides real-time visibility, risk prioritization, and automated controls, making it particularly beneficial for highly regulated industries.

Key features of Metomic include data discovery, data loss prevention, access controls, and compliance automation. It utilizes machine learning for threat detection and offers a "human firewall" approach, engaging employees in security through real-time notifications. The platform is scalable and integrates seamlessly with applications like Google Workspace, Slack, and Office365. Metomic is available as a SaaS security platform through AWS Marketplace, with professional support options for deployment and integration.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Metris Energy AI is an AI-powered workspace platform tailored for asset managers in the renewable energy sector. It aims to enhance productivity and streamline daily operations by integrating various functionalities into a single solution for managing renewable energy projects, including solar.The platform features a centralized project database and document management system, allowing users to quickly access key information through AI-powered search capabilities. Metris also offers SLA tracking and KPI monitoring, converting static agreements into live performance indicators. Additional services include automated billing for Power Purchase Agreements, smart ticketing for fault detection, and an AI-powered scheduling assistant that facilitates seamless project management. Users can automate workflows and generate reports effortlessly, making project commissioning faster and more efficient.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Metro Bank is an independent UK bank that began operations in 2010 and is headquartered in London. Founded by Vernon Hill and Anthony Thomson, it has emerged as a significant challenger to traditional banks in the UK. The bank focuses on enhancing customer experience and has expanded its branch network across the country.

Metro Bank offers a comprehensive range of financial services for individuals and businesses. Its offerings include various savings and current accounts, personal and business loans, credit cards, foreign currency accounts, and payment solutions. The bank also provides private banking services, online and mobile banking for easy account management, and safe deposit boxes for secure storage. With a diverse customer base, Metro Bank serves individuals, small and medium-sized enterprises, and larger corporate clients, ensuring accessibility through its branches and digital platforms.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mettle Studio Ltd. is a UK-based design and engineering studio founded in 2014. The company specializes in product and business transformation by creating digital and physical products that foster positive organizational change. With a multidisciplinary team of around 15-16 members, Mettle Studio generates approximately $4 million in annual revenue and operates as a private limited company.

The studio focuses on turning innovative ideas into exceptional products through award-winning design and expert technical delivery. They follow a "make-test-learn" approach to navigate uncertainty and complex challenges. Mettle Studio offers end-to-end support in three main areas: design, development, and product leadership. Their services include UI/UX design, web and mobile development, cloud architecture, and digital transformation. The studio has worked on notable projects such as Thyia, Mott MacDonald Carbon Portal, and Phillips Auction House, collaborating with both major global brands and startups.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
MiNA Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company based in London, United Kingdom, focused on developing small activating RNA (RNAa) therapeutics. This innovative technology platform aims to restore or enhance normal cellular functions, addressing a wide range of medical conditions. MiNA's RNAa platform has been clinically validated in over 120 patients, showcasing its potential in therapeutic applications.

The company is advancing a pipeline of new medicines with a focus on cancer, particularly advanced liver cancer, as well as genetic diseases, metabolic diseases, and rare neurodegenerative diseases. MiNA's lead candidate, MTL-CEBPA, is currently undergoing clinical studies in collaboration with the National University Cancer Institute in Singapore.

MiNA Therapeutics collaborates with leading pharmaceutical companies to expand the application of its technology across various therapeutic areas. The company is led by CEO Robert Habib and has strengthened its leadership team with experienced professionals from the biopharmaceutical industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Micro Nav is a specialist developer and supplier of Air Traffic Control (ATC) and Air Battle Management simulators and training systems. Founded in 1988 by two Air Traffic Controllers, the company has over 35 years of experience in ATC simulation technology. Based in Southbourne, Bournemouth, UK, Micro Nav serves a global market with 52 customers across 64 sites in 38 countries, focusing on enhancing air traffic safety and efficiency.

The company's primary product suite, BEST (Beginning to End for Simulation and Training), includes BEST Tower, BEST Radar, and BEST Insights. These systems are designed to be customizable and scalable, catering to both civil and military ATC applications. Micro Nav also provides customer support packages and tailored training programs to ensure effective use of their systems. The company is committed to information security and environmental management, holding ISO certifications and promoting sustainability through tree planting initiatives.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Micrographia Bio is an innovative life sciences company that focuses on enhancing drug discovery through spatial proteomics. This technology maps protein-protein networks within cells, helping to identify therapeutic mechanisms more effectively than traditional methods. The company utilizes a sophisticated imaging platform that combines multiplexed microscopy and AI-driven computer vision to visualize proteins in their spatial context.

Founded with the belief that all diseases deserve a cure, Micrographia Bio aims to improve the success rates of drug development. The team is composed of experts in various fields, including molecular biology, chemistry, and machine learning. The company is headquartered in London and emphasizes data privacy in its operations. Micrographia Bio is dedicated to advancing its internal pipeline of therapeutic candidates while fostering a culture of inclusivity and professional growth.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Microland Limited is an IT infrastructure services and consulting company based in Bengaluru, India. Founded in 1989 by Pradeep Kar, it has grown to employ over 4,500 digital specialists across various global locations, including Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, and North America. The company has evolved from being India's first network integration specialist to the largest specialized IT infrastructure provider in the country, serving enterprises in over 100 countries.

Microland offers a wide range of IT infrastructure services, including network management, cloud solutions, data center services, and cybersecurity. The company focuses on AI-driven platforms, such as Intelligeni AIOps, to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation, Microland has established strategic partnerships with major technology firms and has received recognition for its service delivery and growth in the IT sector.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Midnite is a UK-based online gambling platform founded in 2018 by Nick Wright and Daniel Qu. It specializes in sports betting, with a strong emphasis on esports and traditional sports, as well as casino games and horse racing. The company aims to attract digitally native, younger users by offering a modern app experience that competes with established brands in the industry.

The platform features a sportsbook as its core offering, which has expanded into a comprehensive betting service. Midnite's team includes engineers, quants, designers, and marketers who are passionate about esports, sports, and gaming. The company focuses on seamless onboarding and has partnered with GBG for identity verification, enhancing player pass rates and driving revenue growth. Midnite is currently in a growth phase, working towards becoming a leading gambling brand.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Mike Kogan Consulting is a company specializing in hospitality renovation. This privately held company located in Point Pleasant, NJ, has projects ongoing throughout the United States.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Miller Insurance Services LLP is a prominent independent specialist (re)insurance broker based in London, with a global presence in Lloyd’s, London, and international markets. Established in 1902, the company has grown significantly and now employs over 1,000 people across various locations, including Bermuda, Brussels, Geneva, Ipswich, Japan, Marseille, Paris, and Singapore.

The company offers a wide range of insurance and reinsurance solutions, covering areas such as accident and health, construction, marine, property and casualty, energy, and professional indemnity insurance. Additionally, Miller provides advisory services focused on specialized risk management and analytics support. They cater to intermediaries, direct insureds, and reinsureds, delivering tailored solutions for complex risks across industries like healthcare, energy, and marine. With a revenue of approximately $607.5 million, Miller Insurance continues to leverage its independence and expertise in niche markets.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Milton Advisers is a strategic communications agency in the business of shifting perceptions. We have a relentless focus on our clients' needs. We will find a way to tell your story, tackle your issues and realise your opportunities in these unprecedented and unforgiving times.

Whatever it takes.

We are living through unprecedented times. Political instability, changes to the world order, economic volatility, climate change, conflict and disruptive technologies contribute to a relentless pace of change. 

How individuals, organisations and issues are perceived can change in an instant. There are new pressures, new channels and new audience demands emerging every day.  But there are also new opportunities to not just survive but to thrive. This needs a new approach from a unique strategic communications agency.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mimecast is a British cybersecurity company founded in 2003, specializing in cloud-based email management services for Microsoft Exchange and Office 365. The company focuses on security, archiving, continuity, and optimization to protect organizations from email-borne threats. With a pioneering software-as-a-service (SaaS) model, Mimecast has expanded globally, operating 13 offices across North America, Europe, Africa, Australia, and Singapore.

Mimecast offers a suite of integrated solutions designed primarily for small and medium-sized enterprises. Their services include email security to guard against threats, archiving for compliance and digital memory, and continuity solutions to ensure service availability during outages. The company operates on a subscription model, providing dedicated account managers and training to enhance user experience. With over 10,000 corporate customers, Mimecast is committed to building resilient communities through its initiatives and comprehensive cybersecurity offerings.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mimica is an AI-powered task mining and process intelligence platform based in London, United Kingdom. Founded in 2018, the company automates process discovery by recording employee desktop activities to create detailed process maps. This helps organizations identify inefficiencies and prioritize automation opportunities using technologies like robotic process automation (RPA), generative AI (GenAI), and intelligent document processing (IDP).

Mimica specializes in capturing real-world workflows, translating user interactions into comprehensive diagrams without the need for manual input. This enables rapid process optimization and digital transformation. The platform emphasizes privacy with features like automatic PII anonymization and compliance with GDPR and ISO 27001 standards. Mimica offers a free 14-day proof-of-concept and has experienced significant growth, recently securing $26.2 million in Series B funding to enhance its capabilities in training AI agents for enterprise workflows. The company serves over 30 large enterprises, including Fortune 500 and Fortune 100 companies across various sectors such as healthcare, logistics, and financial services.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mimo is a financial management and payments platform founded in 2023 and based in London, with an additional office in Stockholm. The company has raised £22M in capital and employs over 35 people. Mimo aims to simplify financial operations for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), accountants, and bookkeepers by automating month-end processes and unifying payments.

Mimo offers an integrated suite of financial solutions, including automated month-end processes, a unified payment platform, built-in credit options, multi-currency payouts, and automatic syncing with accounting systems. The platform also features approval workflows and AI agents to enhance collaboration and streamline financial workflows. Mimo provides both free and paid plans, with paid options starting from £25 per month.

The company primarily serves accountants, small and medium-sized businesses, and bookkeepers, helping them manage financial operations more efficiently. Mimo was founded by a team with experience from iZettle and is backed by notable investors.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mind Foundry is a British multinational artificial intelligence company based in Oxford, specializing in AI for high-stakes applications across sectors such as insurance, infrastructure, defense, and government. Founded in 2016 as a spin-out from the University of Oxford, the company focuses on developing ethical and transparent AI solutions that enhance human-AI collaboration.

The company offers a machine learning platform designed to support the design, testing, deployment, and governance of responsible AI. Its technology processes multi-modal sensor data for applications like object detection and classification. Mind Foundry's proprietary software includes AI-enabled solutions for anti-submarine warfare and other industrial applications. The company has raised approximately $44 million in funding and has established partnerships with organizations like Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance to drive innovation in global insurance and other sectors.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Minor Figures is a London-based company founded in 2014, known for its innovative approach to specialty coffee and plant-based beverages. Initially recognized for pioneering ready-to-drink cold brew, the company has become a global leader in barista-style oat milk products. With offices in London, Melbourne, and Los Angeles, Minor Figures employs over 100 people and sells its products in more than 40 countries, experiencing significant sales growth in recent years.

The company offers a variety of plant-based, coffee-focused beverages, including its popular Barista Oat milk, designed specifically for coffee without separation issues. Minor Figures also provides nitrogen-infused ready-to-drink coffees, chais, and mochas. Committed to sustainability, the brand uses traceable ingredients and has expanded local production in key markets. As a certified B Corp, Minor Figures emphasizes transparency and environmental responsibility, aiming to improve the planet while supporting the specialty coffee ecosystem through distribution to roasters and baristas.
companies.policy: The company is not currently offering visa sponsorship.

companies.description:
Minotti London is the UK flagship of Minotti, an esteemed Italian luxury furniture company founded in 1948. Known for its high-end upholstered furniture, Minotti embodies the excellence of "Made in Italy" and has been recognized as a Historic Brand by Italy's Ministry of Economic Development. The company began as a small upholstery workshop and has evolved into a global presence with over 60 flagship stores and more than 300 authorized distributors across 80 countries.

Minotti specializes in luxury contemporary furniture for both indoor and outdoor spaces, catering to residential, hospitality, and professional environments. Their offerings include refined sofas, armchairs, and modular systems, as well as tables, beds, and complementary pieces. The company emphasizes craftsmanship, innovative design, and a blend of traditional and modern styles. Minotti collaborates with renowned designers and operates a global distribution network, showcasing its full range at its flagship store in London.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mintago is a London-based fintech company founded in 2019 that offers a comprehensive financial wellbeing platform for employers. The platform enhances employee benefits, financial education, and retention through various tools, including salary sacrifice schemes and pension management. Mintago aims to provide unbiased financial support, helping organizations attract and retain talent.

The company provides several key services, such as salary sacrifice schemes for pensions and childcare, tools for managing lost pensions, and resources for financial education and planning. Additionally, Mintago offers a comprehensive benefits package and health and wellbeing services, including an Employee Assistance Programme and Virtual GP services. The platform is designed to be user-friendly, with high adoption rates reported by clients. Mintago is certified with ISO 27001 and registered with the Financial Conduct Authority, ensuring compliance and security in its operations.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mintel is a global market intelligence and research firm based in London, UK, with over 50 years of experience. Founded in 1972, it specializes in providing in-depth consumer, product, and market insights to help businesses understand trends and consumer behavior. With offices in major cities worldwide, Mintel employs more than 1,200 people and serves a diverse range of clients, including global brands and retailers.

The company offers a variety of services, including market research reports, a Global New Products Database, and specialized tools like Mintel Comperemedia and Mintel Inspire. Its research methodologies involve tracking around 40,000 product launches monthly and conducting consumer surveys with over 1 million participants across four continents. Mintel's mission is to empower clients with actionable intelligence, enabling them to innovate and make informed strategic decisions in their markets.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Minviro is a sustainability consultancy and life cycle assessment (LCA) software company based in London, England. Founded in 2019, it focuses on providing science-driven solutions to help businesses measure and reduce their environmental impact across various value chains, particularly in the energy transition.

The company offers three main services: consultancy services, a next-generation LCA software platform called XYCLE, and customized data services. Its consultancy team, composed of engineers and scientists, delivers ISO-compliant solutions and precise Life Cycle Assessments. The XYCLE software enhances collaboration and data transparency, streamlining the LCA process. Additionally, Minviro provides high-quality supply chain data, having mapped 75% of global battery material supply chains.

Minviro serves multiple industries, including mining, materials, photovoltaics, and electric vehicles, and has worked with notable clients such as Tesla, Rio Tinto, and ExxonMobil. The company has achieved significant growth, raising over £3M and completing 245 commercial projects.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mirakl is a global software company founded in 2012, with headquarters in Paris and Boston. The company specializes in SaaS platforms that enable businesses to launch and manage online marketplaces for B2B, B2C, and retail media applications. Mirakl's innovative solutions support over 300 organizations worldwide and facilitate more than $6 billion in annual transactions.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of marketplace orchestration tools, including a core marketplace platform for catalog and order management, Mirakl Connect for seller and partner ecosystems, and Mirakl Payout for financial services. Their retail media solutions enhance advertising capabilities on e-commerce sites, while personalization and curation tools improve customer experiences. Mirakl Nexus, set to launch in 2025, will further enhance their offerings in agentic commerce.

Mirakl serves notable clients such as Carrefour, H&M, and Decathlon, and partners with firms like Havas to drive digital transformation across various sectors. The company emphasizes innovation in dropshipping, cloud-based operations, and community ecosystems to help brands compete effectively in the marketplace.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mirion Technologies, Inc. is a global leader in radiation safety, science, and medicine. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the company provides a wide range of radiation detection, measurement, analysis, and monitoring products and services. With approximately 2,800 employees, Mirion operates in 12 countries across North America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific.

The company has two primary business segments. The Medical Segment focuses on enhancing quality and safety in cancer care, offering solutions for radiation oncology quality assurance, patient safety, and radionuclide therapy. The Nuclear & Safety Segment provides critical radiation safety and measurement solutions, including personal detection equipment, reactor instrumentation, and laboratory analysis systems. Mirion serves a diverse customer base, including hospitals, military organizations, government agencies, and nuclear power plants. The company became publicly traded in 2021, further solidifying its position in key markets such as healthcare and defense.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Miro is an AI-powered visual workspace designed for innovation, enabling distributed teams to collaborate effectively on product development, strategy, and design. Founded in 2011 by Andrey Khusid, Miro has grown to serve over 100 million users across 250,000 organizations. Headquartered in San Francisco, the platform offers a digital alternative to traditional whiteboarding and in-person collaboration.

The core of Miro's platform is its digital whiteboarding and visual collaboration tools, which allow users to create interactive boards for various purposes, including strategy mapping, UX research, and agile ceremonies. Miro also features specialized capabilities for product acceleration, diagramming, prototyping, and workshop facilitation. Its AI capabilities assist with mind mapping, idea generation, and automating workflows, enhancing the collaborative experience. Miro integrates with over 250 tools, streamlining workflows and reducing context-switching. The platform also prioritizes data security with advanced enterprise features. Notable customers include Nike, IKEA, Deloitte, and Cisco.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mirriad Advertising plc is a London-based technology company founded in 2006, specializing in virtual product placement (VPP) and in-content advertising. The company utilizes proprietary AI and computer vision technology to seamlessly insert advertising imagery into existing video content across various platforms, including television, streaming services, and influencer videos. Mirriad operates in multiple regions, including the US, Europe, Asia, and over 11 other countries.

The company's AI-powered platform identifies placement opportunities within video content and enables dynamic ad insertions that enhance viewer engagement without disrupting the narrative. Mirriad offers a fully managed, cloud-based service that allows brands to generate revenue from airtime typically not used for advertising. It also features a diverse supplier marketplace, supporting campaigns that target various demographics. With over 60 premium content partners and 100 global brands, Mirriad has executed thousands of integrations and campaigns, delivering improved brand metrics and viewer engagement.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mission Zero Technologies (MZT) is a UK-based startup founded in 2020 that specializes in developing electrochemical direct air capture (DAC) technology. This innovative technology efficiently recovers CO₂ from the atmosphere using significantly less energy than traditional methods. MZT aims to support net zero ambitions across various industries by enabling affordable CO₂ removal, storage, and utilization in products.

The company offers DAC-as-a-service, which includes carbon sequestration, sustainable building materials, and e-fuels. Their operational systems include the UK's first commercial DAC plant at the University of Sheffield, a demo plant with O.C.O Technology for carbon-negative building materials, and a system in Alberta, Canada, for permanent CO₂ storage. MZT is committed to creating a decentralized gigaton-scale CO₂ supply chain, guided by principles of curiosity and problem-solving. With a growing team and substantial funding, MZT is positioned to make a significant impact in the carbon management sector.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Mistral AI is a French artificial intelligence startup founded in April 2023 by researchers from Google DeepMind and Meta AI. The company focuses on making advanced AI accessible through open-source and efficient solutions. Mistral AI aims to challenge traditional closed models by offering customizable and portable technologies.

The company specializes in high-performance large language models that are lightweight and scalable. Mistral AI also provides Le Chat, an AI chatbot assistant with multilingual and multimodal capabilities. Their enterprise solutions include Mistral Compute, a European-hosted AI cloud platform, and various APIs like Mistral Agents, Mistral Code, and Mistral OCR, which support diverse applications from coding assistance to optical character recognition.

Mistral AI is committed to privacy-first deployment and offers enterprise-grade tools with support from applied AI scientists. The company collaborates with notable partners like Stellantis and ASML to explore AI applications in product development and operations.

Mitratech is a U.S.-based enterprise software company founded in 1987 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company specializes in legal technology, workflow automation, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) solutions for corporate legal, risk, compliance, and human resources professionals worldwide. Mitratech provides a unified platform that enhances transparency, reduces risk exposure, and ensures compliance across various functions.

The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of software solutions, including legal management and automation tools for corporate legal departments, GRC solutions for risk monitoring and regulatory compliance, and human resources compliance tools for immigration onboarding and risk management. Mitratech's innovative approach integrates specialized acquisitions, such as ClusterSeven, to address shadow IT and data privacy risks. With over 7,000 enterprise customers in more than 160 countries, including Fortune 1000 firms and top global financial institutions, Mitratech is recognized for its ability to streamline operations and improve decision-making across industries.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Mitsui & Co., Ltd. is one of Japan's largest general trading companies, established in 1876 and reformed in 1947. With a global network of 124 offices across 62 countries, the company employs over 56,000 people. Mitsui's diverse business activities include product sales, logistics, financing, and the development of major international infrastructure projects.The company operates in various sectors such as mineral and metal resources, energy, infrastructure, mobility, chemicals, food and retail management, wellness, and IT. Mitsui facilitates global trade, organizes joint ventures, and manages finance and transport, acting as a vital link in international supply chains. In the fiscal year ending March 2023, Mitsui reported consolidated revenues of approximately ¥5.3 trillion and a net income of ¥320 billion. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Mitsui is publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

With a team of 15, Muddy Machines has secured over £2.5 million in funding and more than £3 million in government grants. The company has received accolades such as the gold award for Agri-Tech Innovator of the Year in 2022.

Muddy Machines aims to drive the agriculture industry toward zero emissions with its battery-powered field robots. Their flagship product, Sprout, is an autonomous asparagus harvester that utilizes deep learning and advanced sensors to pick asparagus efficiently. The company also offers Squirrel, a logistics robot designed to transport harvested crops. Both robots are lightweight, electric, and designed with sustainability in mind. Muddy Machines collaborates with growers like Co Brew Farms to test and refine its technology, with plans for further trials in 2025.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
MullenLowe was a marketing communications company based in London, known for its full-service integrated approach. Established in 2015 through the merger of Lowe & Partners and Mullen Advertising, the agency offered a range of services including integrated marketing communications, brand strategy, digital marketing, media planning, and behavior-driven activation.

At its height, MullenLowe operated 90 offices across 65 markets and employed around 6,400 people. The agency focused on innovation and adaptability in its marketing strategies, utilizing various media channels. By 2024, the UK entity had 33 employees and reported a turnover of £18.48 million. MullenLowe Global was dissolved on December 1, 2025, with its legacy preserved in digital archives by the History of Advertising Trust.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Multiomic Health is an AI-enabled drug discovery company based in London, England, focused on precision medicine for conditions related to metabolic syndrome. Founded on March 5, 2021, the company aims to develop innovative treatments for diseases such as type 2 diabetes, chronic kidney disease, atherosclerosis, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.

The company employs a unique approach that combines deep patient datasets, AI-driven data science, and experimental biology to identify molecular-level disease drivers in specific patient subpopulations. Their MOHSAIC platform integrates multiomics analysis with computational systems biology and laboratory experiments to create novel therapeutic concepts. Multiomic Health collaborates with research institutions, healthcare providers, and health tech companies to access de-identified patient data and samples, advancing its drug discovery pipeline and companion diagnostics.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Multiplier is a global employment platform that simplifies the hiring, onboarding, management, and payment of talent across over 150 countries. Acting as an Employer of Record (EOR), it ensures compliance with local laws while handling payroll, benefits, taxes, and HR operations for international teams. Founded with a focus on international payroll and HR compliance, Multiplier has established legal entities in more than 25 countries and operates a remote team of 500 across four continents.

The company offers a range of services, including global payroll, contractor management, and immigration support. Its self-service dashboard provides tools for managing the entire HR lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, in over 120 currencies. Multiplier emphasizes transparency with competitive pricing and aims to reduce manual workflows, making it easier for businesses to scale globally. With a commitment to security and dedicated support from legal and tax experts, Multiplier positions itself as a comprehensive solution for companies looking to expand their workforce internationally.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Multiverse is an upskilling platform founded in 2016 by Euan Blair, focused on personalized apprenticeships and training programs in AI, data, and technology. Headquartered in London, the company operates in the UK and US, having trained over 22,000 learners and partnered with more than 1,500 employers, including Microsoft, Mars, and Citi. In 2022, Multiverse achieved unicorn status with a valuation of $1.7 billion following a $220 million Series D funding round.

The company’s mission is to prepare workforces for the AI era by combining AI-powered platforms with expert coaching. Multiverse identifies skills gaps and creates tailored learning paths through its MAGE framework, ensuring that training translates into measurable business impact. Its offerings include professional apprenticeships, coaching, and online learning, with key programs designed for various roles, such as Business Analysts and Operations Managers. Multiverse generates revenue primarily from employer fees, addressing skill shortages and enhancing career mobility through real-world, paid apprenticeships.
companies.policy: Sponsorship is usually reserved for Director-level or "business-critical" roles, but what the latter means is unclear (we've seen sponsored Product Manager roles in the past).

companies.description:
Multus Bio is a biotechnology startup based in London, specializing in the design of cell culture media. Founded in 2020 by a team of scientists and engineers from Imperial College London, the company utilizes artificial intelligence, robotics, and biological expertise to enhance biomanufacturing processes. Multus is located at Imperial College's White City Innovation Campus and has raised $2.3 million in funding, employing around 19 people.

The company offers a range of services, including off-the-shelf media products, custom media development through its MediOP™ platform, and the production of serum-free alternatives to fetal bovine serum. Multus primarily serves the cultivated meat industry, providing essential growth media for companies producing cell-based meat products. The company is also expanding into medical life sciences. Multus aims to support the sustainable protein transition by making cultivated meat production more accessible and environmentally friendly.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
MyEdSpace Limited is a UK-based educational technology company founded in 2022 by Kharis Yanakidis and Sean Hirons. The company provides affordable, high-quality online learning for students aged 9-18, primarily in the UK, with plans to expand into the US. MyEdSpace aims to transform education by combining top teachers with advanced technology and engaging methods to support students' learning.

The company offers live online lessons twice a week, led by highly qualified teachers, covering the national curricula for KS2, KS3, GCSE, and A-Level students. Core subjects include Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and English. MyEdSpace provides engaging group lessons, homework materials, and a Pro package with personal mentors. Since its launch, the company has supported over 16,000 students, achieving impressive results, such as a significant percentage of GCSE Maths students scoring high grades. In 2025, MyEdSpace raised $15M in Series A funding to enhance its offerings and develop new courses, including a US-focused Mathematics course.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
MyTutor.co.uk is an online tutoring platform based in London, England, founded in 2012. The company connects students with tutors from top UK universities, aiming to make high-quality tutoring accessible and affordable for families. 

The platform offers one-to-one online tutoring sessions across various subjects, conducted in a flexible online learning space. Each session is recorded, allowing students to revisit material as needed. MyTutor.co.uk tailors lessons to individual learning styles and schedules, ensuring a personalized experience for every student. 

With a mission to support students from diverse backgrounds, MyTutor.co.uk has delivered over a quarter of a million lessons, helping students improve their grades significantly. The company has raised $37.48 million in funding and employs a skilled team to enhance its educational services.
companies.policy: All roles can be sponsored.

companies.description:
Mytos is a biotech company that specializes in automated cell culture and manufacturing systems, focusing on its iDEM™ platform. This technology is designed to enhance the production of regenerative medicine for pharmaceutical and biotech firms. Founded by a team of scientists, engineers, and clinical manufacturing experts, Mytos addresses challenges in cell production, such as the cultivation of stem cell-derived tissues, to improve access to therapies for conditions like Parkinson's disease and spinal cord injuries.

The company operates as an Automated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) for regenerative medicine, providing end-to-end production services. Mytos offers fully automated machines that streamline the culturing and harvesting of human cells, significantly reducing errors and contamination while enabling remote control and high-throughput scalability. With a commitment to continuous improvement and customer satisfaction, Mytos aims to modernize the cell culture process, making it more efficient and cost-effective for its clients, which include large pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
companies.policy: The company does not offer sponsorship for any of its junior roles. They are open to offering visa support for other roles.

companies.description:
NB Studio is a London-based branding and communication studio founded in 1997. The agency specializes in creating simple, sustainable brands for growth across both digital and traditional channels. Led by Creative Directors Nick Finney and Alan Dye, NB Studio employs around 72-75 people and generates approximately $6 million in annual revenue.

The studio focuses on branding, packaging, visual identity, and marketing communications. They emphasize sustainable branding and brand strategy, using creative direction and design thinking to deliver bold solutions. Notable projects include the rebranding of Streamtime, the mirrored identity for Almeida Theatre, and a flexible logo system for Ravensbourne media school. NB Studio serves a diverse range of clients across public, private, and third sectors, including arts, retail, and property.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NET-A-PORTER is a luxury fashion online retailer founded in 2000 by Natalie Massenet in London. The company offers a curated selection of high-end women's fashion, accessories, beauty products, fine watches, jewelry, and home décor from over 800 designer brands. With global shipping to more than 170 countries, NET-A-PORTER has established itself as a leader in luxury e-commerce.

The company emphasizes exceptional customer experience, featuring luxury packaging, concierge services, and dedicated Personal Shoppers for its Extremely Important People (EIPs). NET-A-PORTER also provides editorial content through its online magazine, PORTER, and has expanded its offerings with specialized sites like The Outnet for discounted designs and Mr Porter for menswear. Committed to sustainability, it features NET SUSTAIN, a collection of ethically crafted luxury items. Headquartered in London, NET-A-PORTER supports localized assortments and international fulfillment, attracting six million unique monthly visitors to its flagship site.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NFU Mutual, officially known as the National Farmers Union Mutual Insurance Society Limited, is a mutual insurance company based in the UK. Founded in 1910 by seven farmers, it aims to provide cost-price insurance to support the National Farmers' Union. Owned by its policyholders, NFU Mutual prioritizes long-term member interests and has become one of the UK's largest insurers, holding a significant share of the farm insurance market.

Headquartered in Stratford upon Avon, NFU Mutual operates through over 300 rural branches and offers a range of insurance products, including home, motor, farming, and business insurance. The company also provides financial planning services, such as investments and pensions. With a strong focus on customer service and community support, NFU Mutual has invested in initiatives to combat rural crime and adapt to changes in the farming sector. It serves a diverse clientele, including farmers, rural communities, and businesses across the UK.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: The National Health Service (NHS) is the collective term for the publicly funded healthcare systems of the United Kingdom: the National Health Service (England), NHS Scotland, NHS Wales, and Health and Social Care (Northern Ireland) which was created separately and is often referred to locally as "the NHS". The original three systems were established in 1948 (NHS Wales/GIG Cymru was founded in 1969) as part of major social reforms following the Second World War, and officially launched at Park Hospital in Davyhulme, near Manchester, England (now known as Trafford General Hospital). The founding principles were that services should be comprehensive, universal and free at the point of delivery. Each service provides a comprehensive range of health services, provided without charge for residents of the United Kingdom apart from dental treatment and optical care. In England, NHS patients have to pay prescription charges; some, such as those aged over 60, or those on certain state benefits, are exempt. Taken together, the four services in 2015–16 employed around 1.6 million people with a combined budget of £136.7 billion. In 2024, the total health sector workforce across the United Kingdom was 1,499,368.
companies.policy: Many roles can be sponsored.

companies.description:
NICE is an American technology company founded in 1986, specializing in AI-powered software solutions for customer experience, contact center operations, financial crime prevention, compliance, and public safety. Headquartered in the United States, NICE employs over 10,000 people and operates in more than 150 countries, supporting over 25,000 organizations, including 85 of the Fortune 100.

The company offers cloud-native, AI-first platforms, with its flagship product being CXone, a Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform that supports over one million users and integrates with more than 170 applications. NICE's solutions include AI Hyper Platforms for customer engagement and compliance, specialized tools for risk management and fraud detection, and features for workforce optimization and analytics. NICE emphasizes innovation, corporate responsibility, and community involvement, making it a trusted partner for large organizations across various industries.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NLPatent is an AI-powered platform designed for patent research and intelligence, catering to IP professionals, R&D teams, and legal experts. Founded by IP attorney Stephanie and engineer James, the platform utilizes advanced AI techniques, including natural language processing and machine learning, to enhance patent searches and analysis. It enables users to conduct searches 5-10 times faster than traditional methods, addressing inefficiencies in outdated tools.

The core offerings of NLPatent include modules for searching and analyzing patents, monitoring technologies and competitors, and visualizing portfolio insights. Users can perform assessments for patentability, invalidity, and infringement risks, among other tasks. The platform features customizable alerts, detailed reporting, and real-time AI analysis, ensuring users can refine their searches effectively. NLPatent is trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Am Law 100 firms, and research universities, with users highlighting its speed and precision in various patent workflows.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NTS Radio is a global online radio platform and music discovery service that broadcasts diverse music 24/7 from over 50 cities worldwide. Founded in 2011 by Femi Adeyemi and Sean McAuliffe, NTS aims to provide an alternative to mainstream radio by showcasing underground music, art, and fashion. The platform has evolved from a local community station in London to a global community radio service, featuring over 130 shows and custom-built streaming infrastructure.

NTS offers live radio broadcasting with narrative-driven programming that highlights a wide range of genres, including jazz, rap, and j-pop. It also provides a music discovery archive that celebrates global sounds, free from traditional radio constraints. In addition to its online presence, NTS hosts international live events and creates original video content to engage listeners. The platform emphasizes high-quality access and consistency across its offerings, ensuring a unique listening experience.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NTT DATA Europe & Latam is part of the NTT DATA Group, a leading global IT services and consulting company based in Japan. The group operates in 33 countries and focuses on digital transformation, IT modernization, and business process services. The Europe & Latam division aligns with the group's global strategy, providing localized solutions while emphasizing cross-regional collaboration.

The company offers a range of services, including consulting for business strategy and digital transformation, IT modernization such as cloud migration and cybersecurity, and managed services for infrastructure and applications. NTT DATA also provides tailored industry solutions for sectors like finance, healthcare, and manufacturing, along with technology-driven sustainability services aimed at achieving net-zero goals. With a strong commitment to client partnerships, NTT DATA serves a significant portion of Fortune Global 100 companies, particularly in regulated industries like banking and telecommunications.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NVIDIA Corporation is a leading American technology company based in Santa Clara, California, founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem. Initially focused on developing graphics processing units (GPUs) for gaming and multimedia, NVIDIA revolutionized the industry with the launch of the GeForce 256 in 1999, which introduced parallel processing for graphics acceleration. The company has since expanded into accelerated computing, artificial intelligence (AI), and high-performance computing, achieving significant market share in AI training GPUs.

NVIDIA designs a range of products, including GPUs, systems on chips (SoCs), and APIs for various applications. Its GeForce series is well-known in gaming, while Tesla products cater to scientific computing. The company also offers the CUDA platform for parallel computing and the Omniverse platform for virtual collaboration and 3D workflows. NVIDIA's innovations have made it a key player in powering supercomputers and AI models, with partnerships that include major companies like Microsoft, Siemens, and OpenAI.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Nammos is a luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand that began as a small fish tavern on Psarou beach in Mykonos in the mid-1960s. Founded by Kyriakos Angeletakis and his wife Eleni, it has transformed into a renowned global dining and resort destination. The company was officially established as Nammos World SARL in 2003 and is based in Monaco.

Nammos is celebrated for its Mediterranean-inspired cuisine with Asian influences, featuring fresh seafood, premium sushi, and innovative cocktails. The Mykonos location offers a luxury beach club experience, complete with private cabanas, a shisha lounge, and a spa. Additionally, Nammos operates a luxury village with high-fashion boutiques and art galleries. The brand is expanding its hospitality offerings with plans for Nammos Hotel Mykonos and future resorts in the Maldives and Abu Dhabi. With locations in Dubai, Cannes, Limassol, and Qatar, Nammos caters to high-net-worth individuals seeking exclusive culinary and lifestyle experiences.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Nano Fibre UK Limited is a private limited company based in Gilmorton, England, established on May 11, 2016. The company specializes in FTTP (Fibre to the Premises) installations, providing ultrafast fibre broadband directly to homes across the UK. Its mission is to enhance digital connectivity in residential areas by delivering efficient and precise fibre installation services.In addition to FTTP installations, Nano Fibre UK offers engineering and technical consulting services to support its core operations. The company serves residential customers, focusing on last-mile fibre broadband connections and continuously expanding its service coverage. With a commitment to customer satisfaction and operational excellence, Nano Fibre UK aims to connect communities to reliable, high-speed internet.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Nansen is a blockchain analytics platform based in Singapore, founded in 2019. The company enriches on-chain data with a vast database of labeled wallet addresses, providing crypto investors and teams with actionable insights, real-time dashboards, alerts, and AI-powered tools. Nansen supports over 20 blockchain networks, including Ethereum and Solana, and processes petabytes of trading data daily.

The platform features real-time dashboards for tracking market movements, wallet labeling for identifying market participants, and AI tools for predictive modeling and data visualization. Nansen also offers a mobile app that integrates with non-custodial wallets and decentralized exchanges, allowing users to engage in "vibe trading." With a strong focus on exploration and precision, Nansen has served over 1 million users and raised $75 million in funding, generating estimated revenues between $10-50 million.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Napier AI is a London-based RegTech company founded in 2015, specializing in AI-powered anti-money laundering (AML) and financial crime compliance software. The company serves a variety of sectors, including financial institutions, payments, wealth and asset management firms, insurance, and banking.

The flagship product, the Napier AI Continuum platform, utilizes agentic AI, generative AI, and machine learning to enhance AML defenses. It significantly reduces false positives and negatives, enabling explainable decisions while keeping human oversight. The platform streamlines compliance processes, automates workflows, and integrates with third-party data vendors, transforming compliance into a competitive advantage. Napier AI emphasizes technological innovation to combat financial crime and has expanded its reach globally, serving over 100 institutions worldwide.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Napo Pet Insurance is a tech-driven pet insurance company founded in 2021 and based in London. The company aims to transform the pet insurance industry by offering comprehensive coverage that includes essential services as standard. Napo focuses on providing a high-quality customer experience, combining AI-driven efficiency with human empathy to ensure quick and personal claims handling.

Napo offers lifetime insurance coverage that includes dental care, behavioral treatment, and preventive care. Pet owners benefit from free unlimited video vet consultations and behavioral consultations as part of their standard package. The company also provides a 5% discount for insuring multiple pets under one policy. With significant funding to support its growth, Napo is dedicated to enhancing its technology and expanding its market presence while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability and quality care for pets.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Narvar is a post-purchase experience platform founded in 2012 by Amit Sharma. The company specializes in enhancing post-purchase interactions for retailers, brands, and merchants, focusing on areas like order tracking, notifications, returns, exchanges, and customer care. Narvar's AI-driven platform serves over 125 million consumers globally, facilitating 7 billion interactions across 38 countries and 55 languages.

The platform includes features such as delivery promises, timely notifications, order tracking, and fraud prevention. Its proprietary AI tool, IRIS™, processes vast amounts of consumer interaction data to provide predictive intelligence and personalized experiences. Narvar aims to streamline operations and improve customer journeys, helping retailers turn one-time buyers into loyal customers. With a strong presence in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, Narvar is recognized for its impact on customer experience and operational efficiency in the retail sector.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.
Sponsorship can be offered for some roles.
The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Natter is an AI-powered conversation intelligence platform that captures insights from large groups of people simultaneously. It operates in the AI and human resources technology market, enhancing workplace connections and decision-making through an integrated solution that combines surveys, interviews, and focus groups.

The platform's core offering is a conversation intelligence engine that facilitates large-scale engagement, supporting 1 to over 20,000 participants in live or on-demand sessions. Natter enables real-time video conversations, allowing users to share ideas and feedback while its AI analyzes themes, sentiment, and priorities, delivering actionable insights within about an hour. Users benefit from both quantitative data and rich qualitative insights, providing a deeper understanding than traditional survey methods.

Natter serves leaders across various departments, including sales, product teams, and learning & development, helping them make data-driven decisions. The platform is trusted by industry leaders, with positive feedback highlighting its impact on operational excellence.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Natural Innovations is a UK-based food manufacturer that specializes in bespoke, plant-led ingredients and menu solutions for global food brands. Founded in 2002 and rebranded from Freshcut Foods in 2025, the company is headquartered in Beeston, Nottingham. It focuses on transforming natural ingredients into high-quality, ready-to-eat products that prioritize bold flavors, health, and sustainability.

The company develops custom plant-led ingredients, including chargrilled, roasted, and blanched vegetables, as well as carbohydrates and ready-to-eat meals. Natural Innovations emphasizes chef-led menu solutions that cater to foodservice, manufacturing, and recipe box providers. With a commitment to research and development, the company adapts to changing consumer demands, such as the rise of flexitarian diets. In 2023, Natural Innovations reported a turnover exceeding £42.4 million, reflecting its growth and market leadership in bespoke ingredients.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NatureMetrics is a UK-based technology company founded in 2014, specializing in biodiversity surveying and nature impact reporting. As a leader in environmental DNA (eDNA) technology, it serves over 600 organizations in 110 countries. The company focuses on biotechnology research and development, alongside environmental consulting.

NatureMetrics offers a range of services, including biodiversity monitoring using eDNA sampling kits, nature impact reporting, and nature strategy services for extractive industries. In 2023, it launched the Nature Intelligence Platform, which allows users to manage eDNA projects, access automated biodiversity metrics, and visualize data trends. The platform supports a wide variety of taxonomical groups, enhancing the understanding of biodiversity.

With a reported turnover of £4.8 million in 2022 and significant revenue growth, NatureMetrics has attracted $30.7 million in funding since its inception. The company collaborates with notable clients such as Nestle, Unilever, and Tesco, and has contributed to various biomonitoring projects worldwide.
companies.policy: Sponsorship is generally not on offer but it may be considered for future candidates.

companies.description:
NavLive is a spatial AI company based in Oxford, United Kingdom, specializing in AI-powered handheld LiDAR scanning solutions for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industries. Founded in 2022, the company originated from PhD research in robotics and SLAM technology at the University of Oxford and has secured £700K in grant funding from Innovate UK.

The main product offered by NavLive is the NavLive Radius scanner, a lightweight device that integrates LiDAR technology with onboard AI processing. This scanner generates precise 2D and 3D floor plans and captures detailed point cloud data at high speeds. It features intelligent real-time subsampling and on-device AI processing, allowing for instant draft site drawings and direct integration with Building Information Modeling (BIM). Additionally, NavLive provides a cloud-based portal for managing scan data, enabling users to create visual walkthroughs and perform measurements.

NavLive serves various sectors, including construction, nuclear, automotive, and defense, helping professionals like architects and surveyors streamline workflows and enhance site documentation.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Navan, Inc., formerly known as TripActions, is a corporate travel and expense management company based in Palo Alto, California. Founded in May 2015 by Ariel Cohen and Ilan Twig, Navan offers an all-in-one platform that supports travel programs for over 10,000 companies globally. The platform integrates travel booking, expense management, payments, reporting, and analytics to enhance business travel experiences.

Navan provides a comprehensive travel management solution that includes online booking for flights, hotels, and events, along with 24/7 support through its AI agent, Ava. The company emphasizes user-friendly design and offers features like custom policies, real-time insights, and Navan Rewards for budget-compliant bookings. Its expense management services include photo-based receipt submission and rapid reimbursements across multiple currencies. Navan also focuses on analytics, reporting, and employee safety, ensuring a modern and efficient approach to corporate travel.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NearSt is a leading in-store inventory feed platform based in London, UK, founded in 2015. The company connects retailers' live inventory data to online shopping platforms, encouraging online shoppers to visit physical stores. NearSt aims to enhance the competitiveness of independent retailers against major e-commerce players, making local shopping as convenient as online options.

The platform features three main components: Connect, which integrates with various inventory management systems to capture live inventory data; Enhance, which uses AI to create a unified source of stock information; and Distribute, which shares this data with major platforms like Google and Meta. NearSt serves software providers and retailers, helping them improve their retail networks. The company has seen significant success, with notable clients such as Morrisons Daily and Nisa stores, and has expanded its operations into North America.
companies.policy: The company is very unlikely to sponsor but may consider doing so for an exceptional match.

companies.description:
NearForm is an Irish technology company founded in 2011, based in Waterford. The company specializes in digital capability and software solutions, particularly using open-source technologies like Node.js. NearForm has established itself as a significant contributor to the Node.js project and the JavaScript module ecosystem, gaining recognition for its development of privacy-conscious Covid-19 contact-tracing software used globally.

The company offers services in enterprise modernization, digital transformation, customer experience design, and data analytics. NearForm focuses on enhancing operations and decision-making for ambitious enterprises. Its leadership team brings extensive experience in business development, operations, consultancy, and software engineering. NearForm has worked with notable clients, including NBCUniversal and Condé Nast, and has developed projects for well-known publications such as Vogue and The New Yorker.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.
