companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Nemesis SAM Monaco is an independent asset management company established in 2008 and based in Monaco. The firm specializes in asset management, investment advisory, order receipt and transmission, and fund management for both domestic and international clients. It is regulated by the Commission for the Control of Financial Activities (CCAF) in Monaco, ensuring compliance and high standards in its operations.The company focuses on providing personalized services tailored to individual client profiles, emphasizing transparency and innovative management practices. Its core offerings include discretionary management mandates, portfolio management, and various wealth management services. Nemesis SAM also engages in alternative investments, hedge funds, private equity, and financial planning. With a team of experienced professionals, including Managing Partner Roberto Genasci, the firm aims to build strong relationships with high-net-worth clients.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Neptune North Limited is a joint venture formed by Oliver Wyman and Rokos Capital Management, focusing on software development and consulting services for the financial services and alternative investment sectors. Incorporated on June 19, 2024, the company operates from its registered office in Morpeth, England, and has expanded its presence in Newcastle.

The firm offers specialized services including software development, data engineering, DevOps, and AI engineering. These services are designed to optimize business operations, leveraging the expertise of its parent companies. Neptune North aims to create a collaborative work environment, featuring modern design elements and advanced technology integration.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Nervecentre Software is a UK-based healthcare technology company that specializes in developing Electronic Patient Record (EPR) systems for the National Health Service (NHS). Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Wokingham, Berkshire, Nervecentre has become the largest single EPR platform provider in the UK. The company employs between 51-200 people across Europe and Oceania.

Nervecentre's main product is a mobile-first EPR platform that leverages cloud and SaaS technologies. This platform provides clinical and operational teams in acute hospital settings with real-time access to patient information. Key features include mobile accessibility for healthcare professionals, clinical photography solutions for linking images to patient records, and tools for better management of intensive care beds and resources. The platform is widely used by doctors and nurses in UK hospitals, with over 40 NHS trust relationships and more than 100 hospital implementations.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
NetJets is the world's largest private aviation company, founded in 1964 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. As a subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway since 1998, it pioneered fractional aircraft ownership and operates the largest fleet of private jets globally. NetJets serves over 10,200 owners in the US and more than 2,200 in Europe, providing access to flights at 2,200 airports across 170 countries.

The company offers a range of flexible private jet solutions, including fractional ownership, jet card programs, and on-demand charter services. Customers can purchase shares of jets, allowing them to enjoy the benefits of private aviation without the full management responsibilities. NetJets maintains a fleet of approximately 650-700 jets, including light, midsize, super-midsize, large, and long-range aircraft. Its mission is to enrich the lives of owners with extraordinary experiences, catering to both corporate clients and high-net-worth individuals.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Net Purpose is a London-based company founded in 2019 that specializes in impact data aggregation services for investors. The company provides raw, quantitative data on the social and environmental outcomes of publicly listed companies and investment portfolios. This data helps investors monitor their portfolios, comply with ESG regulations, and enhance their sustainable investing strategies.

The platform offers comprehensive features, including data collection and analysis from thousands of global sources, ESG metrics across 200 indicators, and tools for portfolio reporting and impact evaluation. Net Purpose also assists investors in aligning their investments with the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). With a growing customer base and significant funding, Net Purpose supports clients managing over $5 trillion in assets, powering more than $100 billion in sustainable funds.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Nethermind is a blockchain research and software engineering company founded in 2017 in London. With over 300 employees, it focuses on empowering enterprises and developers to build on decentralized systems. The company received an Ethereum Foundation grant in 2018 to deliver a full-client implementation and aims to create accessible and transparent economic and governance systems.

Nethermind's flagship product is its Ethereum execution client, which secures over 30% of the Ethereum blockchain. The company also offers a range of blockchain infrastructure and developer tools, including a Starknet client, block explorer, developer workspace, validator tools, and smart contract security tools. Additionally, Nethermind provides strategic advisory services in areas such as decentralized finance, blockchain engineering, asset tokenization, and security audits. Its diverse clientele includes financial institutions, enterprises, and developers, and it maintains partnerships with key industry players.
companies.policy: The company can offer sponsorship on a case-by-case basis.

companies.description:
Netlify is a cloud computing company founded in 2014 that offers a development platform for building, deploying, and managing web applications and static sites using the Jamstack architecture. The platform simplifies server management by integrating continuous deployment, serverless functions, a global CDN, and composable cloud services into a cohesive workflow. It is designed for developers and businesses looking for scalable and secure web experiences.

Co-founded by Mathias Biilmann and Christian Bach, Netlify launched publicly in 2015 and quickly gained traction, serving a significant volume of web requests. The company has introduced several key features, including continuous deployment from Git repositories, serverless backend functions, and integrations for content management and APIs. Notable products include Netlify Connect, Core, and Create, which enhance workflow efficiency and content orchestration.

Netlify has made strategic acquisitions to expand its capabilities, including FeaturePeek for frontend preview tools and OneGraph for GraphQL-based API composition. The company serves a diverse range of clients, including Affirm, Unilever, and Twilio, and has reached over one million developers and businesses.

Netlight is an international digital consulting firm founded in 1999 in Stockholm, Sweden. The company specializes in IT services, IT consulting, and management consulting, helping businesses navigate the digital landscape through strategy, technology, design, data, and implementation services. With around 2,000 consultants across 10-11 offices in Europe and Toronto, Netlight reported $211.2 million in revenue in 2024 and employs approximately 1,953 people.

Netlight offers a wide range of digital consultancy services, including IT strategy consulting, product development, business analysis, user experience design, coaching, training, and security. The firm focuses on leveraging new technologies to address digital challenges, promoting sustainable impact through diverse and inclusive teams. Netlight has been recognized for its growth, profitability, and commitment to equality and diversity in the IT industry.

Neuberger Berman is a private, independent investment management firm founded in 1939. It is 100% employee-owned and focuses on delivering long-term investment results through fundamental research and innovative strategies. The firm is headquartered in New York and operates in 19 countries, managing approximately $558 billion in client assets as of November 2025.

Originally established to manage funds for high-net-worth individuals, Neuberger Berman has expanded its offerings to include a wide range of investment strategies across public and private markets. These include value-oriented and growth equity funds, fixed income investments, private equity, hedge funds, and multi-asset class solutions. The firm emphasizes a collaborative culture and has significantly grown its non-U.S. assets over the years, serving a diverse clientele that includes institutions, advisors, and intermediaries globally.

Nevis is an AI platform based in New York City, focused on wealth management. Founded by former Revolut executives, the company aims to automate operational workflows for Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and wealth management firms. Nevis emerged from stealth in late 2025, securing $40 million in funding, including a $5 million seed round and a $35 million Series A led by Sequoia Capital.

The platform is designed to streamline administrative tasks, allowing advisors to concentrate on client service and business growth. Nevis integrates data from various systems into a unified AI-powered operating system, automating processes such as meeting preparation, task generation, and client onboarding. It supports RIAs managing over $50 billion in client assets and is gaining traction among wealth management firms, enhancing productivity and client experiences.

companies.description:
New Relic, Inc. is an observability software company based in San Francisco, specializing in cloud-based monitoring and analytics solutions for websites, mobile applications, and infrastructure. Founded in 2008, New Relic went public in 2014 and was recently acquired by private equity firms Francisco Partners and TPG Inc. for approximately $6.5 billion. The company reported $925.6 million in revenue for fiscal year 2023 and employs around 2,700 people across 16 global offices.

New Relic offers a unified observability platform that helps engineers monitor and optimize software performance throughout the software lifecycle. Key features include Application Performance Monitoring (APM), Infrastructure Monitoring, Full-Stack Observability through New Relic One, Kubernetes Observability, and Code Collaboration with New Relic CodeStream. The platform operates on a consumption-based pricing model and includes a perpetual free tier for engineers. New Relic has enhanced its offerings through strategic acquisitions, including Opsmatic, CoScale, Pixie, and CodeStream.

NewDay Ltd is a prominent financial services company based in the UK, specializing in consumer credit products. Established in 2000 and rebranded in 2014, NewDay serves around 4-5.8 million customers through its direct-to-consumer brands and retail partnerships. The company is authorized and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and is committed to promoting financial inclusion.

NewDay offers a wide range of credit solutions, including Aqua, Marbles, Fluid, and Bip cards for credit building, as well as branded credit products for major retailers like John Lewis & Partners and Argos. Their services include Buy Now Pay Later options, instalment finance, revolving credit cards, and a digital platform that provides white-label credit infrastructure. NewDay also emphasizes financial education, supporting over 1.1 million users in enhancing their money management skills. With a strong focus on accountability and integrity, NewDay aims to help customers take control of their credit journey.

NewStore is a Boston-based omnichannel retail platform founded in 2015 by Stephan Schambach. The company offers Omnichannel-as-a-Service, a cloud-based, mobile-first solution that integrates online and offline retail experiences. This platform allows retailers to operate stores on iPhones, enhancing customer engagement and boosting sales through features like mobile point-of-sale, order management, and personalized clienteling.

NewStore's Unified Commerce Platform is designed to work seamlessly with existing e-commerce and ERP systems, providing flexibility and ease of integration. Key functionalities include real-time inventory management, mobile checkout, and native consumer apps for a streamlined shopping experience. The company serves a diverse range of brands, including UNTUCKit, Decathlon, and Burton, helping them improve in-store revenue and customer loyalty. With a strong focus on innovation, NewStore continues to expand its capabilities and global reach.

Newable is an employee-owned business support platform based in the UK, established in 1982. Originally known as Greater London Enterprise, it rebranded in 2016 and became fully employee-owned in 2023. The company focuses on empowering ambitious small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and established businesses through its services in Money, Advice, and Workspace. Newable supports over 20,000 businesses each year, emphasizing a values-driven culture with principles like "Dream Big" and "Grow Together."

The company offers business loans and tailored financial products to help entrepreneurs secure capital for growth. It provides expert guidance to navigate business challenges and opportunities, fostering confidence and development. Newable also operates over 55 business centers across the UK, offering flexible workspace solutions. With a commitment to ESG principles, Newable focuses on economic development and sustainability while promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture.

companies.description:
Newsquawk is a financial news service that specializes in delivering real-time audio and text headlines focused on market-moving events across various sectors, including forex, equities, fixed income, metals, and energy. The company employs analysts who monitor numerous news sources and data releases around the clock to provide actionable insights, helping traders stay informed without the need to sift through irrelevant information.

The service offers a range of tools for professional traders, including live audio alerts, a scrolling text feed of news headlines, and real-time chat with analysts. Users can access daily pre-market research, an economic calendar, and additional features like a Twitter scanner and AI-curated media monitoring. For institutional clients, Newsquawk provides enterprise solutions such as API delivery of headlines and custom feeds, enhancing trading opportunities and risk management.

Trusted by top-tier financial professionals and institutions, Newsquawk is recognized for its speed and accuracy in reporting, making it a valuable resource for traders looking to react quickly to market developments.

Newsquest Media Group is a prominent UK-based publisher of regional and local newspapers, operating as a subsidiary of Gannett Co., Inc. Established in 1995, it has become the second-largest regional publisher in the UK. The company employs around 5,700 staff and manages a diverse portfolio of print and digital publications.

Newsquest specializes in regional journalism, producing local newspapers, including daily and weekly titles across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. It also offers digital platforms with online news portals and community-focused websites. Additionally, the company provides printing services through its acquisition of Southernprint, which handles magazine and commercial printing. Newsquest has expanded its reach through strategic acquisitions, enhancing its portfolio with niche publications.

Newtech Intelligent Automation Limited is a private limited company based in Sharnbrook, Bedford, UK. Established in 1984, it has over 41 years of experience in the industry and remains active as of January 2026. The company specializes in the design and manufacture of industrial ultrasonic slicing, cutting, portioning, and handling machines, focusing on food production automation.

As a leading manufacturer in its field, Newtech emphasizes safety, compliance, and innovation in its automated ultrasonic cutting and portioning solutions, which often include robotic handling features. The company operates as a micro-sized enterprise, employing around 14 people and maintaining a strong financial position with total assets of £2.06 million as of March 2024. Key leadership includes Managing Director Richard Martin Smith and Directors Edwin John Richard Canvin and Stephen Anthony Rawlinson.

The company focuses on helping organizations navigate industry changes and enhance their competitiveness through strategic consulting and digital transformation services. With a team of approximately 50-99 employees, Newton Vision generates an estimated annual revenue of $1M–$5M.

The firm offers a range of services, including business process reengineering and optimization, digital transformation, business process outsourcing, and management consulting. Their expertise spans various technology platforms and methodologies, such as software development and IT consulting. Newton Vision also operates offices in Austin and Houston, Texas, and has a project management office in Bogota, Colombia. The company is committed to fostering goal-oriented cultures and has a history of strategic partnerships aimed at achieving competitive advantages.

Next plc, commonly known as Next, is a leading British multinational retailer based in Enderby, England. The company specializes in clothing, footwear, and home products, operating approximately 500 stores in the UK and Ireland, along with around 200 additional locations across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Next is recognized as the UK's largest clothing retailer by sales and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 on the London Stock Exchange.

Founded in 1864, Next has evolved significantly over the years. The modern brand was established in 1982, expanding rapidly into various product lines, including home furnishings with the launch of Next Interiors in 1985. The company has embraced multiple shopping formats, including retail, catalogue, and e-commerce, with a strong online presence that accounted for over 40% of sales by 2017. Next is committed to quality, trend-awareness, and sustainability, aiming for net zero emissions by 2040 and a 50% reduction in emissions by 2025.

Founded in 1995 as Text 100 and rebranded in 2023, the company operates with 22 brands across four main service segments: Insight, Engagement, Delivery, and Transformation. It serves over 3,500 clients globally, including major corporations like Alphabet, Amazon, Procter & Gamble, Johnson & Johnson, and Toyota.

The company’s services are delivered through specialized brands such as Savanta for market research, Archetype for global communications, and Transform for business strategy. Next 15 has a strong presence in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, and Oceania. It has received over 100 industry awards in 2024, recognizing its innovation in marketing and communications. The company continues to expand through strategic acquisitions and focuses on providing tailored growth solutions in tech-adjacent markets.

Nimble Elearning Ltd is an elearning company based in Gloucestershire, United Kingdom, founded in 2009. It specializes in user-friendly and affordable software tools for creating, delivering, and managing online training. The company aims to make high-quality online learning accessible to organizations of all sizes and sectors, emphasizing ethical practices and sustainability as a Certified B Corporation.

Nimble offers a complete elearning solution that is quick to set up and supported by excellent customer service. Its key products include Nimble Author for creating engaging online courses, Nimble LMS for managing learning programs and tracking progress, and Nimble Courses, which provides ready-made, brandable courses covering various topics like compliance and skills development. With a commitment to data security, Nimble is ISO27001 certified and serves thousands of companies, handling millions of enrolments each month.

Founded in 2019 by Creative Director Jim Allen and Managing Director Barny Wright, the studio merges award-winning sound capabilities with high-end visual effects.

The company offers a range of multi-disciplinary post-production services, including editing, audio and music production, colour grading, visual effects (VFX), CGI, and animation. No.8 is known for its seamless visual effects and collaborates closely with clients from the initial concept to final delivery. Noda offers an AI-powered building orchestration platform that integrates and manages data from various sources, including Building Management Systems, meters, and sensors.

Key services include analytics and insights for tracking energy and carbon metrics, AI-driven optimization for automating demand management and HVAC control, and actionable recommendations to address inefficiencies. Noda also provides payment and open banking solutions, facilitating payments and offering AI-driven financial insights. The company serves notable clients in the commercial real estate and hospitality sectors, including CBRE Group, Marriott International, and Hilton Worldwide.

As part of the Nomios Group, the company focuses on designing, securing, and managing digital infrastructures for organizations of all sizes. They emphasize enterprise-grade security and network integrity, serving as a trusted partner for businesses undergoing digital transformation.

The company offers a range of services, including cybersecurity solutions that implement advanced security architectures, cloud networking to support secure connectivity, and managed services for 24/7 monitoring and incident response. Their professional services provide strategic consulting and tailored project rollouts. Nomios UK&I collaborates with over 40 vendors, including Palo Alto Networks and Cisco, to deliver integrated, vendor-agnostic solutions. With a global client base of over 2,000, they cater to highly regulated industries that require complex network and security solutions.

Nomo Bank is a UK-based, Sharia-compliant digital bank that launched in July 2021. It is recognized as the world’s first fully digital international Islamic bank, designed for customers with global lifestyles who seek ethical financial solutions. Nomo focuses on accessibility, security, and compliance with Islamic finance principles, offering services regulated in the UK with deposit protection up to £85,000.

Nomo Bank provides a range of services, including multi-currency accounts that allow customers to hold, spend, and send funds in six currencies. It also offers fixed-term deposits for wealth growth in GBP, USD, or EUR, and Sharia-compliant property finance for residential or rental property purchases in England and Wales. Customers can enjoy digital banking tools, including instant account setup via smartphone and 24/7 access to their accounts. Nomo primarily serves residents of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), particularly in Kuwait and the UAE, catering to expatriates and investors seeking UK transactional banking and international financial flexibility.

Nonwovenn is a leading nonwoven fabric technology company based in Bridgwater, Somerset, England. Founded in 1952, it specializes in designing and manufacturing technical fabrics for industrial, medical, and packaging sectors. The company has a strong track record of innovation, delivering protective solutions and customized fabric technologies. As of September 2024, Nonwovenn has achieved 18 years of consecutive profitable growth, with a turnover of £45 million and plans to double this to £80 million by 2028.

The company offers a range of products, including technical nonwoven fabrics for industrial applications, medical-grade materials, and packaging solutions. Nonwovenn is committed to sustainability, aiming to become carbon-neutral by 2030 and focusing on developing sustainable energy and raw materials. With a strategy for international expansion into North American and European markets, Nonwovenn is well-positioned to meet the growing demand for innovative and sustainable fabric solutions.

The platform features an integrated accounts payable workflow that includes purchase order management, invoice processing, and payment processing across 36 currencies. Nook's AI-powered tools streamline invoice coding and bank detail validation, while collaboration features allow team members to discuss invoices and purchase orders in real-time. Additionally, suppliers can access a secure portal to view paid invoices and future payment details, ensuring transparency and efficiency in the payment process.

Their expertise covers high bandwidth applications, storage, visualization, and security, catering to a global clientele across various industries, including aviation, finance, bio-sciences, education, government, and oil & gas.

Nordstar Group offers a comprehensive range of services, including consultation for HPC needs, integration and deployment of hardware and software, and managed services. The company operates in 14 European countries, including the UK and Ireland, as well as Australia and New Zealand, employing over 1,300 people across various operational sites. Norgine has a fully integrated pharmaceutical infrastructure that allows it to acquire, develop, manufacture, and commercialize innovative products.

The company focuses on gastroenterology and hepatology, with significant expertise in bowel preparation products. Norgine's product portfolio includes MOVICOL®, a leading treatment for constipation in Europe, and PLENVU®, a unique bowel preparation product. In addition to pharmaceuticals, Norgine offers digital and analog services to support healthcare professionals and patients. Norgine Ventures, a complementary business, provides financing to innovative healthcare companies in Europe and the US. The company is dedicated to improving patient outcomes and enhancing healthcare systems through its innovative solutions.

The company offers a variety of services, including board and leadership search, senior interim management, research and insight, leadership consulting, and talent acquisition at executive levels. Norman Broadbent serves multiple sectors, including consumer, financial services, industrials, technology, media, telecommunications, life sciences, and private equity. The company operates with a startup culture that prioritizes autonomy and rapid delivery. Northslope builds tailored AI products to meet unique operational needs, particularly in complex supply chains. They work closely with clients to identify key issues and deliver minimum viable products in a matter of days, driving significant business outcomes quickly. Northslope serves a wide range of clients, from ambitious startups to Fortune 500 companies, across various industries including healthcare and supply chain management.

Founded in 2020, Nory offers an integrated operating system designed to optimize operations, enhance profitability, and reduce costs for hospitality businesses. The company has raised a total of $63 million in funding, with a significant $37 million Series B round in 2025, aimed at supporting expansion and algorithm development.

Nory's platform includes features such as business intelligence, inventory management, workforce management, payroll automation, and growth funding tools. It utilizes AI for predictive analytics and demand forecasting, helping restaurants streamline operations and make informed decisions. The platform integrates seamlessly with existing systems, acting as a command center that learns business patterns to improve efficiency. Nory has partnered with notable hospitality brands, demonstrating its effectiveness in reducing labor costs and food waste while enabling faster growth and profitability.

The platform connects over 5,500 small creative businesses, including designers, artisans, and bakers, with customers seeking unique, often handmade products. NOTHS has grown significantly since its inception, starting with 200 partner producers and expanding to host over 350,000 unique products, serving more than 4 million customers worldwide.

NOTHS operates as a curated marketplace, handpicking UK-based brands and facilitating transactions without holding inventory. The platform provides sellers with business support, tech infrastructure, and data tools, while customers enjoy easy returns and the opportunity to discover hard-to-find items. The marketplace emphasizes purpose-driven retail, supporting small brands and promoting conscious shopping. With a focus on growth and empowering artisans, NOTHS aims to be the go-to destination for gifting and self-purchase, continuing to scale its offerings globally.

The company emphasizes transparent aesthetics and functional innovation, positioning itself as a challenger in the global market. With a design hub led by Adam Bates, former Head of Design at Dyson, Nothing has established a retail presence that includes a store in Soho and various pop-up kiosks.

The company has successfully raised over $450 million in funding, achieving a valuation of $1.3 billion and over $1 billion in cumulative sales. Its product portfolio includes audio devices, smartphones, wearables, and accessories, featuring innovations like the Glyph Interface and Nothing OS. Notable products include the ear (1) and ear (2) earphones, as well as the Phone (1) and Phone (2) smartphones. Nothing also launched a sub-brand, CMF, which focuses on additional consumer electronics. The company is committed to hardware-software integration and community engagement through events and crowdfunding initiatives.

Headquartered in Smethwick, England, the company employs between 42 and 200 people and is valued at approximately $72 million as of late 2022. Nourished is recognized for its commitment to sustainability, using zero single-use plastics and home-compostable packaging.

The core offering from Nourished is its personalized 7-layer nutrient gummy stacks, which are created fresh to order. Customers start by taking an online quiz to assess their individual health needs, leading to a bespoke gummy stack tailored to their wellness goals. These gummies are vegan, sugar-free, and made with ethically sourced ingredients. Nourished targets health-conscious consumers seeking convenient and effective nutrition solutions, and it has received positive recognition in various media outlets, establishing itself as a leader in the personalized vitamin market.

The company focuses on converting plant biomass waste into sustainable, bio-based products using its proprietary technology. Its flagship process, REFNOVA®, efficiently transforms woody and agricultural residues into valuable products, including advanced second-generation ethanol, biochar, biopolymers, biochemicals, and biofuels.

The company serves various sectors, including chemicals, energy, transport, food and drink, manufacturing, and construction. Notable projects include a partnership with British Airways and LanzaJet to develop sustainable aviation fuels through Project Speedbird, and the establishment of its first commercial-scale facility, NOVAONE. Nova Pangaea Technologies aims to provide sustainable alternatives to fossil-based products and supports global decarbonization efforts through its innovative processes.

Novoic is an AI-first digital biotechnology company based in London, founded in 2019 by researchers from Oxford and Cambridge Universities. The company specializes in developing speech-based algorithms for the early detection of neurological diseases, such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. Novoic aims to create clinically viable software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) that can diagnose and monitor neurological conditions through automated audio-verbal assessments.

The company offers a range of products, including fully automated cognitive testing tools like Novoic Storyteller, which can detect subtle cognitive impairments in just 10 minutes. Novoic's AI models facilitate early identification of cognitive decline and support digital screening and monitoring in clinical trials. Their technology is designed to be scalable and user-friendly, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations. Novoic collaborates with over 50 institutions and medical centers, including the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, to enhance access to early detection services in underserved communities.

The company focuses on manufacturing basic pharmaceutical products and conducting research and experimental development in biotechnology. Its therapeutic specialties include oncology, inflammation and immunology, anti-infectives, and rare diseases. In addition to product development and manufacturing, NOVUMGEN offers product licensing, co-development, and technology transfer services. With a team of 51-200 employees, the company operates manufacturing facilities and research laboratories to support its mission of delivering life-changing medicines that enhance safety and value for patients and healthcare providers worldwide.

Their expert team creates tailored designs to meet project requirements and oversees all aspects of delivery to ensure timely and cost-effective results. The firm specializes in serving premium brands within the architecture, design, and built environment sectors, particularly focusing on high-end real estate, luxury branding, and premium hospitality projects. 

The consultancy offers a range of services, including brand strategy and identity development, content production, and immersive storytelling. Known for its "good, slow design" philosophy, Noë & Associates aims to create a positive and lasting legacy through its work. Notable collaborations include projects with Surface magazine and Watch Journal, as well as developing a new brand identity for The One Atelier.

Ntropy is a fintech company founded in 2019, co-founded by CEO Naré Vardanyan and CTO Ilia Zintchenko. The company offers a developer-first API platform focused on financial data standardization, enrichment, and intelligence. Utilizing in-house machine learning and large language models, Ntropy processes transaction data accurately across various sources, formats, and languages. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Ntropy's main product is a highly accurate financial data standardization and enrichment API. This API analyzes transaction data for context in milliseconds, aiding in credit scoring, loan agreements, and other financial decisions. Additionally, Ntropy AI is a newly launched platform that orchestrates large language models for finance, capable of processing up to 100 million transactions daily with low latency. The platform is designed to be scalable and privacy-compliant, addressing challenges posed by legacy payment systems. Ntropy serves enterprises in financial services and has garnered interest from multiple fintech companies.

companies.description:
Nu Quantum is a quantum networking technology company founded in 2018, originating from the University of Cambridge's Cavendish Laboratory. Based in Cambridge, UK, with an office in Los Angeles, the company focuses on developing infrastructure to scale quantum computers for commercial use. With over 60 employees across various technical disciplines, Nu Quantum aims to build the Entanglement Fabric, a solution designed to enable the mass commercialization of quantum computing through distributed architectures.

The company's product offerings include the Entanglement Fabric, a modular quantum networking stack, and the Quantum Networking Unit (QNU), which efficiently scales quantum processing units. They also provide a Qubit Photon Interface (QPI) and single-photon technologies that operate at room temperature. Nu Quantum serves government and enterprise clients, working on pilot projects in telecommunications and space communications, and supports applications in machine learning, optimization, and complex system simulations. The company has raised $60 million in Series A funding to support its growth in Europe and the US.

companies.description:
Nucleome Therapeutics is a biotechnology company founded in 2019 by experts in gene regulation from the University of Oxford. Based in Oxford Science Park, England, the company focuses on decoding the regulatory genome to enhance personalized medicine. Nucleome aims to understand how genetic variations influence gene function and disease biology, which is essential for drug discovery and development.

The company offers drug discovery research services by utilizing the three-dimensional structure of the genome. By combining computational and biological expertise, Nucleome identifies genetically validated drug targets and determines patient responses to treatments. Their platform integrates genetic information across disease populations, providing insights into molecular networks that underlie diseases.

Nucleome is developing a pipeline of drug assets targeting autoimmune diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, inflammatory bowel disease, and multiple sclerosis. The company has secured significant funding from notable investors, which supports its programs and the expansion of its dark genome atlas. Nucleome collaborates with major pharmaceutical companies to apply its insights in drug development.

companies.description:
Numan is a UK-based digital healthcare platform founded in 2018, offering direct-to-consumer subscription services for personalized medical treatments, diagnostics, and wellness coaching. The company integrates clinical consultations, prescription fulfillment, pharmacy operations, and ongoing care management through a single website and mobile app. Numan operates a subscription model that allows it to manage the entire patient journey, ensuring comprehensive care and higher gross margins.

The platform provides a wide range of health services, including weight loss programs, sexual health treatments, hair loss medications, testosterone replacement therapy, and various diagnostic services. Numan also offers women's health services, supplements, and wellness programs. Patients receive personalized care through a medical questionnaire reviewed by remote GPs or pharmacists, with medications and test kits delivered promptly. The platform features AI-driven recommendations tailored to individual health profiles and includes support tools for mental health and behavioral change. As of 2024, Numan serves over 650,000 patients and has generated $90 million in revenue.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Nuntius Therapeutics is a biotechnology company based in London, England, founded in 2021. The company specializes in developing mRNA therapies using proprietary nanocarriers, machine learning, and nucleic acid engineering. Their focus areas include oncology, respiratory diseases, and neurodegenerative disorders. Nuntius emerged from stealth in August 2024 as a Y Combinator-backed startup, having raised $130K in funding.

The company's core technology features programmable and non-immunogenic nanocarriers that enable targeted delivery of genetic material, such as mRNA and CRISPR. These nanocarriers outperform traditional delivery methods by minimizing immunogenicity and targeting tissues beyond the liver. Nuntius has established a partnership with Taiho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. to enhance their mRNA cancer immunotherapy efforts. The team consists of experienced scientists and entrepreneurs dedicated to advancing patient outcomes through innovative therapies.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Nurole Ltd is a London-based technology company founded in 2014 by Susie Cummings. It specializes in global non-executive director (NED) search and board-level talent recruitment through a digital platform that modernizes traditional headhunting methods. Nurole combines smart technology, AI-driven matching, and industry expertise to connect high-quality candidates with board roles, promoting diversity and efficiency in the hiring process.

The platform serves a wide range of organizations, including multinationals, startups, charities, and government bodies, providing access to a vetted pool of over 50,000 potential board candidates. Nurole also offers candidates visibility into more than 1,300 board-level vacancies, along with membership options that include career support and networking resources. With over 60,000 members across 100+ countries, Nurole has successfully placed more than 2,500 individuals into board roles, earning recognition as one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

companies.description:
OANDA is a global online trading group and forex broker founded in 1996, specializing in multi-asset trading platforms, currency data services, and analytics for both retail and institutional clients. The company was co-founded by Dr. Michael Stumm and Dr. Richard Olsen, with a mission to democratize access to currency data and trading markets. OANDA pioneered free online real-time currency exchange rate data and has continued to innovate with its fxTrade platform for automated FX trading.

Headquartered in New York, OANDA operates in major financial hubs worldwide, including Toronto, London, and Tokyo. The company offers advanced trading platforms, a vast historical database of FX rates, and systematic investment products. It serves a diverse clientele, including individual traders, corporations, and auditing firms, with a focus on reliability and compliance. OANDA's commitment to transparency and education supports a broad user base, making it a trusted provider in the forex and crypto markets.

OC&C Strategy Consultants is a British management consulting firm based in London, specializing in strategic consulting. Founded in 1987 by Chris Outram, Geoff Cullinan, and Michael Jary, the firm has over 35 years of experience in addressing complex business challenges. With a team of more than 700 employees across 15 global offices, OC&C focuses on providing tailored solutions that reflect their philosophy of "simple, uncommon sense™."

The firm offers a variety of services, including corporate strategy development, divisional strategy enhancement, and strategic advice on mergers and acquisitions. OC&C is known for its bespoke approach, treating each client's challenges as unique and delivering customized insights. They work with top management from multinational corporations, national companies, private equity firms, and governmental institutions, building lasting relationships through collaboration and a commitment to solving complex problems.

companies.description:
OLR America, Inc., also known as OLR Retail, is a specialist in Oracle Retail systems integration, established in 1998. The company provides end-to-end omnichannel retail solutions designed to optimize operations for retailers. OLR focuses on creating unified views of customers, inventory, and orders, enhancing efficiency and competitive advantage across merchandising, planning, stores, POS, and eCommerce.

Headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, OLR has additional operations in London and Bengaluru. The company employs approximately 280-359 people and generates annual revenue between $58.3 million and $67.4 million. OLR is a certified member of the Oracle Partner Network, offering services that include system integration, automated testing, and 24/7 managed support. Their expertise encompasses multichannel integration, customer analytics, and order fulfillment, with proprietary tools like PaytestLab Robot for efficient testing. OLR supports various Oracle Retail applications, helping retailers with cloud migration and digital transformation.

ONE.io is a unified payments and financial services provider that specializes in high-risk sectors globally. Founded in 2017, the company initially operated as an OTC digital asset trading desk before shifting its focus to address challenges in settlement and business accounts. It obtained a Payment Institution license from the UK's Financial Conduct Authority in 2020 and launched its proprietary payments platform in 2021.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services through its divisions, ONE.io Connect and ONE.io Fusion. ONE.io Connect provides multi-currency business accounts, global payments, and spot foreign exchange services. ONE.io Fusion facilitates 24/7 cryptocurrency trading, payment processing, and fiat settlements. With a strong emphasis on collaboration and innovation, ONE.io supports businesses in navigating the complexities of crypto and payment management, helping them to grow without banking limitations.

companies.description:
ONI (Oxford Nanoimaging) is a biotechnology company based in Oxford, UK, founded in 2016 as a spin-out from the University of Oxford. The company specializes in super-resolution microscopy, enabling the visualization of single molecules in living cells. ONI manufactures compact, benchtop super-resolution microscopes and related tools, employing around 107 people and reporting revenue of $62.8 million.

The company's flagship product, the Nanoimager, supports various imaging modalities for versatile research applications. Other offerings include the Aplo Scope, an advanced super-resolution system, and the Aplo Flow, an automated liquid handler for sample preparation. ONI also provides sample preparation kits and a cloud-based analysis platform called CODI for data processing and collaboration. These products are designed to facilitate high-resolution imaging and AI-driven analysis in industrial, medical, and research settings, contributing to over 200 peer-reviewed publications.

OPRE Solutions is a trusted leader in Purpose-Built Student Accommodation (PBSA) and dedicated rental housing, with over six decades of combined expertise in asset management, development, and investment services. We have successfully managed more than 120,000 units worldwide, delivering outstanding results for clients across diverse real estate sectors.

Our tailored solutions are designed to maximize portfolio performance through innovative strategies, data-driven insights, and a long-term, sustainable approach. We specialize in creating value across all phases of the real estate lifecycle, from pre-planning and development to operations and asset management.

At OPRE Solutions, we combine industry-leading expertise, a commitment to ESG principles, and a proven track record to deliver superior returns for investors while transforming homes, communities, and lives. Partner with us to unlock the full potential of your real estate investments.

companies.description:
Oil Spill Response Limited (OSRL) is the largest industry-owned cooperative focused on global oil spill preparedness and response. Established in 1985, OSRL is a member-funded organization that includes over 160 environmentally responsible entities from the oil, gas, shipping, and maritime sectors. With more than 40 years of experience, OSRL has responded to over 400 oil spill incidents worldwide and operates 13 strategic bases across Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, and the Americas.

OSRL offers a comprehensive range of preparedness and response services tailored for oil spills of any scale. Their preparedness services include crisis management, contingency planning, equipment hire, and training. For response, they provide rapid deployment of personnel and equipment, subsea well intervention services, and wildlife response. OSRL also offers customizable equipment hire packages that include offshore containment systems, shoreline clean-up tools, and advanced dispersant application systems. The cooperative emphasizes partnership and collaboration to enhance resilience and ensure regulatory compliance in the face of emerging challenges.

OVO Energy is a UK-based energy supplier and technology company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Bristol. The company provides clean and affordable energy to homes and businesses across the UK, serving over 1.5 million customers. In 2020, OVO expanded significantly by acquiring SSE Energy Services, which added approximately 3 million customers to its base.

The company focuses on sustainability through its Plan Zero initiative, aiming to become a net zero carbon business by 2035. OVO Energy offers a variety of services, including electricity and gas supply, renewable energy solutions like solar panels, and smart meter installations. They also provide programs to encourage energy efficiency, such as Power Move, and payment options like Boost, a pay-as-you-go service. OVO Energy is committed to using 100% renewable electricity and integrates smart technology to help customers manage their energy consumption effectively.

OZA Design is a RIBA and ARB chartered architectural and design practice that offers a wide range of design services. As a multidisciplinary studio, it has an extensive international portfolio that includes architectural, interior, product design, and branding services.

The firm provides full-scale architectural design, refurbishment projects, and innovative solutions for complex approvals. In interior design, OZA Design specializes in residential, cultural, hospitality, and commercial spaces, along with bespoke furniture and lighting design. Their branding services encompass logo creation, marketing materials, and brand identity development. Additionally, they offer specialized design services such as menu design for food and beverage brands, table setting design, and art curation. OZA Design also creates unique furniture and lighting collections, often collaborating with artists and artisans to explore experimental materials. 

The company focuses on understanding client needs and delivering designs that reflect both vision and environmental context, resulting in timeless and unique concepts.

The company aims to enhance internal communications and connect various types of workers, including frontline and remote employees, through a mobile-first platform. Oak Engage operates as OAK ENGAGE LIMITED and has its headquarters in Newcastle Upon Tyne.The company offers an award-winning employee app and intranet platform designed to boost productivity and engagement. Key features include mobile access, seamless integrations with tools like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, social and cultural tools for peer recognition, and feedback mechanisms such as polls and surveys. The platform is customizable, allowing organizations to create tailored experiences that improve information access and foster workplace culture. Oak Engage has partnered with notable brands like Aldi, ITV, and Burger King, demonstrating its commitment to supporting diverse workforces.

OakNorth is a British bank established in 2015 in London by Rishi Khosla and Joel Perlman. It focuses on providing fast and flexible debt finance solutions to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with turnovers between £1 million and £100 million. The bank aims to serve the "Missing Middle," offering tailored financial products that traditional lenders often overlook.

As a fully licensed bank under the UK’s Prudential Regulation Authority and Financial Conduct Authority, OakNorth launched its services six months after securing its banking license. It specializes in bespoke loans, emphasizing credit analysis and technology-driven lending processes to assess future growth potential. Additionally, OakNorth offers savings accounts that help fund loans to SMEs, contributing to job creation and economic growth.

The bank has lent approximately £4.5 billion to UK businesses, supporting various sectors, including healthcare and real estate development. With a leadership team comprising experienced professionals from the financial sector, OakNorth combines entrepreneurial insight and advanced technology to enhance the customer experience and promote business growth.

The company specializes in data strategy, engineering, and AI, utilizing its "Lighthouse Project" methodology to deliver quick wins while establishing sustainable data foundations.Oakland offers a range of services, including data strategy consulting, AI and machine learning solutions, data engineering, and governance improvements. The company focuses on building client capabilities, enabling organizations to manage their data solutions independently. With a commitment to a people-first approach, Oakland emphasizes collaboration and stakeholder engagement to ensure lasting impact.In 2024, Oakland was acquired by Softcat, enhancing its data and AI offerings. Founded in 2000, it started as the UK's first pure-play online grocer and has since evolved into a leader in ecommerce, fulfillment, and logistics solutions for grocery retailers worldwide. The company operates through two main segments: Technology Solutions and Ocado Logistics, with its core offering being the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP). This platform integrates web-shop, supply chain, and last-mile logistics into a single, configurable solution.

Ocado utilizes a network of highly automated Customer Fulfillment Centers (CFCs) equipped with advanced robotics and automation technology to enhance order fulfillment. The company generates revenue through online grocery sales, technology solutions provided to global grocery retailers, and third-party logistics services. Notable partnerships include collaborations with Marks & Spencer, Kroger, and Coles, among others. Ocado continues to expand its international presence, launching new CFCs and automation solutions in various countries.

Ochre Bio is a biotechnology company based in Oxford, UK, founded in 2019. The company focuses on developing RNA therapies for chronic liver diseases, aiming to reduce the need for liver transplants. With 1.5 million deaths annually from liver disease and only about 40,000 transplants performed worldwide, Ochre Bio is dedicated to addressing this critical health issue.

The company utilizes advanced technologies, including AI, genomics, and big data, to enhance drug discovery. Ochre Bio operates three main platforms: the Human Discovery Platform, which generates predictions for new drug targets; the Human Validation Platform, which combines AI predictions with human models for accuracy; and the RNA Platform, which accelerates the development of RNA therapies. Their approach emphasizes the use of human data and models to create precise genomic medicine for liver conditions. 

Ochre Bio's leadership team brings extensive experience in genomics, AI, and drug development, positioning the company to make significant contributions to the field of liver disease treatment.

It has grown to become the UK's largest energy provider, serving over 9 million customers across nine countries. The company operates as a collective of 10 businesses focused on making energy fair, clean, and simple through innovative technology.

Octopus Energy offers a range of services, including 100% renewable electricity supply, AI-driven smart tariffs, home solar programs, and electric vehicle services. Its proprietary technology platform, Kraken, enhances efficiency and customer service by integrating various business functions. The company is also a significant investor in renewable energy, managing a portfolio worth £7 billion and having invested over £3 billion in renewable assets across Europe. Octopus Energy is recognized for its commitment to fair pricing and sustainability.

Octopus Group is a UK-based holding company founded in 2000, focused on investing in and building entrepreneurial companies that promote positive change. With over £12 billion in assets, it serves more than 1.5 million customers across various sectors, including financial services, energy, real estate, and education. The company is a certified B Corporation, demonstrating its commitment to balancing profit with social and environmental responsibility.

The group operates through several subsidiaries, including Octopus Energy, which supplies affordable green energy to over 1.35 million customers and manages renewable energy assets. Octopus Investments focuses on venture capital trusts and investments that create societal impact, while Octopus Money provides accessible financial advice. Other ventures, such as Aurora, support children with special educational needs. Overall, Octopus Group is dedicated to fostering sustainable growth and social impact through its diverse portfolio.

Odfjell Drilling is a prominent offshore drilling services provider, established in 1973 and headquartered in Aberdeen, United Kingdom. The company specializes in harsh environment and deepwater operations, boasting a modern fleet of semi-submersible rigs. With roots tracing back to 1914, Odfjell Drilling has evolved significantly, marking its 50th anniversary in 2023 and showcasing advancements from the first Norwegian-built drilling rig to advanced 6th-generation rigs.

The company offers a range of services, including mobile offshore drilling units for exploration, production, and platform drilling. Odfjell Well Services provides well intervention and tubular running services across various regions, including Europe and the Middle East. Odfjell Drilling is committed to sustainability, focusing on energy-efficient operations and zero-emission drilling, while also investing in technology and automation to enhance operational efficiency. With a workforce of over 1,600 employees, Odfjell Drilling emphasizes a strong culture of quality, health, safety, security, and environmental stewardship.

Odin is a UK-based tech platform operated by Join Odin Limited, designed to facilitate syndicated investments through Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) and bare trusts. The platform primarily serves syndicate leads, founders, and investors involved in venture capital deals, including primary shares and secondaries. Odin is notable for being the only tech-first fund administration platform in the UK with full FCA authorization for client money custody and deal arranging.

The platform offers a comprehensive suite of services, including deal structuring, capital calls, fund administration, SPV creation, and investor communications. Key features include the ability to roll up angel investors into a single cap table line for founders, flexible asset syndication for various investment types, and strong compliance support. Odin emphasizes capital efficiency, tax compliance, and a superior customer experience, making it a valuable resource for those looking to streamline their investment processes.

companies.description: Ohm Space is a UK-based aerospace startup founded in 2021, specializing in high-temperature resistojet propulsion systems for spacecraft. The company develops innovative solutions for a range of platforms, from nanosatellites to large geostationary satellites, using safe and low-cost propellants like water and noble gases. This approach enhances thrust and specific impulse, achieving up to 70% higher performance compared to competitors while promoting sustainability by reducing hazardous chemicals.Headquartered in Southampton, OhmSpace builds on extensive research from the University of Southampton. The company secured a €2.5M seed round in 2023 to support its mission, which includes plans for In-Orbit Demonstration missions in 2026. OhmSpace's core product is a modular, scalable electric propulsion system that utilizes patented 3D-printed metal heaters for efficient propellant use. The company also offers engineering model assembly, mission design support, and plans for in-house manufacturing in Rome to ensure quality and scalability. Its technology targets space agencies, satellite operators, and LEO constellation providers, focusing on enhancing mission capabilities and sustainability in the aerospace sector.

Ohme is a UK-based company founded in 2017 that specializes in smart home charging technology for electric vehicles (EVs). The company focuses on dynamic chargers that optimize charging for cost savings, renewable energy use, and grid efficiency. Headquartered in London, Ohme operates under the Temporis Group, aiming to accelerate the transition to clean energy by integrating hardware, software, and data systems for various stakeholders, including EV drivers, OEMs, and energy providers.

Ohme's core products include smart EV home chargers, such as the Home Pro and ePod, which feature load balancing, solar compatibility, and tariff optimization. The Ohme App allows users to schedule charging sessions, track energy usage, and activate solar charging. The company also provides installation services and emphasizes smart energy management to support grid stability. Ohme has established partnerships with major OEMs like Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, and Polestar, as well as energy suppliers such as Octopus Energy and OVO Energy, enhancing its presence in the EV market.

Okta, Inc. is a technology company based in San Francisco, founded in 2009 by Todd McKinnon and Frederic Kerrest. The company specializes in cloud-based identity and access management (IAM) solutions, including Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS). Okta's Identity Cloud enables secure connections between users and technology, allowing organizations to manage user authentication for employees, customers, and partners across various applications and devices.

Key offerings include Single Sign-On (SSO), which simplifies access to multiple cloud applications with one set of credentials, and Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management (PAM) for secure access controls. Okta has experienced significant growth, serving over 19,100 customers and reporting $2.263 billion in revenue for FY2024. The company is recognized for its influence in identity management and is committed to security and community initiatives through programs like Okta for Good.

With over 50 years of combined e-commerce expertise, Olsam leverages technology to optimize brand performance and drive growth across various platforms.

The company focuses on acquiring high-potential brands and enhancing them through a proprietary platform that offers real-time data analytics and operational management. Olsam is committed to expanding its portfolio of category-leading consumer goods brands while providing IP and patent protection in multiple regions. The leadership team, which includes experienced professionals from the e-commerce sector, aims to achieve significant revenue growth by 2024 through strategic acquisitions and operational excellence.

It provides borderless multi-currency business accounts, company registration, international payments, accounting, legal services, and virtual office tools. The company is registered in England and Wales and is authorized by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for issuing electronic money and providing payment services.

With a focus on fast and transparent global payments, Omega supports operations in over 150 countries and accepts more than 35 major currencies. The company emphasizes security, safeguarding customer funds in top-tier banks and adhering to high security standards. The company aims to streamline the entire supplier lifecycle, enhance purchasing decisions, manage costs, and ensure governance and risk management. Headquartered in London, Omnea operates in the business technology sector and has raised $20 million in Series A funding.

The core offering is an intelligent procurement orchestration platform powered by Omnea AI. This platform simplifies intake and requests, automates approval workflows, and manages vendor onboarding and supplier processes. It also focuses on third- and fourth-party risk management, ensuring compliance and information security. The services offered by Omnicom Media Group include developing tailored media strategies, negotiating media purchases in digital, television, print, and outdoor advertising, and providing data-driven insights to enhance campaign effectiveness. They also specialize in digital media solutions, including social media and online video advertising. As part of Omnicom Group Inc., OMG benefits from a wide range of additional marketing services, enhancing its capabilities in the industry.

Founded in the UK, Oncimmune operates independently while benefiting from Alden Scientific's resources. The company has facilities in Dortmund, Germany, and Cambridge, Massachusetts, in addition to its UK base.

The core offering of Oncimmune is the ImmunoINSIGHTS platform, which is designed for discovering antibody and autoantibody biomarker signatures. This platform features one of the largest antigen libraries, advanced analytics powered by machine learning, high-sensitivity profiling capabilities, and multiplexing technology. Oncimmune's technology supports drug development optimization, early cancer detection, biomarker discovery, and precision medicine, making it a key player in advancing patient care and targeted therapies.

It focuses on connecting traditional asset trading with digital assets through EU-regulated spot trading, perpetual futures, and over-the-counter (OTC) services. The company rebranded from Bitpanda Pro in 2024, becoming the first MiFID II-regulated perpetual futures venue in the EU. It holds an OTF License in the Netherlands and a MiCAR license for crypto spot trading and custody.

The platform caters to both institutional and retail customers, allowing them to trade assets 24/7 without hidden fees or high margins. One Trading offers a vertically integrated platform that enhances returns through low spreads and deep liquidity. Its services include crypto spot trading with over 100 altcoins, cash-settled perpetual futures, and OTC trading. The company emphasizes regulatory compliance and transparency, publishing environmental datasets for its crypto assets. With a strong financial backing and partnerships, One Trading is positioned to serve a diverse range of traders across the EU.

The company aims to simplify the home buying and selling process by integrating various services into a single digital platform. It was established by Babek Ismayil, inspired by his own challenges in purchasing a home in London. OneDome has raised a total of $10.36 million in funding, with its latest Series A-II round bringing in $6.36 million.

The platform offers a range of services, including property search, estate agent engagement, mortgage advice, conveyancing services, and a HomeBuyer Service that combines these elements into a fixed-price package. OneTrust launched just ahead of GDPR implementation, targeting chief privacy officers and has since grown significantly.

The platform offers a range of capabilities, including privacy compliance automation, data governance, AI governance, and security management. It supports organizations in navigating complex compliance workflows with insights from legal experts across numerous jurisdictions. OneTrust serves over 10,000 customers, including a significant portion of the Fortune 100 and Fortune 500, and processes billions of consent transactions weekly. The company aims to simplify the car buying and financing process through technology and customer-centric services, emphasizing transparency and accessibility for various credit profiles.

Oodle offers used car finance primarily through hire purchase agreements, allowing customers to apply for pre-approval without impacting their credit scores. The company provides technology-driven credit assessments for quick decisions and personalized support. Oolio supports over 22,000 venues worldwide, combining decades of hospitality expertise into a unified platform that enhances operational efficiency and customer experiences.

The company provides an all-in-one cloud-based POS platform that manages orders, payments, inventory, and reporting from a single screen. Key features include self-ordering, kitchen displays, and delivery integrations with popular apps. Oolio Pay allows venues to process card transactions at no cost. The platform also includes venue-specific modules tailored for bars, quick-service restaurants, and high-volume stadiums, ensuring reliable support and streamlined operations. The organization is dedicated to creating a world free from animal suffering, focusing on ending the exploitation of farmed animals. Open Cages campaigns across several European countries, including Poland, Denmark, Norway, France, Bulgaria, and the UK.

The charity employs various strategies to promote animal welfare, including undercover investigations, public awareness campaigns, grassroots activism, corporate engagement, and legislative advocacy. Open Cages conducts investigations to expose factory farming practices and engages with businesses to improve their animal welfare policies. The organization has made a significant impact through notable campaigns, such as investigating Tesco's chicken supply chain and advocating for legislation requiring cameras in Spanish slaughterhouses. With a team of 25 dedicated individuals, Open Cages is recognized as one of the top four most effective NGOs for animals globally.

The company focuses on democratizing access to space through Earth observation and satellite communication missions. With nearly 55 employees, Open Cosmos operates from its headquarters at Harwell Campus and has facilities in Barcelona, Porto, and Greece.

The company offers three main services: OpenOrbit, an end-to-end mission management platform that oversees satellite missions from concept to in-orbit operations; OpenConstellation, a shared satellite infrastructure that enhances data accessibility and collaboration; and DataCosmos, a cloud-based platform that provides users with access to high-resolution satellite imagery and decision-making tools. The company emphasizes a patient-centric approach, focusing on delivering solutions that address complex healthcare challenges. OPEN Health offers services that include HEOR to assess the economic and clinical impact of products, market access support to navigate healthcare environments, and strategic medical communications for healthcare professionals and patients. Additionally, through its consulting arm, Acsel Health, it provides strategic consulting services to help clients innovate across therapeutic areas. OPEN Health is dedicated to enhancing patient outcomes and well-being by engaging patients throughout the product lifecycle.

Founded in 2004, the company focused on generating electricity from tidal streams and operated facilities in Dublin and Greenore, employing around 38 staff at its peak.

The company's flagship product was the open-centre tidal turbine, designed for seabed installation without surface structures. Key achievements included the installation of a 250 kW prototype at the EMEC tidal test site in 2006, which became the first tidal turbine connected to the UK national grid in 2008. Open Hydro provided comprehensive services for tidal energy projects, including turbine design, manufacturing, subsea deployment, and grid integration. The company was involved in various projects, including a planned 1 MW installation with Nova Scotia Power Inc. and advanced projects in Canada.

Founded in December 2015, it aims to advance AI technology in ways that benefit humanity, focusing on the development of safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI). The organization was established by notable figures including Sam Altman and Elon Musk, with significant early investments contributing to a $1 billion endowment.

OpenAI has developed several innovative AI tools, including the OpenAI Gym for reinforcement learning, the GPT series of language models, and DALL-E for text-to-image generation. The organization transitioned to a hybrid "capped-profit" model in 2019, allowing it to raise capital while maintaining its mission. OpenAI collaborates closely with Microsoft, leveraging Azure for its technologies and ensuring ethical development in the AI field. Its core mission emphasizes promoting AGI that benefits humanity while ensuring safety and ethical considerations are prioritized.

The company is known for its leading sportsbook technology platform, which is designed to handle high betting volumes, processing over 100,000 bets per minute with zero downtime.

The platform features a redundant systems architecture for reliability, automatic resource scaling during demand spikes, and real-time odds calculation and risk management. It also supports multi-currency and multi-language operations, making it suitable for global sports betting providers. OpenBet's commitment to high-performance infrastructure has positioned it as a key player in the sports betting technology sector.

It provides a real-time, composable, and autonomous foundation that lets financial institutions operate and innovate at Tier-1 scale — across any cloud, geography, or asset type. By turning the core from a bottleneck into a catalyst, OpenCoreOS abstracts away the complexity of security, scalability, and resilience, enabling banks and fintechs to build and deploy bank-grade applications with speed and confidence.

Built on an unbreakable foundation and powered by MARS, its autonomous SRE system, OpenCoreOS delivers unmatched uptime, auditability, and resilience. Aligned with BIAN service domains, it provides banks with a real-time, compliant, and self-healing core. The Command Center – "Cursor for Banking" – unifies monitoring, compliance, and configuration through natural-language interaction, enabling teams to model products or migrate cores conversationally. Supporting fiat and digital assets, including stablecoins and tokenized deposits, OpenCoreOS powers the next era of programmable, intelligent, and unbreakable finance.

The platform can automate up to 90% of interactions through natural language conversations across multiple channels, available 24/7. Founded in 2010 and based in Boston, Massachusetts, the company analyzes billions of data points daily to deliver insights that help telecommunications providers enhance network and subscriber performance. 

Opensignal specializes in network performance measurement, consumer and business subscriber behavior analysis, and sales operations support across various ecosystems. The company offers the OpenSignal app, which helps users find better phone signals and measures data speed and reliability. Additionally, Opensignal has developed several complementary applications, including WeatherSignal for real-time weather data, CrisisSignal for monitoring communication network status during emergencies, and WifiMapper for locating free Wi-Fi hotspots.

Opensignal serves major telecom companies worldwide and collaborates with media organizations to create interactive coverage maps. The company is backed by Berkshire Partners and has received investment from notable firms, including Qualcomm Ventures.

Recently acquired by Intrum, a leading credit management company in Europe, Ophelos aims to modernize debt collection through machine learning and customer-focused technology. The integration with Intrum enhances Ophelos's ability to scale its services across Europe, leveraging extensive debt data and regulatory expertise.

The platform offers a comprehensive digital engagement solution for debt resolution. It features personalized installment plans, machine learning-driven communications, and real-time analytics to support clients in managing customer financial well-being. This innovative approach allows for robust and efficient autonomy in machines without relying on traditional AI methods or extensive training. Founded in 2020, Opteran has grown from a decade-long research project and has secured approximately $25 million in funding.

The company's core technology, Opteran Mind, provides general-purpose autonomy for edge devices, enabling navigation in challenging environments. Key products include Opteran Sense for collision avoidance, Opteran Direct for SLAM, Opteran Decide for autonomous decision-making, and Opteran See for 360-degree vision. Opteran's solutions are designed for various applications, including mobile robotics, drones, and autonomous vehicles, with a focus on operating in GPS-denied and unstructured settings. The company collaborates with partners like Airbus and engages with automotive companies to enhance advanced driver assistance systems.

The company reported annual revenues of $42.44 billion in 2022 and employs around 143,000 people.

Oracle's product portfolio includes over 70 solutions, with its flagship Oracle Database being the first commercial RDBMS to utilize SQL for efficient data management. The company provides enterprise applications such as ERP and CRM, as well as cloud infrastructure and AI integrations. Red Bull Technology serves as the technical division, focusing on the design and development of F1 cars and innovations.

The team competes in Formula One with a strong emphasis on car development, race strategy, and driver management. It has established key technical partnerships with engine suppliers, including Renault and Honda, and currently develops its power units through Red Bull Powertrains. Under the guidance of design chief Adrian Newey, Red Bull Racing has produced aerodynamically advanced cars that have achieved significant success, including multiple championships from 2010 to 2013 and a resurgence in recent years with driver Max Verstappen. The team also collaborates with its sister team, Racing Bulls, to develop new driving talent.

Headquartered in Forres, Scotland, with additional facilities in Denmark, Orbex specializes in low-cost, low-carbon orbital launch services for the small satellite industry. The company is developing the Orbex Prime, a 19-meter micro-launch vehicle designed to deliver payloads of up to 150 kg to low Earth orbit. This vehicle features advanced materials and 3D-printed engines, utilizing renewable bio-propane propellant to significantly reduce carbon emissions.

Orbex operates from the Sutherland Spaceport, the world's first carbon-neutral spaceport, and aims to conduct up to 12 launches per year. The company has secured substantial funding to support its research and development efforts, with commercial launches targeted for 2025. Orbex emphasizes environmental leadership in aerospace and holds active patents for its rocket technology in Europe and the US. The company is recognized for its innovative approach and has received support from various governmental and industry partners.

Orbital connects various documents, maps, and historic deeds to create a comprehensive view of risks associated with properties.

The platform offers an end-to-end workflow that includes searching for and securely storing diligence data, visualizing properties through mapping, and using AI for quick and accurate analysis of documentation. Additionally, Orbital enables users to generate customizable reports and interactive site plans for easy client sharing. This integration of data visualization and AI-driven tools streamlines complex real estate analysis, making it easier for professionals to understand property details.
