The company specializes in full-stack photonic quantum computers that utilize single photons transmitted through optical fiber. This technology enables scalable and modular systems for applications in machine learning, optimization, and generative AI, while also working towards long-term fault-tolerant quantum computing.

Headquartered in London, ORCA has additional offices in Toronto and Austin. The company aims to make quantum computing accessible for industry and research experts through its innovative fiber-interconnected architecture, which operates at room temperature and integrates with standard tools like PyTorch and Python. ORCA has achieved significant milestones, including securing a £11.6 million UK government grant and deploying photonic quantum systems worldwide. Their offerings include PT-series photonic quantum machines and quantum accelerators, along with comprehensive software support and services for practical deployments across various sectors.

OrganOx is a medical technology company focused on advanced organ preservation devices. Founded in 2008 as a spin-out from the University of Oxford, it was established by engineering professor Constantin Coussios and transplant surgery professor Peter Friend. In 2025, OrganOx became a wholly owned subsidiary of Terumo Corporation following a significant acquisition.

The company is dedicated to improving outcomes for patients with organ failure. Its core mission is to enhance the availability of donor organs, addressing the critical need for transplants. OrganOx specializes in Normothermic Machine Perfusion (NMP) technology, with its flagship product, metra, being a liver NMP device. This device circulates warm, oxygenated fluid through the organ, allowing real-time assessment of organ function. It received FDA approval in 2021 and has been used in over 6,000 liver transplant procedures globally. OrganOx is also developing a kidney NMP device, with plans for commercialization around 2030.

Their mission is to enhance patient access to these therapies by addressing manufacturing challenges such as high costs and variability.

The company's main offering is the IRO® platform, which integrates automation, data analytics, and a benchtop cell processing system to streamline the manufacturing process. This platform supports various therapy types, initially focusing on cell therapies like CAR-T. Ori also launched the Lightspeed Early Access Program (LEAP) in 2022, providing select partners with pre-launch access to their technology. Ori Biotech has formed partnerships with organizations like Achilles Therapeutics and Hitachi Chemical, targeting therapy developers and contract manufacturers as key customer segments.

With a growing team of around 55 employees, Oxford Ionics is part of IonQ and plans to expand further.

The company has developed a patented Electronic Qubit Control technology that sets it apart from competitors. This innovative approach uses electronics integrated into silicon chips to control trapped-ion qubits, avoiding the errors associated with laser control. Oxford Ionics combines trapped-ion technology with semiconductor fabrication, achieving impressive quantum performance. Their full-stack quantum computing systems are designed for scalability, featuring field-upgradable Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) and compatibility with data center environments.

With over $100 million in funding from various investors, including Oxford University Innovation and the European Investment Bank, Oxford PV has grown significantly, expanding its team and capabilities.

The company specializes in perovskite-on-silicon tandem solar cells, which combine metal halide perovskites with silicon to enhance energy efficiency. Notable achievements include setting a 25% efficiency record for industrial-sized solar modules and a world record of 26.9% efficiency for residential solar panels. Oxford PV operates a production line in Brandenburg, Germany, and plans to scale manufacturing further. The company is committed to providing affordable clean energy and addressing climate change through innovative solar technology.

OUP publishes around 6,000 new titles annually, covering a wide range of academic, educational, and trade categories. Its offerings include journals, reference works like the Oxford English Dictionary, school textbooks, English Language Teaching materials, children's books, and music scores.

With a global presence, OUP has offices in various locations, including New York and Southern Africa. As a charitable organization, all profits from its publications support the University of Oxford's mission in scholarship, research, and education. Ozone API specializes in handling the complexities of regulations and technical implementation, delivering high-performance APIs with built-in consent management.

Key features include Confirmation of Payee, Verification of Payee, TPP management, strong customer authentication, and reporting suites. The platform integrates easily with core banking systems, enabling rapid compliance and supporting various financial services. Ozone API serves a diverse range of clients, including banks, central banks, and technology platforms, and is trusted for powering national infrastructures and shaping global standards.

Paragraf's key innovations include Graphene Hall Sensors, which are significantly more sensitive to magnetic fields than traditional sensors, and Graphene Field-Effect Transistors. The company has established partnerships with notable organizations such as CERN, Rolls-Royce, and the University of Cambridge. Pay Check Limited is a UK-based company specializing in fully managed payroll and pension services. Established in 1996, it serves over 1,500 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), accountants, and businesses across various industries, including high fashion, retail, hospitality, and financial services. The company is known for its bespoke, cost-effective solutions that enhance accuracy and ensure compliance.

Pay Check offers a range of services, including payroll processing, pension setup and management, PAYE registration, and statutory responsibility management. Their cloud-based ePay Portal allows for secure data submission and employee self-service, ensuring compliance with GDPR. The company integrates seamlessly with existing operations and provides proactive advice on legislative changes. With a focus on customer satisfaction, over 95% of their clients come from recommendations, reflecting their commitment to quality service.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Pay.UK is the operator and standards body for the UK's interbank retail payment systems. Established in 2009, it manages key payment systems such as Bacs, Faster Payments, and the Image Clearing System. Headquartered in London, Pay.UK processes around £20.3 billion of the UK's daily retail payments, ensuring secure and efficient money transfers for banks, building societies, and payment providers.

The organization also offers additional services like the Current Account Switch Service, Confirmation of Payee, and Request to Pay, which enhance the payment experience and security. As the standards authority, Pay.UK develops data-rich standards to promote safety, security, and interoperability in UK payments, working closely with the Bank of England to modernize payment formats and support innovation in the industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
PayFit is a cloud-based payroll and HR management software company founded in 2016 and based in Paris, France. It specializes in automating payroll and HR processes for small to medium-sized businesses (SMBs) in the UK and Europe. PayFit operates on a SaaS subscription model, with pricing starting at €68 per month, and serves over 20,000 SMBs by combining automated software with expert support.

The platform automates over 90% of manual payroll tasks, including payroll processing, HR management, leave and absence management, and expense management. It features an employee self-service portal and offers additional tools for benefits management, time tracking, and custom reporting. PayFit's hybrid model provides in-house control through cloud software along with dedicated payroll expert support, ensuring security with data encryption and AWS-hosted backups in France. The solution simplifies compliance with HMRC updates and significantly reduces payroll processing time, allowing businesses to focus on employee engagement and growth.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Paydock is a payments orchestration platform founded in 2015, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia, and additional operations in the UK. The company offers an API-first, low-code solution that simplifies payment processing, fraud detection, and identity verification through a unified interface. This platform is designed to meet the needs of merchants, fintechs, banks, and not-for-profit organizations, ensuring compliance and security while optimizing costs.

The platform provides rapid API connectivity to various payment systems, allowing users to manage multiple providers easily. It supports a range of services within the transaction lifecycle and is built to scale for enterprise use. Paydock has achieved significant milestones, including a £25 million Series A funding round in 2023, and has established a strong presence in sectors like e-commerce and retail. Notable clients include the UNHCR, WWF, and Coles Liquor, showcasing the platform's effectiveness and reliability in the payments landscape.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Payoneer Global Inc. is a financial technology company based in New York, founded in 2005. It specializes in cross-border payment solutions, facilitating global commerce for businesses and individuals in 190 countries. With a workforce of over 2,000 employees across more than 25 offices, Payoneer supports millions of customers, including small and medium-sized businesses, freelancers, and major global companies.

The company offers a multi-currency financial platform that includes services for payments and payouts, prepaid debit cards, merchant tools for online stores, and working capital advances. Payoneer emphasizes a technology-driven approach, providing localized support and features tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Its mission is to democratize access to global commerce, making international payments easier for underserved entrepreneurs.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Paysend is a global fintech company that specializes in cross-border money transfers and digital payments. Founded in 2017, it has grown to serve over 10 million registered customers with a team of more than 350 people across 30+ countries. The company aims to simplify international payments and operates what it describes as the world's largest instant digital payment network.

The core services offered by Paysend include the Paysend Consumer app, which allows individuals to send, request, and receive money in over 170 countries with quick transfers and low fees. For businesses, Paysend provides a B2B solution for secure global payouts through a single API integration. Additionally, the company offers a white-label solution for partners and a virtual bank card to enhance financial accessibility. Paysend connects to major card networks and local payment schemes, ensuring a broad reach and accessibility for both banked and unbanked populations.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Pear Bio is a computational biology and AI-enabled biotech company founded in 2017, with headquarters in London, UK, and Boston/Natick, Massachusetts. The company focuses on developing functional precision medicine platforms aimed at optimizing cancer treatment and drug discovery. Led by founder and CEO Duleek Ranatunga, Pear Bio integrates tissue engineering, confocal microscopy, and computer vision into a patient stratification tool that analyzes the human tumor microenvironment.

The company offers personalized testing services to predict effective therapies for individual patients, maintains a drug discovery pipeline targeting novel druggable options, and provides clinical trial support to match patients with experimental drugs. Pear Bio's technology is particularly focused on biomarker-negative cancers, including triple-negative breast cancer, and is expanding its clinical trials in breast and kidney cancer. With a team of 32 and recent funding of $15 million in Series A, Pear Bio is actively involved in advancing cancer treatment solutions.

Peavey Electronics Corporation, founded in 1965 by Hartley Peavey in Meridian, Mississippi, is a leading manufacturer and supplier of musical instruments, amplifiers, and professional audio systems. The company has grown significantly, distributing over 2,000 products to more than 130 countries. Peavey emphasizes innovation, quality, and affordability, adhering to the founder's philosophy of providing top-notch gear at fair prices.

Peavey produces a diverse range of products, including guitars, electronic keyboards, and high-power amplifiers. Notable innovations include the MediaMatrix system, a pioneering audio networking solution, and advancements in class-D power amplifier technology. The company has earned numerous awards for its contributions to the industry and holds over 180 patents worldwide. Peavey also operates its own advertising agency and maintains in-house production for many components, ensuring a high level of quality and reliability in its offerings.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Peckwater Brands is a London-based company founded in 2019 by Sam Martin and Leo Bradshaw. It specializes in creating and operating data-driven virtual food brands designed for delivery-only services. The company integrates its virtual restaurant concepts into existing restaurant kitchens, helping to optimize underused capacity and boost revenue. Peckwater Brands is recognized as Europe's largest virtual food brand operator, with over 5,300 live virtual restaurants across multiple countries, including the UK, France, Germany, and the USA.

The company offers a range of services, including brand creation, recipe development, marketing, and operational support. Its virtual food brands cover various categories, such as burgers and tacos, and are optimized for delivery platforms. Peckwater also provides a flexible franchise model for independent eateries and larger chains, allowing them to turn their kitchens into multi-franchise hubs. With a focus on enhancing delivery performance, Peckwater Brands aims to increase revenue and consumer choice for its partners in the hospitality industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Peer Group is a private limited company specialising in commercial and residential real estate. It owns and manages a wide-ranging portfolio in the office, retail, industrial and residential sectors.

Operating under the Chairmanship of Martin Birrane, during the last four decades, has built a portfolio of UK property which it manages in-house.

The Group's strategy is to secure growth through the considered asset management of the existing portfolio and the acquisition of carefully chosen investment and development opportunities.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Pelago is a virtual clinic focused on substance use management, collaborating with employers and health plans to provide personalized, evidence-based treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, and cannabis use. Founded by physicians, including CEO Yusuf Sherwani and COO Maroof Ahmed, Pelago aims to eliminate barriers to care through discreet, on-demand services that integrate seamlessly with existing health systems.

The clinic offers a range of services, including unlimited access to a physician-led care team, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), medication-assisted treatment (MAT), and remote monitoring tools. Pelago also provides access to vetted inpatient facilities and ensures compatibility with health plans and wellness platforms. The company emphasizes a personalized approach to treatment, resulting in significant reductions in substance use and substantial cost savings for employers. Pelago serves enterprises and health plans across the U.S., making it easier for organizations to support employee well-being.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Penfold is a UK-based fintech company that offers a digital workplace pension platform designed to simplify auto-enrolment pensions for individuals, self-employed workers, employees, and businesses. Launched in 2019, Penfold addresses retirement savings gaps, particularly for self-employed individuals, and has grown to serve over 100,000 users and thousands of businesses.

The platform provides workplace auto-enrolment pensions, allowing businesses to set up or switch pension plans quickly while ensuring compliance with UK regulations. It also offers flexible personal pensions with features like contribution management and investment performance tracking. Penfold emphasizes clarity and accessibility, aiming to make pension saving straightforward and engaging, with a focus on user-friendly support and transparency in savings growth. The company is backed by notable European fintech investors and operates with a team of 51-200 employees.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Penta Precision Engineering Ltd is a UK-based precision CNC machining company with over 25 years of experience. Founded by five machinists, the company specializes in manufacturing high-quality, high-tolerance, and complex machined components for various industries across the UK. Penta is ISO 9001:2015 accredited and Cyber Essentials certified, reflecting its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.The company offers a range of precision machining services, including 3, 4, and 5-axis CNC milling with 24/7 automation, as well as multi-axis CNC turning. They provide design-for-manufacture support to optimize product designs for efficient machining. Penta works with materials such as aluminium and plastics, producing everything from prototypes to full production quantities. Their team of in-house specialists ensures consistent quality and timely delivery, supported by modern CNC machinery and quick set tooling.Headquartered in Portsmouth, Hampshire, Penta employs around 27 people and generates approximately $7.1 million in revenue. The company has built a strong reputation for trust and excellence in the precision engineering sector.

companies.description:
PeopleCert is a global leader in the assessment, certification, and accreditation of professional skills and language competencies. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in London, the company has grown from a Greek examination provider to a multinational organization, delivering millions of exams in over 200 countries. With a workforce of around 862-1,000 employees from 40 nationalities, PeopleCert generates approximately $147.9 million in annual revenue.

The company offers a range of certifications and exams based on global standards, including ITIL® for IT service management, PRINCE2® for project management, and LANGUAGECERT® for language proficiency. PeopleCert also provides online proctored exams and assessment technology, supporting multiple languages and countries. Its services empower career advancement and organizational training, benefiting a significant number of Fortune 500 companies and government organizations worldwide.

Peppy Health Limited is a UK-based digital health company founded in 2018. It offers an employee healthcare benefit app that provides unlimited, confidential access to specialist clinicians. The app focuses on key life stages and underserved areas such as women's health, men's health, fertility, pregnancy and parenthood, and menopause, while also supporting lifestyle aspects like nutrition, fitness, and mental wellbeing.

Headquartered in London, Peppy operates in the UK, Ireland, and the United States. The company is certified as a B Corporation and emphasizes proactive, human-centered care to enhance employee wellbeing and organizational performance. Peppy supports over 3 million employees across more than 250 organizations, featuring a mobile app that allows for private consultations, live events, and a library of resources. Its services cater to diverse groups, ensuring robust clinical oversight and a comprehensive approach to health management.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Performanta is a global cybersecurity firm based in Maidenhead, United Kingdom. The company specializes in integrated security solutions, threat intelligence, and managed detection and response (MDR) services. Its mission is to enhance cyber safety for organizations through a combination of people, processes, and technology.

One of Performanta's key offerings is the Safe XDR service, which is the world's first AI-verified Extended Detection and Response platform. This service automates security tasks, reduces the time to remediate threats, and enhances visibility across attack surfaces. Performanta also provides a range of services including identity and access management, data protection, security compliance, cyber incident response, and cloud security services. Their consulting approach follows the APBRI cycle, focusing on assessment, planning, building, running, and improving security solutions.

With a team of over 150 security specialists, including former CISOs and CIOs, Performanta serves more than 500 customers and manages 2 million users. The company emphasizes its expertise and commitment to driving continual enhancements in cybersecurity practices.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Perfumer H is a British fragrance house founded in 2015 by Lyn Harris, a classically trained perfumer based in London. The brand focuses on the artisanal craft of perfume-making, emphasizing natural ingredients and sensory experiences. With six stores globally, including a flagship location in Marylebone, Perfumer H offers a range of products that include unique Eau de Parfum collections, bespoke fragrances, handblown glass candles, traditional incense, and pantry items.

Lyn Harris, recognized as England's first trained female perfumer, has a deep connection to scent, influenced by her childhood in the Scottish Highlands. She trained in Grasse, France, and collaborates with the family-owned fragrance manufacturer Robertet. Perfumer H is committed to ethical sourcing and sustainability, partnering with global communities and acclaimed creatives to ensure quality and artistry in every product. The brand's visual identity, crafted by Studio Frith, reflects a connection to nature and meticulous attention to detail.

Periodic Labs is an early-stage AI company dedicated to advancing scientific discovery through the development of AI scientists and autonomous laboratories. The company focuses on the physical sciences and materials research, aiming to enhance research capabilities by combining intelligent AI systems with hands-on experimentation. Their innovative approach involves generating new knowledge through hypothesis testing and analyzing high-volume experimental data.

Founded by a team with extensive experience in AI and scientific projects, Periodic Labs is supported by notable investors, including a16z, Felicis, and NVIDIA’s venture capital arm, NVentures. The company is committed to building AI systems that can conjecture models, conduct experiments, and learn from results, with a particular emphasis on materials discovery and industry applications. They also provide tailored solutions for specific industry challenges, such as assisting semiconductor manufacturers with data analysis and design iteration.

companies.description:
Perkbox is a global employee benefits and engagement platform that helps companies support, connect with, and celebrate their employees through a unified digital solution. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in London, Perkbox serves over 3,500 companies and millions of employees worldwide. In 2024, Perkbox merged with Vivup, enhancing its offerings and expertise in employee experience.

The Perkbox platform integrates five key areas: comprehensive employee benefits, mental health support, recognition and reward programs, discounts and offers, and tools for HR teams to manage employee experience programs. It is accessible via a mobile app and web interface, providing a seamless experience for users. The platform has received recognition for its advanced budget management tools and quick implementation.

Perkbox caters to a diverse range of clients, from small and medium enterprises to large multinational corporations, helping them harmonize their Employee Value Proposition across various locations. The company is backed by Great Hill Partners, a private equity firm focused on high-growth companies.

companies.description:
Perkins&Will is a global architecture and design firm founded in 1935 in Chicago, Illinois. With over 20 offices and more than 1,600 professionals, the firm focuses on creating transformative spaces in education, healthcare, and various other sectors. Guided by a philosophy that prioritizes people and societal goals, Perkins&Will has built a reputation for innovative, people-centered design.

The firm offers a wide range of services, including architecture, interior design, engineering, planning, and sustainability consulting. It is known for pioneering healthy workplace designs and has achieved notable certifications such as LEED-CI Platinum and WELL Platinum. Perkins&Will's portfolio features iconic projects like the Crow Island School, Rush University Medical Center, and Boeing International Headquarters, showcasing its expertise across educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and commercial buildings. The firm has received numerous awards for its design excellence and is recognized for its commitment to diversity and sustainable practices.

companies.description:
Perlego is a digital subscription platform founded in 2016 that offers unlimited access to over 1 million academic and professional books across more than 1,000 topics. It provides an affordable and sustainable alternative to traditional textbooks by partnering directly with publishers to reduce costs associated with print and distribution. Perlego aims to enhance the learning experience globally, support researchers, and promote inclusivity and sustainability.

The platform features a cross-device digital library accessible via desktop, mobile app, and tablet. Key offerings include Smart Search, which helps users find relevant content, curated Topic Indexes for various subjects, and a Read Aloud feature. Perlego offers two subscription plans: the Essential plan, which includes access to over 800,000 titles, and the Complete plan, which provides access to more than 1.4 million books along with advanced tools for research. Users can cancel their subscriptions at any time while retaining access until the end of the billing period.

companies.description:
Permutive is a privacy-first advertising technology company founded in 2014 and based in London, UK. The company offers a predictive data collaboration platform that helps publishers, advertisers, agencies, and retail media leaders unify first-party data for secure, cookie-less audience targeting and ad campaign management. With a focus on privacy compliance, Permutive's patented edge technology processes data directly on users' devices, ensuring no third-party cookies or personal information is shared.

The platform integrates a Data Management Platform (DMP), Data Clean Room, and Curation functionalities into a no-code, AI-driven solution. It enables real-time audience creation, segmentation, and targeting across various channels, including web, mobile, and connected TV. Permutive supports over $1 billion in ad spend for premium publishers and advertisers globally, facilitating secure collaboration and audience strategies without compromising user privacy. The platform also features tools for campaign management, compliance, and customizable reporting, empowering clients to optimize their advertising efforts effectively.

Personio is an HR technology company based in Munich, founded in 2015. It offers a cloud-based People Operating System designed for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with 10 to 5,000 employees. The platform digitizes and automates the entire employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, payroll, and offboarding. This helps HR teams streamline processes and focus on strategic initiatives.

The company has experienced significant growth, reaching over 12,000 customers in 70 countries by 2024. Personio's core offerings include core HR functions, recruiting and talent management, employee experience tools, and an automated payroll solution launched in 2023. The platform is designed to integrate with existing HR systems, making it a valuable resource for SMEs looking to enhance their HR operations. With offices in major cities like Berlin, London, and New York, Personio continues to expand its presence and support for businesses across Europe and beyond.

companies.description:
Perspectum Ltd is a global medical technology company that specializes in precision medicine through advanced imaging and AI-driven software. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Oxford, UK, the company focuses on improving diagnostics and care for patients with chronic metabolic diseases, including liver disease, diabetes, and cancer. With additional offices in the U.S., Portugal, and Singapore, Perspectum employs around 228 people and has raised significant funding to support its mission.

The company’s flagship product, CoverScan, is a multi-organ MRI technology that provides comprehensive diagnostics by capturing multiparametric mapping data. This technology enables non-invasive alternatives to biopsies and supports precision care by offering insights into organ inflammation and other biomarkers. Perspectum collaborates with healthcare providers globally, aiming to democratize access to high-quality care through its innovative imaging solutions.

companies.description:
PetsApp Ltd is a UK-based company that provides a client engagement and communication platform specifically designed for veterinary clinics. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in London, PetsApp enhances interactions between veterinary professionals and pet owners, aiming to improve patient advocacy. The company serves over 15,000 veterinary professionals worldwide, with 6.3 million pets registered on its platform.

The PetsApp platform includes a variety of features such as communication tools, appointment management, digital payment processing, and a customer relationship management system. It offers role-based text chat, video consultations, online booking, and automated reminders. Additionally, PetsApp provides insights for operational efficiency and client behavior analysis, along with community support through training resources and events. The integrated tools help streamline practice management, fostering loyalty and growth within veterinary practices.

companies.description:
Pexapark is an enterprise software and advisory company founded in 2017, focusing on renewable energy, particularly power purchase agreements (PPAs) and risk management. The company has supported over 30GW of renewable PPA transactions across Europe and the United States. Pexapark aims to accelerate the energy transition toward net zero by creating an efficient renewable energy market.

The company offers a comprehensive software platform for managing renewable energy investments, including tools for PPA pricing, deal execution, portfolio monitoring, and risk analytics. Pexapark also provides advisory services to assist with PPA transactions, strategy development, and market intelligence. Their offerings include daily PPA reference prices, educational resources, and market trend updates. With a team of over 100 employees, Pexapark is dedicated to digitizing the route to market for renewables, making it easier for energy players to execute deals and manage risks effectively.

Pharmacy2U Ltd is the UK's first and leading online pharmacy, established in 1999 and publicly launched in 2000. It operates as an NHS-approved mail-order pharmacy, delivering prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines, and personal care products directly to customers' homes.

The company offers a range of services, including electronic prescription requests, postal delivery of NHS prescriptions, and a selection of non-prescription health products. Pharmacy2U also provides a private online doctor service for confidential medical consultations and innovative digital services like prescription reminders and synchronization. Registered with the General Pharmaceutical Council and the Care Quality Commission, Pharmacy2U adheres to professional pharmaceutical standards and is managed by qualified pharmacists.

With over 350,000 electronic prescription service patients as of May 2019, Pharmacy2U has shown significant growth, dispensing over 621,000 prescription items in November 2019. The company has expanded its operations with a highly automated dispensary in Leicester, capable of processing up to 6.5 million prescription items monthly. Recent developments include the acquisition of the LloydsDirect business from LloydsPharmacy in October 2023.

companies.description:
Phasecraft is a London-based quantum computing company founded in 2018 as a spinout from University College London and the University of Bristol. The company specializes in developing advanced quantum algorithms and software that are hardware-agnostic, focusing on applications for near-term Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. With offices in London, Bristol, and Washington DC, Phasecraft employs around 30 leading researchers in quantum science and engineering.

The company offers quantum-enhanced optimization platforms and algorithms for various industries, including materials science, chemistry, energy, logistics, and optimization. Their solutions, such as the Mondrian platform, deliver significant efficiency gains for complex problem-solving. Phasecraft collaborates with major quantum hardware providers like Google Quantum AI, IBM, and Rigetti, allowing for real-time testing and refinement of their algorithms. Their commercial partnerships include notable organizations such as Johnson Matthey, Oxford PV, BT, and the UK National Energy System Operator.

Phoelex Ltd is a UK-based technology company founded in 2015, specializing in advanced connectivity solutions for high-speed data transmission. The company focuses on optical transceivers and opto-chiplets, which enhance data rates, reliability, and energy efficiency. Phoelex has developed innovations in silicon photonics and high-speed analog/digital design, targeting applications in compute, storage, data centers, cloud computing, AI, high-performance computing, and quantum computing.

The company has engaged in product development within semiconductor manufacturing and IT, operating as a seed-stage VC-backed startup. Phoelex has raised funding from investors such as Entrepreneur First and Octopus Ventures. Its products are designed to address connectivity challenges in data-intensive sectors, providing energy-efficient solutions for data center optical fiber network equipment.

Phoenix Equity Partners is a private equity firm based in London, established in 2001. The firm specializes in growth capital investments ranging from £10 million to £80 million in established, founder-led businesses in the UK and Ireland. Phoenix focuses on mid-market companies and targets sectors across Western Europe and North America. With a commitment to a people-first approach, the firm aims to nurture entrepreneurs and their teams, emphasizing collaboration and shared growth.

The firm concentrates on three main thematic areas: Data & Analytics, Technology & Specialist Services, and Health & Wellbeing. Phoenix has a strong track record, having completed 63 unique partnerships since its inception, and it combines deep sector expertise with hands-on support to help businesses achieve their goals. The firm has managed 11 closed funds, with its latest closures in 2024, and celebrates entrepreneurial milestones alongside its partners. Key personnel include experienced professionals in origination, finance, and investment management.

Phoenix Software Limited is a UK-based IT solutions provider that has been operating since 1990. Headquartered in Pocklington, York, the company specializes in managed services, software, hardware, and digital transformation technologies. It serves a diverse range of sectors, including defence, charities, and public services, with a customer base of over 3,300 organizations.

The company offers a variety of services, including IT managed services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, cyber security, and digital workplace tools. Phoenix focuses on modernizing infrastructure through partnerships with leading technology providers like Microsoft and Dell. Its solutions encompass software asset management, data center management, and tailored digital transformation strategies. With a commitment to employee wellbeing and a positive work environment, Phoenix Software Limited emphasizes integrity, collaboration, and customer passion in its operations.

PhysicsX is a physical AI company founded in 2019 and based in London, UK, with an additional office in New York. The company develops an AI-native platform that combines deep learning, physics simulation, and multiphysics inference to enhance engineering, manufacturing, and innovation in advanced industries. PhysicsX focuses on addressing global challenges such as climate transition and industrial resilience through AI-driven solutions that integrate simulation, data management, and model training.

The company offers an AI-native simulation software stack designed for engineering and manufacturing. This platform enables real-time multiphysics simulations, rapid iterations, automated optimization, and generative design exploration. PhysicsX provides enterprise solutions for sectors including aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy. With a team of around 140 professionals, PhysicsX has secured $135M in Series B funding and is recognized as one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK.

Piclo is a London-based technology company founded in 2013, specializing in an online marketplace for trading energy flexibility services. The company aims to support the transition to net-zero carbon emissions by enabling smarter and more sustainable electricity networks.

Piclo's cloud-based platform offers an end-to-end solution for system operators, renewable generators, and asset owners to procure and sell flexibility products, including demand response, battery storage, and electric vehicle charging. The platform, known as Piclo Flex, allows grid operators to manage flexibility procurement and provides tools for third-party sellers to bid on opportunities. Piclo operates in six countries, including the UK, Ireland, and the United States, and has secured funding to accelerate its international growth. 

The company collaborates with various partners, including Northern Powergrid and National Grid ESO, to enhance flexibility procurement and integrate renewable energy sources into the grid.

Picnic is a digital advertising technology company founded in 2017, focused on enhancing user experiences through high-quality ad formats across premium web inventory. The company utilizes its proprietary PIQ (Picnic Inventory Quality) data platform to ensure engaging ads that prioritize brand safety and improve return on investment for advertisers. The platform, launched in January 2024, employs machine learning and human expertise to assess webpage suitability, significantly increasing media attention and reducing ad waste.

Picnic offers a range of creative-led solutions, including managed and programmatic services with in-house creative optimization. Their ad formats include mobile-friendly options like Stories and Polls, designed to load quickly and maintain user engagement. The company provides various packages, such as PIQ Display and PIQ Video, which focus on delivering quality placements and cost-effective campaigns. Picnic also emphasizes cookieless targeting strategies and offers dedicated client success teams to support advertisers throughout their campaigns.

Pigment is an AI-powered business planning and performance management platform founded in 2019 and based in Paris, France. The company specializes in consolidating and aggregating large amounts of data in real-time, allowing organizations to design dynamic models and make informed strategic decisions across various departments. With around 380 employees, Pigment has raised $324.3 million in funding and generates approximately $79.8 million in annual revenue.

The platform offers an integrated planning solution that connects people, data, and processes. Key features include Agentic AI capabilities, financial planning tools, sales and HR planning, and supply chain planning. Pigment's technology consolidates data from multiple sources, ensuring data protection and privacy. The company serves finance, sales, and HR teams globally, with notable clients such as Unilever, Snowflake, and Figma. Pigment aims to enhance business planning and decision-making, positioning AI as a key element in democratizing access to data for all team members.

PillSorted is a UK-based delivery pharmacy founded in 2019, focusing on NHS and private prescription management. Headquartered in Cambridge, the company offers free home delivery, personalized care, and automated dispensing to assist patients managing multiple or urgent medications. Co-founded by Zeinab Ardeshir, a pharmacist with extensive experience, PillSorted aims to enhance patient interactions by automating routine tasks.

The company provides a range of services, including free prescription delivery, proactive medication management, and access to real pharmacists for consultations. Its technology-enabled approach ensures accurate and timely delivery of medications, particularly benefiting vulnerable patients and those on multiple prescriptions. PillSorted emphasizes a full-service pharmacy experience, combining personalized support with efficient service delivery.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

Ping Identity is a prominent provider of enterprise identity security solutions, established in 2002 and based in Denver, Colorado. The company specializes in identity and access management (IAM) for large organizations, managing over 3 billion identities globally and achieving 99.99% uptime. Ping Identity serves a diverse clientele, including more than half of the Fortune 100, with notable clients in banking, healthcare, aerospace, retail, and automotive sectors.

The company offers a comprehensive identity security platform designed for enterprise IT, featuring products such as PingFederate for federation, PingID for multi-factor authentication, and PingAccess for access management. Additional offerings include PingDirectory for identity storage and PingAuthorize for zero-trust policy enforcement. Ping Identity emphasizes innovation, with recent advancements in AI-driven threat detection and a strong commitment to security compliance. With a focus on customer experience and a high Net Promoter Score, Ping Identity is recognized as a leader in the access management space.

Pinnacom specialises in providing telephony and data services in remote locations for events and outside broadcasts etc. In doing this work the company has built considerable expertise in getting communications services to remote sites. 

Pinnacom has relationships with many carriers and data providers across the UK that allows the provision of data services to remote locations as well as cities, and operates as an Internet Service Provider to provide appropriate support levels for mission critical services.

The firm has grown through significant mergers and acquisitions, becoming one of the UK's largest law firms with over 1,500 lawyers and more than 430 partners. It operates across 28 offices in Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa, employing over 3,700 people.

The firm specializes in sectors such as construction, real estate, technology, energy, and infrastructure, providing both contentious and non-contentious legal advice. Pinsent Masons is recognized for its strong construction practice and has developed innovative tools like the SMART delivery method and Vario contract-lawyer services. It allows users to find inspiration, curate ideas, and shop products through a virtual pinboard system. Originally developed as an app to digitize paper catalogs, Pinterest pivoted to focus on image collection, quickly gaining popularity after its iOS app launch in 2011.

The platform serves over 553 million monthly active users, hosting 1.5 billion boards. Users can pin images or videos to personalized boards, making it easy to discover and save ideas for various projects like home decor, recipes, and fashion. Pinterest also offers features such as visual search and shoppable pins, enhancing the user experience. The company monetizes primarily through advertising, with Promoted Pins allowing brands to reach its engaged audience effectively.

Pion Inc. is a pharmaceutical technology company based in Billerica, Massachusetts. It specializes in innovative technologies and scientific expertise to support drug development and pharmaceutical formulation processes. Pion Inc. offers a range of analytical tools and services, including dissolution testers, ADME testing, bioavailability and bioequivalence testing, and formulation development services. Their solutions assist drug developers and formulation scientists in screening drug candidates and ensuring material consistency from bench to production scale.

Separately, Pion (We Are Pion) is a marketing and consumer insights company founded in 2005. It focuses on helping brands grow by leveraging insights and targeted advertising, particularly aimed at strategic consumer groups like students and Gen Z. Pion provides actionable insights, advertising campaigns, and verification services to engage and build loyalty with these demographics. The company serves over 3,500 brands across more than 100 countries, positioning itself as a partner for brands seeking to enhance their marketing strategies.

Pirum is a UK-based financial services technology company founded in June 2000 and headquartered in London. It serves as a centralized automation and connectivity hub for global securities finance activities, streamlining pre-trade, post-trade, and collateral management processes throughout the trade lifecycle. The company connects over 180 financial institutions and service providers, including 25 of the 30 global systemically important banks, processing more than USD 4.1 trillion in transactions daily.

Pirum offers a comprehensive suite of services that includes post-trade services, real-time solutions, trade connectivity, risk management tools, and regulatory reporting. Its key offerings, such as the Post Trade Services and Trade Risk Manager, enhance client profitability and market transparency while ensuring compliance with regulations. The company is recognized for its flexible integration capabilities and has received industry accolades, including the ISF 2020 Global Post Trade Service Provider of the Year award.

Pixability is a Boston-based video advertising technology company founded in 2008 by MIT graduate Bettina Hein. The company specializes in data-driven optimization of large-scale advertising campaigns across platforms such as YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and Connected TV. With a focus on sophisticated targeting and automated execution, Pixability has developed a comprehensive suite of video advertising software and services.

The company offers campaign optimization that leverages data science for precise audience targeting and performance measurement. Its automated tools for YouTube and Connected TV provide unified insights to enhance return on investment. Pixability is recognized for its advanced features, including brand suitability and verifiable viewability, making it a leader in managing video ad campaigns. With a workforce of around 83 employees and reported revenue of $38.4 million, Pixability has been acknowledged as one of America's fastest-growing private companies.

Pixie is a London-based company that offers cloud-based practice management software tailored for accounting and bookkeeping firms. The platform helps streamline workflows, manage client relationships, and automate administrative tasks, enhancing overall productivity for its users. With fewer than 25 employees, Pixie has raised under $5 million in funding.

The software features comprehensive tools for workflow management, client management, team collaboration, compliance, and reporting. It allows firms to break down workflows into manageable steps, centralize client data, and facilitate real-time communication among team members. Pixie also ensures compliance with legal requirements and provides secure cloud storage. Its flat-fee pricing model starts at $69 per month, making it accessible for firms of all sizes without additional per-user charges.

Plain is an AI-powered customer support platform designed for technical B2B teams. It focuses on API-first integrations and Slack-centric workflows to streamline support across various channels, including Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and chat. The platform consolidates customer interactions into a single inbox, providing instant context for efficient resolutions.

The core offering includes features like a unified inbox, AI-powered automation for conversation summaries and workflow management, and real-time insights for performance tracking. Plain also supports customer grouping and service level agreements (SLAs) to enhance the support experience. With customizable support portals and extensive integrations, it caters to fast-growing companies that prioritize developer experience and collaborative support.

PlanetWatchers is a geospatial analytics company based in London, UK, specializing in satellite imagery and machine learning for the crop insurance industry. Founded in 2016, the company aims to enhance policy data capture and claims validation, primarily serving North America's agricultural insurance market.

The company offers two main service categories: Acreage Reporting Services and Claims Validation Services. Acreage Reporting Services automate the collection and validation of acreage reports, while Claims Validation Services provide detailed crop damage maps to streamline field inspections and claims resolution. PlanetWatchers' primary application, CropCycle, delivers various reporting services, including planting dates and crop classification, along with advanced features like wind and flood damage detection.

PlanetWatchers utilizes advanced satellite imaging and data analytics, including Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) analysis, to deliver actionable insights. The company is committed to innovation and partnership, helping agricultural insurance providers and growers save time and resources while ensuring accurate data for the crop insurance sector.

Plasma is a Layer 1 blockchain focused on stablecoin transactions, designed for efficient global money movement. It offers sub-second settlement times and low or zero fees, making it ideal for cross-border payments and everyday financial services. The platform supports thousands of transactions per second and is built on a modular Ethereum execution client, ensuring robust security and performance.

Key offerings include instant stablecoin payments, a neobank app called Plasma One for managing digital dollars, and a compliance infrastructure that meets regulatory standards. Plasma also provides tools for smart accounts and security, enabling features like multisig wallets and asset management. The ecosystem supports various integrations with DeFi platforms, payment protocols, and analytics tools, targeting a wide range of users from remittance providers to corporate treasuries.

companies.description:
Plastic Energy is a global leader in chemical recycling, dedicated to transforming end-of-life plastic waste into valuable feedstock for new plastics. Founded in 2011 and based in London, the company operates as a privately-held industrial technology firm with a presence in the UK, Singapore, Malaysia, Spain, France, and remote locations. With around 200 employees, Plastic Energy focuses on creating a circular economy for plastics.

The company specializes in proprietary chemical recycling technology that converts unrecyclable plastic waste into hydrocarbon vapors, which are then condensed into a recycled feedstock called TACOIL. This feedstock serves as a sustainable alternative to fossil oils in plastic production, helping to divert waste from landfills and incineration. Plastic Energy operates two chemical recycling plants in Spain and has successfully sold TACOIL to manufacturers for producing virgin-quality recycled plastics. The company also collaborates with various governments and organizations to expand its impact in sustainable plastic production and waste management.

Playfair Capital is a London-based venture capital firm founded in 2013, focusing on pre-seed investments across the UK and Europe. The firm aims to support visionary founders building technology companies. Established by Federico Pirzio-Biroli, Playfair Capital combines the personal touch of angel investing with the resources of institutional funding. It has managed multiple funds, including a £57m Fund 3, and emphasizes emotional intelligence alongside financial capital in its investment approach.

The firm invests in ambitious founders across various sectors, including AdTech, CloudTech, E-Commerce, Developer Tools, and Fashion. Playfair typically writes checks ranging from £100k to £1.5m and provides expert support beyond funding, helping startups with discipline and tailored guidance. With a strong track record, Playfair has a high graduation rate from pre-seed to Series A and is recognized for its commitment to addressing gender imbalance in venture capital.

companies.description:
Pledge is an AI-driven platform that specializes in sustainable supply chain management. The company focuses on decarbonization, waste reduction, traceability, and ESG reporting for logistics emissions. Pledge offers tools that automate logistics data collection, supplier engagement, and emissions calculations across various transport modes, including sea, air, road, rail, and inland waterways. Its solutions comply with recognized standards such as the GLEC Framework and ISO 14083:2023.

After being acquired by Blue Yonder, Pledge integrates into comprehensive supply chain solutions, helping teams reduce Scope 3 emissions. Key offerings include emissions measurement and reporting, which converts shipment data into emissions calculations, and supplier engagement through the Pledge Network™ for real-time updates. The platform also supports seamless integrations with carbon accounting tools and provides targeted solutions for logistics service providers and shippers. Pledge empowers organizations to streamline data management and enhance sustainability efforts in their supply chains.

Plentific is a London-based real estate technology company founded in 2012 or 2013 by Cem Savas and Emre Kazan. The company offers an AI-powered software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform designed to optimize property operations in real-time. It connects landlords, property managers, contractors, service providers, and residents, addressing inefficiencies in traditional property management.

The platform provides solutions for work order management, workforce management, compliance management, and property repairs and maintenance. By using AI, Plentific enhances operational efficiency, matches local contractors to jobs, and improves accountability for both in-house teams and external partners. The company supports a wide range of sectors, including social housing, private rented sector, and letting agencies, aiming to deliver a high-quality resident experience. With over 300 employees and a presence in multiple countries, Plentific has raised approximately $142 million in funding and serves millions of properties worldwide.

Pleo is a financial technology company based in Copenhagen, founded in 2015. It offers a comprehensive spend management platform designed to streamline business spending for companies across Europe. Pleo provides smart company cards, expense tracking, accounts payable automation, and reimbursement solutions, empowering over 40,000 businesses in 16 European countries.

The platform operates as a B2B SaaS solution, giving employees spending autonomy while allowing finance teams to maintain real-time visibility and control. Pleo's core offerings include customizable company cards, automated expense management, and accounts payable automation, all integrated with popular accounting systems. The company aims to enhance spend management efficiency and reduce manual processes, ultimately saving finance teams significant time. With features like AI-powered analytics and multi-currency support, Pleo is focused on optimizing business spending and improving financial workflows.

Pliant is a European fintech company based in Berlin, Germany, founded in 2020. It specializes in providing an API-first platform for B2B payment solutions. Pliant enables businesses to issue both physical and virtual credit cards, track spending, and integrate financial data into their systems.

The company offers a range of products designed to optimize payment processes and enhance financial operations. Key offerings include customizable payment apps, a Pro API for scalable operations, a Cards-as-a-Service platform for issuing branded credit cards, and a Card OS solution for banks to launch innovative credit card programs. Pliant's modular platform supports seamless integration with existing finance stacks, making it a smart choice for businesses looking to streamline their payment processes.

The company focuses on creating interactive data applications and visualization tools for enterprises and data science teams. With a remote-first workforce of around 90 employees, Plotly has raised $8.3 million in funding.

The company offers a range of products, including open-source tools like Plotly.js, Plotly.py, and Dash, which are widely used for creating interactive graphs and web applications. Plotly's enterprise solution, Dash Enterprise, provides a platform for building and managing Dash applications with features like low-code editing and integration with major cloud services. Additionally, Plotly Studio is an emerging AI-native tool that helps users convert raw data into interactive applications quickly. Plotly's tools are utilized by millions globally, including Fortune 500 companies, research labs, and universities, supporting real-time data sharing and decision-making.

It specializes in a smart money app designed for automated personal finance management, savings, investments, and budgeting. The company is headquartered in London, with additional offices in Athens and Nicosia. Plum operates as a private limited company and focuses on activities related to financial intermediation.

The Plum app connects securely to users' bank accounts, allowing them to monitor spending, income, and expenses. It automates savings by setting aside spare money that users won't miss. Key offerings include automated savings tools, investment options with access to thousands of stocks and funds, and budgeting tools for tracking finances and comparing bills. Plum offers various subscription plans, including a free basic option and premium tiers with enhanced features. The company emphasizes AI-driven automation to simplify financial management for users ranging from beginners to advanced savers.

It specializes in curating a selective collection of short-term rental properties, including vacation homes and Airbnbs, across over 500 destinations in 29 countries. The platform features more than 30,000 rigorously vetted homes, making it one of the largest curated collections worldwide.

The company employs a unique, technology-driven curation process that combines an AI-powered algorithm with expert human review. Each property undergoes the "Plum Test," a comprehensive assessment of over 150 features, ensuring high standards for comfort and style. Plum Guide also offers a B2B service, Plum Guide ForBusiness, providing its curation technology to online booking platforms and hotel groups. The company targets discerning travelers seeking reliable and stylish vacation homes, and it has received industry recognition for its innovation and service quality.

Plumm's mission is to support both employees and businesses by providing accessible mental health and people management solutions.

The platform offers a comprehensive suite of services, including access to a global network of accredited therapists, therapy and coaching, self-help resources, and mood tracking tools. It also features HR management tools such as an Applicant Tracking System, Learning Management System, payroll management, and performance management tools. Additionally, Plumm includes AI-enhanced solutions like EMMA, a virtual assistant for HR tasks, and integrates with platforms like Microsoft Teams and Slack. The company focuses on transforming raw data into actionable insights using AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics, particularly in sports forecasting and betting markets. With around 9 employees, Pluto operates as a micro-entity and is classified under SIC code 63110 for data processing and related activities.

Headquartered in London, Pluto Data Analytics offers AI-powered predictive analytics validated in real-world betting scenarios across various sports. Their services include predictive sports analytics for game forecasting and player behavior, as well as advanced analytics for fraud detection and betting pattern analysis. The company emphasizes the use of deep datasets and advanced machine learning models, providing tools for sports clubs to enhance player shortlisting and transfer decisions. Founded in 2007, the firm focuses on areas such as environmental law, consumer protection, human rights, and product liability. With over 100 attorneys and 500 staff, Pogust Goodhead operates in multiple countries, including the UK, Brazil, and the US, representing millions of claimants worldwide.

The firm is known for handling significant class actions, including cases related to the Mariana dam disaster and the Volkswagen emissions scandal. The firm has over 3,000 employees and operates 18 offices worldwide, managing approximately $41.5 billion in assets as of October 2025. Originally established as SAC Capital Advisors in 1992, Point72 rebranded in 2014 and became a registered investment advisor in 2018, focusing on external capital.

The firm employs a diverse range of investment strategies, including fundamental equities, systematic trading, global macro, venture capital through Point72 Ventures, and private credit. With over 190 investing teams, Point72 emphasizes research-driven, risk-adjusted returns. The firm also runs the Point72 Academy, which trains recent graduates in equity analysis, fostering talent development within the organization.

Polaron is an AI startup based in Shoreditch, founded in November 2023 by Isaac Squires, Steve Kench, and Sam Cooper. The company emerged from research at Imperial College London and specializes in generative AI to enhance the design and optimization of advanced materials for sustainable applications, particularly in battery technology. Polaron aims to significantly reduce the time and cost associated with traditional material development methods, transforming processes that typically take years into mere days.

The company offers an AI platform for material design that can operate on customers' hardware or in the cloud, ensuring data privacy. Key features of the platform include rapid prototyping, enhanced characterization of materials, and optimization of manufacturing methods. Polaron's technology is material-agnostic, initially focusing on batteries but also expanding into alloys, composites, and catalysts. The company is in early commercial stages, collaborating with battery manufacturers to improve electric vehicle performance and is supported by prominent institutions in materials science and AI.

It offers a white-label, cloud-native digital experience platform designed to help banks provide merchant services and payment solutions for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). The company focuses on enhancing SMB banking and payments, enabling banks to effectively compete with fintechs through modular tools for merchant acquisition, onboarding, and growth.

With a global presence, Pollinate operates offices in London and Charlotte, employing between 51 and 200 people, including hybrid roles in South Africa. The company emphasizes secure and scalable technology, utilizing modern stacks like AI and cloud platforms to deliver real-time insights. Its core offerings include dynamic onboarding workflows, a unified merchant dashboard, embedded integrations, and modular mini-apps that enhance the merchant lifecycle. Pollinate partners with Tier 1 banks worldwide, with notable deployments such as Tyl by NatWest in the UK and Truist Merchant Engage in the US.

Founded in 2001, Polunin is an employee-owned value specialist managing c. $7.5bln in International and Emerging Markets equity portfolios on behalf of an  exclusively institutional client base.

We believe that markets are inherently cyclical and oscillate consistently around a secular trend driven by predictable human behaviour. Understanding cycles results in a knowledge-advantage vis-à-vis peers. Whilst we do not pretend to know the future, we do aim to tilt the odds of reaping asymmetric returns in our favour


Exploiting the profit potential of market cycles requires a disciplined investment approach. We combine proprietary valuation metrics that filter out market noise with an ability to be contrarian when the payoff for betting against consensus is overwhelmingly in our favour.

We believe that our distinctive investment process typically results in return and portfolio characteristics that offer significant diversification benefits.

It specializes in voice-first AI agents designed for enterprise contact centers, providing multilingual customer service experiences across various platforms. The company was established by a team with strong backgrounds in dialog systems from the University of Cambridge and experience at major tech companies like Apple, Google, and Facebook.

PolyAI's main product is Agent Studio, an omnichannel platform that allows businesses to design and deploy voice assistants. This platform leverages their proprietary large language model, Raven, which is optimized for real-time voice interactions. PolyAI supports high-volume calls in up to 12 languages and offers end-to-end services, including custom development and ongoing support. The company serves nearly 100 enterprise customers, helping them achieve significant improvements in customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

Established in 1972 in New Orleans, the UK branch focuses on authentic Southern cooking while adapting to local tastes. The company uses 100% fresh British chicken, marinated for 12 hours in a blend of Louisiana herbs and spices.

The menu features hand-breaded fried chicken known for its "shatter crunch" texture, along with sides like Cajun fries, biscuits, and signature sauces. Popeyes UK is expanding its presence across the country and offers delivery through third-party platforms. The brand emphasizes a family-friendly dining experience and promotes a vibrant, inclusive culture inspired by Mardi Gras. With a commitment to employee welfare and diversity, Popeyes UK aims to create a positive work environment while celebrating its rich culinary heritage.

It places a strong emphasis on investing in music rights and intellectual property within the entertainment industry.Pophouse manages music catalogues from renowned artists such as ABBA, Avicii, Swedish House Mafia, KISS, and Cyndi Lauper. Notable projects include the *ABBA Voyage* concert experience, a virtual avatar show, and the *Avicii Experience*, an interactive museum in Stockholm. Porotech is a UK-based semiconductor company focused on advanced microLED display technology. Founded in 2018 as a spin-out from the University of Cambridge, the company utilizes its proprietary porous gallium nitride (GaN) material platform, PoroGaN®, to create full-color RGB microLEDs from a single chip. Their DynamicPixelTuning® (DPT®) technology allows for color-tunable microLEDs, which can emit any visible color, including white.

Headquartered in Cambridgeshire, Porotech has expanded its operations with an R&D center in Taiwan and production facilities for epitaxial wafers and module assembly. The company offers a range of products, including SpectraCore™ for red microLEDs, custom GaN-based epiwafers, and light engine components for AR/VR displays. Porotech also provides technology consultancy to support mass production across various applications, including wearables and automotive electronics. The company is actively building partnerships to enhance its microLED supply chain, aiming for mass production readiness by 2025.

Founded in 1931 by Ferdinand Porsche, the company initially operated as an engineering consultancy before transitioning to vehicle production with the Porsche 356 in 1948. The iconic Porsche 911 debuted in 1964 and has become a hallmark of the brand, showcasing innovative engineering and performance.

Porsche's product lineup includes the 356, 911, Boxster, Cayenne, and Panamera, with a growing focus on hybrid and electric vehicles. The company emphasizes precision engineering and maintains in-house control over production processes. With a strong commitment to research and development, Porsche continues to advance sustainable technologies while maintaining a prominent presence in motorsports, boasting over 24,000 racing victories. The brand targets affluent buyers who seek luxury performance, supported by its affiliation with the Volkswagen Group and a global distribution network.

The company focuses on enabling engineering teams to create self-service experiences and automate workflows, providing a unified view of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). With around 175 employees, Port.io offers tools for platform engineering and DevOps, including a Context Lake for data consolidation, a software catalog for ecosystem modeling, and AI agents to streamline operations.

The platform emphasizes dynamic modeling to enhance self-service capabilities and support multi-domain engineering at scale. It helps managers track key metrics such as developer productivity and software quality while minimizing bottlenecks for developers. Port.io has raised $60 million in funding, including a recent $35 million Series B round, and is recognized for its innovative approach in the internal developer portal space. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company has grown to approximately 106-150 employees. PostHog's mission is to empower engineers to make product decisions through a unified Product OS that handles real-time analytics, supporting billions of events with sub-second queries.

The platform offers over 10 paid products, including product analytics, session replay, A/B testing, and feature flags. It integrates seamlessly with data warehouses, providing a comprehensive toolkit for product-led growth and customer data management. PostHog serves over 100,000 customers and has a user base of 190,000 to 250,000 teams, focusing on engineering-led startups and scaling companies. The company emphasizes developer-first tools and aims to build every piece of SaaS needed for product success.

The company specializes in developing and manufacturing flexible integrated circuits (FlexICs) that are cost-effective and sustainable. Their innovative platform allows for faster production cycles compared to traditional silicon chips, making it ideal for applications in Internet of Things (IoT) devices, smart packaging, and sensors.

The company operates the UK's first 300mm wafer fab in Durham, capable of producing billions of FlexICs annually. This facility emphasizes sustainability, utilizing thin-film semiconductors that reduce water and energy consumption. Pragmatic Semiconductor has raised over $400 million in funding and collaborates with various partners to advance its technology and expand its market reach. Their focus on enabling item-level intelligence positions them as a key player in industries that require real-time supply chain visibility and edge intelligence.

QUBIS Ltd proactively seeks to identify and evaluate commercially exploitable research and resources from Queen's University. Management and partners, who have appropriate skills and access to the market place, are then sought. All new ventures are market led and only those with strong feedback from the market place are actually undertaken. Our experience has shown that the support of a private or trade investor, particularly one who brings access to markets, eg. having an established distribution system or presence in a relevant market, is especially desirable.

The immediate objective of QUBIS Ltd as a holding company, is to establish an ongoing stream of dividend, or other income, from its investments. We are patient investors and all of our investments are undertaken for the medium to long term, we do not look for an early exit.

These technologies allow for label-free, single-particle measurement of molecular mass by analyzing light scattering from biomolecules and viral particles in their native solution state. This approach provides quick insights into various aspects such as purity, interactions, and sample characterization.

Refeyn offers a variety of mass photometers, including the TwoMP, OneMP, SamuxMP, and KaritroMP, along with the StreamlineMP software suite for data analysis. Originally established to produce munitions for the German Empire, it has evolved into the largest German and fifth-largest European arms manufacturer. The company specializes in a wide range of defense and civilian products, including armored fighting vehicles, munitions, and integrated systems for security and mobility.

Rheinmetall operates globally, with facilities in the U.S., India, and Germany. Its U.S. subsidiary, American Rheinmetall, focuses on delivering defense products tailored for the military. The company is committed to engineering excellence and innovation, serving both defense and civilian sectors while maintaining a strong emphasis on supporting warfighters and enhancing security capabilities.

Founded by world-leading scientists from Harvard University & the University of Cambridge, Ride’s unique technology platform provides an entirely new approach to solving the delivery challenge at the molecular level. Powered by micro- and nano-engineering coupled to advanced data science, Ride is building the capability to deliver any molecular cargo, to any cell type, with a tunable release profile.

companies.description:
Rightmove plc is the UK's largest online real estate property portal, connecting property seekers with estate agents, lettings agents, new home developers, and commercial property advertisers. Founded in 2000, Rightmove operates a website and mobile app that attract 18.5 million unique users each month, holding about 75% of the UK online property listings.

The company offers a two-sided platform with free search tools for consumers, including property listings and market insights, while providing paid services for over 20,000 advertisers. Core offerings include residential and commercial property listings, advertising products, and additional tools like tenant referencing and mortgage regulation support. Rightmove generates revenue primarily from charging professionals for listings and premium ads, with a reported revenue of £322.5 million in 2022. The company emphasizes a commitment to making property transactions easier and simpler for everyone.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
RightShip is a global digital maritime platform focused on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) solutions for the shipping industry. Founded in 2001 by BHP and Rio Tinto, the company is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, with additional offices in London, Houston, and Singapore. RightShip aims to enhance maritime safety, sustainability, and crew welfare through its innovative services.

The company offers a range of solutions, including vessel vetting and inspections, due diligence for risk management, and environmental products to reduce emissions. RightShip also provides safety and crew welfare solutions, leveraging advanced technologies to improve maritime operations. With a customer base of over 850 clients, including shipowners, charterers, and maritime insurance providers, RightShip is committed to achieving zero harm across the maritime value chain.

In addition to its core services, RightShip actively supports not-for-profit maritime organizations and engages in local community initiatives through charity partnerships. The company is dedicated to being a trusted partner in creating a safe and sustainable future for the maritime industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
RingCentral, Inc. is a global leader in cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for business communications. Founded in 1999 in Belmont, California, the company has transformed communications for distributed and mobile workforces. RingCentral pioneered cloud phone systems and went public in 2013. It has achieved significant growth, reaching $2.2 billion in revenue by 2023 and serving over 500,000 customers across 46 countries.

The company offers a comprehensive Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS) platform that includes cloud phone systems, team messaging, video meetings, and AI-powered tools. Key products include RingCentral MVP, an integrated communication solution, and RingCX, an AI Contact Center. The company also focuses on AI integration with tools like RingSense for conversation analytics and an AI Receptionist for call handling. With a global workforce of 8,000 and strategic partnerships with companies like AT&T and Microsoft, RingCentral provides flexible and cost-effective communication solutions for businesses of all sizes.
