companies.description:
Risk Ledger is a London-based cybersecurity company founded in 2018. It specializes in third-party risk management (TPRM) through a platform that helps organizations assess, monitor, and mitigate supply chain risks. The company aims to create a global network of connected organizations to enhance real-time detection and response to cyber threats. Led by CEO Haydn Brooks, Risk Ledger employs 63 people and generates £6.7 million in revenue.

The TPRM platform centralizes supplier security profiles, automates risk scoring, and provides real-time insights into supply chain risks. Key features include onboarding entire supply chains, access to pre-assessed suppliers, and an adaptive risk assessment framework. Risk Ledger serves various sectors, including public services, critical national infrastructure, financial services, and technology, supporting enterprises in managing complex vendor ecosystems. The company has been recognized for its innovative workplace culture and commitment to proactive supply chain security.

companies.description:
Riverlane is a quantum computing company based in Cambridge, United Kingdom, founded in 2016 by Steve Brierley. The company specializes in developing an error correction stack that enables fault-tolerant quantum computing by managing unstable qubits and correcting data errors. Riverlane was initially named River Lane Research LTD and rebranded in 2022 to reflect its focus on quantum error correction.

As a private limited company, Riverlane has raised a total of $120.43 million in funding, reaching Series C stage, with its latest funding round of $75 million occurring about 10 months prior to the latest data. The company collaborates with various technology and academic partners to tackle challenges in quantum computing, emphasizing the importance of error correction in achieving reliable quantum systems.

companies.description:
Robin AI is a London-based legal technology company founded in 2019. It specializes in AI-powered tools designed for contract review, drafting, analysis, and management. The company aims to enhance the efficiency of legal teams, enabling them to work up to 85% faster while ensuring human oversight. Robin AI has expanded significantly into the US market since 2024 and combines proprietary machine learning models trained on millions of legal documents with a "human-in-the-loop" approach for quality control.

The company offers modular AI software that functions as a Legal AI Assistant and copilot throughout the contract lifecycle. Key features include AI-suggested edits, clause checks, rapid Q&A, and the ability to analyze and summarize large volumes of contracts. Robin AI's platform supports both small and large firms, ensuring that legal professionals maintain control over AI-generated suggestions. The company has established partnerships with notable organizations, enhancing its capabilities and positioning itself as a vital resource for modern legal teams.

companies.description:
Robinhood Markets, Inc. is a financial technology company founded in 2013 by Stanford graduates Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Bhatt. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Robinhood aims to democratize access to financial markets by offering commission-free trading through a user-friendly mobile app. The company launched publicly in March 2015 as the first mobile-first brokerage in the U.S. with no minimum deposit, quickly gaining popularity and reaching 1 million users shortly after its debut.

Robinhood provides a digital platform for commission-free trading of stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), options, and cryptocurrencies. The platform also offers retirement accounts, crypto wallets, and credit cards, along with features like fractional shares to make investing more accessible. With a focus on retail investors, particularly millennials and Gen Z, Robinhood has influenced the industry by prompting competitors to eliminate trading fees. The company went public in July 2021 and has raised over $5.73 billion across multiple funding rounds, employing around 2,300 people as of 2024.

Roblox Corporation is a technology company based in San Mateo, California, founded in 2004 by David Baszucki and Erik Cassel. It operates an immersive online platform that allows users to create, play, learn, and connect through community-generated 3D experiences. The platform is particularly popular among users under 18, with a focus on community engagement and user-generated content.

Roblox's core offerings include a multiplayer environment with over 22 million user-generated games, a free desktop tool called Roblox Studio for building experiences, and advanced avatar and AI tools. The company supports a vibrant developer ecosystem, enabling creators to monetize their work through the Developer Exchange program. Roblox emphasizes safety and innovation in its communication features and has partnerships that extend its reach beyond digital experiences, such as toy lines with Jazwares. With a commitment to connecting billions of users, Roblox continues to enhance its platform and foster creativity among its global community.

Rocket Software is a U.S.-based software company founded in 1990 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. The company specializes in enterprise software that modernizes IT infrastructure across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments. With over 3,200 employees, including 1,750 software engineers, Rocket Software serves more than 12,500 customers globally, including many leading companies in various industries.

The company offers solutions that enhance data, applications, and infrastructure from legacy platforms, focusing on modernization, innovation, and operational efficiency. Its core offerings include support for IBM Z, IBM i, and cloud platforms, along with capabilities in application integration, predictive analytics, and IT system management. Rocket Software emphasizes seamless operations and security, enabling organizations to leverage existing technology while developing for AI and automation. The company has established strong partnerships, particularly with IBM, and plays a vital role in mission-critical sectors such as financial services, healthcare, and aerospace.

ROLI is a London-based music technology company founded in 2009 by Roland Lamb. The company focuses on creating innovative musical instruments and software that enhance how people learn, create, and experience music. With offices in London, New York, and Los Angeles, ROLI sells its products in over 40 countries.

ROLI's flagship hardware includes the Seaboard, a unique MIDI controller, and BLOCKS, modular music-making devices. The company also offers instruments like the ROLI Piano and LUMI, designed to make music learning engaging. On the software side, ROLI has developed a comprehensive ecosystem featuring apps like Noise, the Equator synthesizer, and educational services through ROLI Learn. ROLI collaborates with notable musicians and has appointed Pharrell Williams as Chief Creative Officer to guide product development.

Rolls-Royce Holdings plc is a British multinational engineering company founded in 1904 by Charles Stewart Rolls and Henry Royce. Initially known for luxury automobiles, the company has evolved into a global leader in designing, manufacturing, and distributing power systems for aviation, defense, and other industries. Its history includes significant milestones such as the introduction of the iconic Silver Ghost car and early involvement in aviation with the Eagle engine during World War I.

Today, Rolls-Royce focuses on power systems, providing advanced solutions like jet engines, gas turbines, and propulsion systems for various sectors, including aviation and marine. The company has a rich legacy of innovation and engineering excellence, with a registered office located in London.

RoslinCT is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) specializing in advanced cell and gene therapies. Founded in 2006 as a spin-out from the Roslin Institute, the company has grown to over 450 employees, primarily based in Scotland. RoslinCT operates 22 purpose-built cGMP suites in Edinburgh and Hopkinton, Massachusetts, supporting its comprehensive development-to-commercial manufacturing services.

The company offers a range of services, including process and analytical development, cGMP clinical and commercial manufacturing, and technology transfer. RoslinCT is recognized for its pioneering work in cell therapy, notably developing the first CRISPR-edited cell therapy approved in Great Britain. It partners with leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies, contributing to significant advancements in the field of regenerative medicine.

The company specializes in residential accommodations, including multi-family housing, purpose-built student accommodation, build-to-rent, co-living, and senior living. With a strong track record, it has managed over $13 billion in capital and transacted in more than 140,000 residential units and student housing beds.

The firm operates through a vertically integrated model, providing end-to-end real estate services. It emphasizes innovation, integration, and strong performance, leveraging deep sector expertise and local market insights. Round Hill Capital has a significant presence across Europe and the United States, with 14 offices in key locations. The company is also active in PropTech investments through Round Hill Ventures, focusing on digital transformation within the real estate sector.

Roundabout Ltd is a registered charity based in South Yorkshire, dedicated to supporting young people aged 16-25 who are homeless or at risk of homelessness. Founded in 1977 in Sheffield, the organization began with a small emergency hostel and has since expanded its services to provide high-quality housing and support. Roundabout serves over 380 young people daily, helping them develop skills and recognize opportunities to break the cycle of homelessness.

The charity offers a range of services, including emergency and medium-term accommodation, comprehensive advice, and life skills training. It also runs prevention programs to help young people maintain stable housing, particularly during challenging times. Roundabout collaborates with various organizations and engages the community to raise funds and support its mission, ensuring that young individuals have access to the resources they need for a better future.

Royal Museums Greenwich is a charitable organization based in the UK that operates four significant museums in Greenwich, London. These museums focus on Britain's maritime history, navigation, astronomy, and seafaring heritage. Established in 1934, the organization manages sites that include the National Maritime Museum, Queen's House, Royal Observatory, and Cutty Sark, all of which are part of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Maritime Greenwich site.

The National Maritime Museum houses over two million items related to maritime history, while the Queen's House features art collections in a historic Palladian building. The Royal Observatory marks the Prime Meridian and includes a planetarium, and the Cutty Sark showcases the history of maritime trade. The organization also hosts various exhibitions, community events, and educational programs, promoting public engagement with Britain's naval past and scientific achievements.

Runa is a global payments platform that offers infrastructure for real-time payouts, disbursements, and remittances through a single API. The platform enables businesses to send digital value, including virtual prepaid cards, bank transfers, gift cards, and wallets, to recipients in over 190 countries. Runa specializes in modern payout solutions, allowing instant money transfers in 40 currencies with features like real-time foreign exchange, reconciliation, and sub-second response times.

Runa provides a variety of payout options, including thousands of global choices such as prepaid cards, bank payouts, and crypto. The platform is designed for B2C payment senders, including loyalty platforms, gaming apps, and gig economy services. Key features include easy API integration, transparent pricing, and tools for rewards and recognition. Runa has successfully processed billions in payouts annually and is known for its reliability, with 99.999% uptime and robust security measures.

Runna is a personalized running training app that offers customized coaching and training plans for runners of all levels. Founded in 2021 and launched in March 2022, the London-based company has quickly grown to serve hundreds of thousands of users in over 180 countries. In April 2025, Runna was acquired by Strava, a well-known exercise-tracking platform.

The app provides tailored training plans for various distances, from 5K to ultramarathons, with durations ranging from 8 to 26 weeks. Users benefit from adaptive plans that adjust based on performance, a simple setup process, and integration with popular fitness devices like Garmin and Apple Watch. Runna also offers coaching support, community features, and multiple plan tiers for experienced runners. The app is available on both iOS and Android, allowing users to connect with others and share their progress. Runna has received recognition as a finalist for Apple's App of the Year in 2024 and maintains high ratings across various platforms.

Ruuby operates across multiple regions, including the United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Switzerland, and the South of France.

The core offering is an app that allows users to book a variety of beauty, spa, and wellness treatments from five-star providers. Services are available for private clients, corporate events, luxury hotels, and special occasions like weddings. Ruuby partners with top spas in London to provide access to spare appointments and extends its services through mobile professionals. Founded in 1860 by Henry Varnum Poor, the company has evolved significantly, particularly after the merger that created Standard & Poor's in 1941. It has grown from a niche provider of railroad data to a global leader serving various markets.

The company offers Essential Intelligence®, which combines data, technology, and expertise to provide insights for risk management and opportunities across global markets. Its divisions include Market Intelligence, Ratings, Commodities and Energy, and Private Markets, serving a diverse clientele that includes 100% of Fortune Global 100 and 80% of Fortune Global 500 companies. The firm, which rebranded from Evelyn Partners, operates independently following a 2024 investment from Apax Partners. With around 1,800 employees and over 120 partners, S&W has a presence in 15 towns and cities across the UK and the Republic of Ireland.

S&W is recognized as the fastest-growing firm among the top 10 accountancy firms in the UK, serving over 23,500 clients for 140 years. The firm specializes in a wide range of services, including accountancy, audit, tax, advisory, corporate finance, and digital services. Recent expansions include the acquisition of ClearViewIP for intellectual property advisory and Beechwood Partners in Ireland. S&W focuses on providing tailored solutions to mid-market businesses, growing enterprises, and private clients, emphasizing expertise, simplicity, and client success.

The company has around 28 employees and generates annual revenue of $6.3 million.

S64 offers a comprehensive technology platform that manages the full lifecycle of alternative assets. Key features include streamlined client onboarding, automated subscription management, and multi-jurisdiction regulatory reporting. The platform is designed with a modular architecture to cater to diverse client needs and incorporates AI and process automation for enhanced operational efficiency. S64 primarily serves private banks, asset managers, and wealth managers, enabling them to offer and manage alternative investments across various asset classes, including private equity, venture capital, and real estate. Headquartered in Walldorf, Germany, SAP has become one of the largest enterprise software companies in the world, specializing in real-time data processing and business application software. In 2021, the company reported revenues of €27.8 billion, ranking third in the industry behind Microsoft and Oracle.

SAP's core offerings include enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, which facilitates centralized data management and real-time information flow across organizations. Key products include SAP ERP, S/4HANA, and SAP HANA, an in-memory platform for analytics and data processing. The company also provides solutions like SAP NetWeaver for integration and SAP Fiori for user experience design. In addition to software, SAP offers services such as implementation, consulting, and training to support business transformations across various industries globally.

Operating under the name Securities API, SAPI focuses on loan-program-as-a-service to support business growth through revenue-based funding. With teams in London and Hanoi, it serves markets in the US, UK, and EU.

SAPI addresses challenges in business financing, such as regulatory complexity and capital shortages. Its mission is to foster small business growth globally, particularly for immigrant- and woman-owned businesses often overlooked by traditional banks. The company offers a range of services, including payment-linked advances, instant payouts, and custom loan programs, all designed to align with business cash flow. SAPI manages the entire process, from underwriting to collections, ensuring a seamless experience for partners and their customers.

The firm is regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is committed to sustainability, being a signatory to the UN Principles for Responsible Investment.

SDCL focuses on developing and investing in sustainable energy infrastructure projects. Their services include energy efficiency solutions such as LED lighting and HVAC systems, on-site generation like solar energy with storage, and decentralized energy solutions for commercial and public sector clients. Additionally, SDCL's investment banking division offers strategic financial advisory services in the energy, water, and waste sectors. The firm serves a diverse range of clients, including Citigroup, the UK National Health Service, and Tesco, and is actively involved in projects that support net-zero targets.

SPAICE is a technology company specializing in spatial-AI autonomy software for aircraft, drones, and satellites. Their software is designed to enable autonomous operations in complex 3D environments, addressing challenges in navigation, pose estimation, and environmental monitoring.

The company is led by a skilled team, including CEO Matteo Cuccorese, who has a strong background in aerospace engineering and AI, and CTO Guillem Garrofé Montoliu, an expert in computer science and robotics. SPAICE is focused on innovation in spatial AI and is actively seeking talent to join their mission-driven team.

companies.description:
SPOKE is a menswear brand founded in 2013, based in Richmond, England. The company specializes in custom-fit trousers and apparel, focusing on high-quality, sustainable legwear such as chinos and selvedge denim. With hundreds of size combinations available, SPOKE offers made-to-order products that provide a tailored fit without the traditional costs or wait times associated with bespoke tailoring. They back their products with a "Ridiculously Well Fit, or your money back" guarantee.

SPOKE's mission is to deliver the best-fitting menswear by addressing the common issue of poor fits in high-street clothing. Customers can use an online fit guide to measure themselves for personalized finishing. The brand operates through e-commerce, selling directly to consumers and emphasizing sustainability by sourcing from factories in Europe, the Near East, and Asia. With reported revenue of $6.9 million and a dedicated team, SPOKE aims to enhance men's confidence through well-fitting apparel.

companies.description:
SSE plc is a multinational energy company based in Perth, Scotland, specializing in low-carbon infrastructure. The company focuses on renewable energy sources, including onshore and offshore wind, hydropower, and efficient gas-fired generation. SSE also operates electricity transmission and distribution networks, providing energy products and services to a wide range of businesses.

With a history dating back to the 1880s, SSE has grown to become the UK's largest renewable energy generator, boasting a capacity of approximately 4.5 GW as of 2023. The company plans to invest £24 billion in renewables over the next decade. SSE operates across various segments, including electricity generation, gas distribution, and retail energy supply, serving over 9 million customers in Great Britain and 50,000 in Ireland. SSE Energy Solutions focuses on supporting nearly 350,000 business premises in the UK with decarbonization services.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
STITCH Editing is a media production company based in Santa Monica, California, with an additional office in Soho, London. Founded in 2010 by editors Leo King and Tim Hardy, the company specializes in film editing for various formats, including commercials, music videos, short films, and digital post-production. 

The company focuses on providing high-quality editing services in a creative environment, promoting collaboration and talent development. STITCH Editing also launched Homespun in 2014, a dedicated channel for music and short films that showcases emerging talent. With a team of 10-50 employees, STITCH Editing is committed to delivering exceptional work in the media production industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
SURE Solutions is a family-owned industrial refrigeration company, established in 2016 and based in Birkenhead, UK. The company specializes in energy-efficient refrigeration solutions using natural refrigerants like ammonia and CO2. With a team that boasts over 500 years of collective industry experience, SURE Solutions serves clients across the UK, offering flexibility by collaborating with preferred suppliers and subcontractors.

The company provides comprehensive turnkey solutions in areas such as meat processing, dairy, food and beverage, and cold storage. Their services include design, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of refrigeration systems, along with a catalogue of OEM spares and refrigerants. SURE Solutions is committed to sustainability and operational excellence, holding multiple ISO accreditations and engaging in green initiatives. They also offer 24/7 technical support and have received industry recognition for their innovative projects and practices.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: SWJ TECHNOLOGY, LLC is an engineering, planning, and project management company based in Tuscaloosa, Alabama. Founded in 2009, it has evolved through several name changes, becoming SWJ TECHNOLOGY in 2019. The company operates the Alberta Technology Center, which features an engineering lab managed by its subsidiary, NGE EQUIPMENT. This lab provides advanced measurement, prototyping, and specialty tool assembly services.The company specializes in helping various industries enhance their processes and products through engineering and project management solutions. Services include virtual planning, structural concept development, manufacturing process optimization, quality engineering, and supply chain management. SWJ TECHNOLOGY also offers consulting for process improvement and project execution. Its subsidiary, NGE EQUIPMENT, develops innovative specialty tools and equipment to support manufacturing operations. The company is committed to continuous learning and employee development, providing opportunities for skill enhancement and career growth.

Sabe Fluid Dynamics, operating as Sabe Technology Ltd, is a UK-based consultancy founded in July 2019 by Gerson Garsed-Brand. The company specializes in thermal and fluid dynamics, with a strong focus on computational fluid dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, and hydrodynamics. Headquartered in Silverstone Park, Northamptonshire, Sabe provides turn-key aerodynamic support, enhancing clients' engineering teams from initial analysis through development to final sign-off.

Sabe offers a range of services, including aerodynamics and CFD analysis for race car development, thermal and fluid dynamics simulations, and technology development across various sectors such as aerospace, automotive, and energy. The company emphasizes sustainability and collaborative partnerships, working closely with clients to improve processes and efficiency. With a team that includes experts with extensive experience in motorsport and engineering, Sabe is committed to delivering high-quality consultancy services tailored to meet specific client needs.

companies.description:
Sabio Group is a UK-based digital customer experience transformation company founded in 1998. Headquartered in London, it specializes in enhancing customer journeys through the integration of digital technology and human interactions. With a workforce of over 1,000 employees, Sabio serves clients in more than 65 countries and operates several subsidiary brands, including Sabio, Dvelp, and flexAnswer.

The company offers a wide range of services focused on customer experience optimization. These include AI and automation solutions, workforce management, contact center consultancy, and cloud transformation. Sabio also provides data analytics and business intelligence services, ensuring clients can make informed decisions. The company partners with leading technology providers like Avaya, Genesys, and Google to deliver effective solutions across various sectors, including banking, insurance, retail, and telecommunications.

companies.description:
Sable Bio is a London-based biotechnology startup founded in 2023. The company develops an AI-powered platform that provides predictive safety insights for drug targets, focusing on toxicology to enhance drug discovery and reduce clinical trial failures. Sable Bio leverages advanced AI, large language models, and domain expertise to analyze various biomedical data sources, addressing challenges in drug development such as safety assessments and data overload.

The core offering is the Sable Target Intelligence platform, which extracts signals from diverse data sources to deliver interpretable predictions and actionable recommendations on drug safety. This platform supports pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, researchers, and drug discovery teams in evaluating drug target safety. Sable Bio generates revenue through subscriptions, licenses, and potentially consulting services, while actively seeking partnerships with other companies and academic institutions to further its mission.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Safehinge Primera is a UK-based design and engineering company that specializes in innovative door safety solutions for mental health, education, and correctional environments. Founded in 2009 by Philip Ross and Martin Izod, the company has grown rapidly, doubling its revenues to £12 million and expanding its team to 75 employees by 2022. Safehinge Primera is recognized as one of the top suppliers of safe door systems for mental health hospitals, with a focus on both the UK and international markets, including the US and Australia.

The company designs a range of durable and hygienic door systems, including anti-ligature and anti-barricade solutions, as well as advanced locksets and alarm technologies. Their products are widely used in hospitals, schools, and secure care settings, with over 70% of UK Local Education Authorities and 80% of NHS Trusts utilizing their solutions. Safehinge Primera emphasizes collaboration with clinicians and architects to create safer environments, employing a six-stage co-production process to ensure their products meet the needs of high-risk settings.

companies.description:
Safi is a London-based company founded in 2021, previously known as TrueCircle. It operates an online platform that facilitates the global trade of recyclable materials within the recycling and waste management sector. The platform connects buyers and sellers worldwide, providing an end-to-end solution that emphasizes transparency, optimal pricing, and efficiency through AI-powered tools.

Safi's offerings include AI-powered quality control and matching, allowing users to photograph bales for quality assessment and pricing optimization. The trading platform provides access to a vast international network, streamlining order management, digital document signing, and transport arrangements. Additionally, it supports procurement teams with tools for transparency and hassle-free trading of feedstock recyclables. Safi aims to reduce manual processes and enhance access to the global market for recyclables.
companies.policy: The company is not currently offering visa sponsorship.

companies.description:
Sage Group plc, commonly known as Sage, is a multinational enterprise software company founded in 1981 in Newcastle upon Tyne, UK. The company specializes in accounting, payroll, HR, ERP, and business management solutions, primarily for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Sage has established itself as a global leader, serving millions of customers with both cloud-based and on-premise products, achieving recent revenue of £1.836 billion.

Sage's product offerings include a range of integrated software solutions for financial and operational management. This includes Sage 50 Accounts, Sage HR, and Sage Business Cloud, which provides 24/7 access to accounting and estimating tools. The company has also embraced emerging technologies, integrating AI across its products and launching Sage Earth for carbon accounting. With a mission to empower businesses through innovative software, Sage continues to support SMEs in simplifying processes and enhancing efficiency.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Sainsbury's (J Sainsbury plc) is a prominent British multinational retailer specializing in groceries. Founded in 1869 by John James Sainsbury and Mary Ann Sainsbury, the company began as a small shop in Covent Garden, London, focusing on high-quality fresh foods. Over the years, Sainsbury's has grown to become one of the UK's largest grocery retailers, known for its commitment to quality and value.

The company offers a wide range of grocery products, including fresh foods, packaged goods, own-brand items, frozen foods, bakery, dairy, meat, fish, and non-food items like wine. Sainsbury's operates through supermarkets, hypermarkets, and smaller formats, providing services such as self-service shopping and direct supplier deliveries. With a rich history of innovation, including the introduction of self-service retailing in the UK, Sainsbury's continues to emphasize affordable high-quality food shopping as a key aspect of its operations.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Salary Finance is a FinTech company based in London, founded in 2015 by Dan Cobley, Asesh Sarkar, and Daniel Shakhani. The company focuses on enhancing employee financial wellbeing through salary-linked products and services, partnering with over 600 employers, including 20% of the FTSE 100, to support more than 4.5 million employees in the UK and US.

The company offers a range of financial benefits, including affordable loans, salary-linked savings, pay advances, and financial education tools. These services are designed to reduce financial stress and improve overall employee wellbeing. Salary Finance emphasizes responsible lending by providing low-interest loans and financial education, helping employees manage their finances effectively. With a mission to promote financial health and happiness, Salary Finance has raised significant funding and is recognized for its social responsibility in the FinTech sector.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Salesforce is a leading American technology company founded in 1999, known for pioneering cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) software. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, Salesforce operates globally with offices in various countries, including Australia, India, Germany, the UK, Japan, France, Ireland, and Spain. The company serves businesses of all sizes, helping them achieve digital transformation through automation and customer-focused platforms.

Salesforce offers a comprehensive AI-powered CRM platform that is accessible from any device. Key components include Sales Cloud for automating sales processes, Service Cloud for customer support automation, and Marketing Cloud for managing marketing efforts. The company also provides various platform tools, such as Apex for data processing, Visualforce for custom user interfaces, and Salesforce Lightning for enhanced UI experiences. Additionally, Salesforce has developed mobile applications and a vibrant ecosystem through its AppExchange marketplace, which features a wide range of applications.

companies.description:
Salsify is a Boston-based software company founded in 2012 that specializes in Product Experience Management (PXM) and Commerce Experience Management (CommerceXM). The company helps brands, retailers, and distributors manage, syndicate, and optimize product content across various digital channels. With a workforce of over 400 employees and nearly 1,200 customers in more than 100 countries, Salsify has established itself as a leader in the industry.

The core offering of Salsify includes a PXM platform that centralizes product information and automates content syndication. This platform features Product Information Management (PIM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), and an Experience Builder for creating unified product experiences. The CommerceXM platform enhances collaboration across teams, tracks inventory, and provides sales performance analytics. Salsify's solutions support faster product launches and improved shopper experiences across e-commerce and social commerce platforms. The company also founded the Digital Shelf Institute to promote best practices in digital commerce.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description: Salvo1968 Ltd is a UK-based company that specializes in the wholesale and distribution of authentic Italian food products. Founded in 1968 by Salvatore Cumbo, it has grown from a small delicatessen in North London to one of the largest Italian food wholesalers in the UK. The company is known for its innovative approach, being the first sole importer of San Giorgio beer and the first UK importer of Italian flours specifically for pizza. Salvo1968 has exclusive partnerships, including one with Latteria Sorrentina to supply Fior di Latte cheese to UK food establishments.Operating from a modern distribution facility in Cheshunt, Hertfordshire, Salvo1968 serves a variety of foodservice organizations across the UK. Its product range includes essential Italian ingredients such as pizza flour, cheeses, charcuterie, pasta, sauces, frozen items, beverages, and confectionery. The company caters primarily to food industry professionals, including pubs, hotels, schools, and catering services, and offers next-day delivery in key locations like London, Manchester, and Bristol.

companies.description:
Samsara Inc. is a San Francisco-based IoT and cloud software company founded in 2015 by Sanjit Biswas and John Bicket. The company specializes in its Connected Operations Cloud platform, which digitizes physical operations across various industries, including transportation, construction, logistics, and manufacturing. Samsara initially focused on fleet telematics, launching its first Vehicle Gateway for real-time tracking of GPS location and vehicle diagnostics.

The Connected Operations Cloud integrates hardware like gateways and sensors with cloud software and AI to enhance operational efficiency and safety. Key offerings include vehicle telematics, AI-powered dashcams, and equipment monitoring tools. Samsara has grown significantly, serving over 20,000 customers and achieving over $1.2 billion in annual recurring revenue. The company has expanded globally, with offices in multiple cities, and is recognized for its impact on reducing CO2 emissions and improving operational practices across various sectors.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Samsung Electronics is a global leader in technology and consumer electronics, known for its wide range of products that include semiconductors, home appliances, telecommunications devices, and display technologies. Established in 1969 as a subsidiary of the Samsung Group, the company has evolved from manufacturing black-and-white televisions to becoming a prominent multinational technology conglomerate.

The product portfolio of Samsung Electronics encompasses consumer electronics such as televisions, washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners, and audio equipment. The company has made significant advancements in semiconductors, becoming the world's largest producer of memory chips. Samsung is also a major player in the mobile phone market, having introduced its first mobile phone in 1992 and producing over 800 million devices to date. Additionally, Samsung is recognized for its innovative display technology and offers information technology services through Samsung SDS. The company invests heavily in research and development to drive innovation across various industries.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Santander UK plc is a prominent retail and commercial bank in the United Kingdom, fully owned by Banco Santander. Established in 2010 through the merger of Abbey National plc, Bradford & Bingley, and Alliance & Leicester, the bank has its headquarters in London. It serves approximately 14 million active customers, including 7 million digital users, through 444 branches and 64 corporate business centers.

The bank operates across three main segments: Retail & Business Banking, Corporate & Commercial Banking, and Consumer Finance. It offers a range of products and services, including mortgages, consumer auto finance, unsecured loans, credit cards, and various banking and savings accounts. Santander UK positions itself as one of the largest providers of mortgages and savings in the UK, focusing on a "digital first with a human touch" approach to customer service. The bank emphasizes innovation, strong risk management, and community investment, aiming to create sustainable growth while delivering value to its customers and stakeholders.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Team Satchel is a UK-based education technology company founded in 2011 by Naimish Gohil, a former assistant headteacher. The company specializes in developing school management and learning platform software, with a focus on enhancing homework delivery and parental engagement. Team Satchel operates with around 54-64 employees and collaborates with over 4,500 schools worldwide, headquartered in London.

The company offers a range of software solutions, including Satchel One, a comprehensive learning platform, and Show My Homework, which helps track homework and engage parents. Their tools also encompass classroom management features, administrative functions, and a cloud-based Management Information System (MIS) that integrates with major providers. Team Satchel primarily serves secondary schools, sixth forms, colleges, and universities, aiming to streamline school processes and improve communication among educators, students, and parents. The company has received multiple awards for its contributions to the education sector.

companies.description:
Saturn is an AI-powered platform that automates compliance, back-office workflows, and investment research for wealth managers and financial advisory firms. The company focuses on providing data-driven solutions that enhance operational efficiency, allowing advisors to concentrate on client engagement and business growth. Saturn partners with over 650 advice firms in the wealth management industry and is headquartered in Liverpool Street, London.

The platform offers three main solution categories: Data Capture Solutions, which transform unstructured data into actionable insights; Workflow Solutions, which automate routine administrative tasks; and the Guardian Compliance Suite, which provides intelligent risk management technology for regulatory adherence. Saturn's technology is designed for scalability and seamless integration with major financial services platforms, ensuring security and operational efficiency for its users. The company supports over 1,000 advisers and fosters a community for knowledge sharing among partner firms.

companies.description:
Sauce Shop is a UK-based condiment company founded in 2014 by Pam and James Digva in Nottingham. The company specializes in craft sauces made with natural ingredients, fewer additives, and less sugar than mainstream options. It began in a home kitchen and has grown to become the UK's largest independent sauce brand, producing hundreds of thousands of bottles weekly at its Nottingham headquarters.

The company offers over 35 varieties of sauces, including hot sauces, ketchups, BBQ sauces, mayonnaises, cooking sauces, chili jams, and seasonings. Notable products include the Smoky Chipotle Ketchup and the award-winning Sriracha Chilli Sauce. Sauce Shop emphasizes small-batch production and in-house recipe development, focusing on bold flavors and high-quality ingredients. Its products are available nationwide in major UK supermarkets and independent food shops, as well as through special releases on Amazon.

companies.description:
Save the Children International is a leading independent children's organization, established in 1919 in Great Britain by Eglantyne Jebb and Dorothy Buxton. It operates globally with 29 national member organizations in over 100 countries. With more than a century of experience, the organization advocates for children's rights and welfare, evolving from its initial focus on humanitarian aid to a broader mission.

The organization provides a range of services, including health and survival initiatives, quality education programs, child protection during crises, community development projects, and rapid humanitarian response. Save the Children reaches tens of millions of children each year and has significantly contributed to reducing child mortality rates. With a strategic ambition for 2030, the organization aims to ensure that all children survive, learn, and are protected from violence. It primarily relies on private charitable contributions and employs innovative fundraising methods, such as child sponsorship programs.

companies.description:
Scaleup Finance is a fintech company based in Copenhagen, Denmark, founded in 2021 by Alexander Wulff, Nicolai Rasmussen, Patrick Jørgensen, and Thorbjorn Ronje. The company specializes in providing fractional CFO services and operates a technology platform called Nume, designed to simplify financial management for startups and growing scaleups.

The company offers a subscription-based solution that combines expert CFO support with smart automation. This helps clients streamline financial processes, moving away from traditional spreadsheet-heavy methods. Scaleup Finance provides services such as strategic financial planning, automated reporting, liquidity management, and day-to-day operations like bookkeeping and payroll. With around 90-100 employees and two global offices, Scaleup Finance serves 250 clients, primarily in the UK and Denmark, focusing on the unique needs of scaleups in the seed funding stage.

companies.description: Scarlet is an independent certifying organization focused on regulatory compliance for medical software and devices. It is designated as an EU Notified Body under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and a UK Approved Body under UK Medical Devices Regulations. Scarlet specializes in the safe and compliant deployment of software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) and AI-driven healthcare technologies.  The company offers regulatory certification services for EU MDR and UKCA/CE marking, as well as compliance support through ISO 13485 certification for quality management systems in medical device manufacturing. Scarlet also provides guidance on intellectual property, ensuring clients adhere to strict usage policies for certification marks.  As Europe's only Notified Body dedicated exclusively to software and AI medical devices, Scarlet streamlines certification processes and enforces rigorous compliance standards. Its clients include developers of medical software and AI technologies seeking regulatory approval in the EU and UK, enabling them to deliver compliant software updates, particularly for life-saving technologies.

companies.description:
ScienceMachine is a London-based AI startup founded in 2024, led by CEO Lorenzo Sani and a team including Benjamin Tenmann, Henry E. Miller, Matthew Greenig, and Bo Wang. The company specializes in developing AI-driven bioinformatics platforms aimed at enhancing scientific research through rapid and cost-effective data analysis.

The core product, Sam, is an autonomous AI agent that automates end-to-end workflows in biotech and biomedical data analysis. It processes raw data, generates reports, and integrates seamlessly with existing client tools and databases. Sam is designed to handle various tasks, including flow cytometry data analysis, mass spectrometry, RNA-seq visualization, and image segmentation. ScienceMachine emphasizes security, ensuring that client data remains private and encrypted.

In July 2025, ScienceMachine raised $3.5 million in pre-seed funding, positioning itself as a leader in AI automation for biotech. The company operates on a subscription-based model, offering customized AI solutions and enterprise features that include expert human support and a free demo option.

companies.description:
Sciensus is a global life sciences company focused on patient access, engagement, and support solutions within the European healthcare ecosystem. Founded in 1992 and based in London, the company rebranded from Healthcare at Home LTD to Sciensus in 2022. With operations in 25 countries, Sciensus supports over 300,000 patients annually and has a robust infrastructure that includes European headquarters in Switzerland and a distribution hub in the Netherlands.

The company offers a wide range of services throughout the product lifecycle, including patient engagement programs, medication coordination, home-based clinical administration, and drug compounding services. Sciensus specializes in supporting patients with chronic diseases, cancer, and rare diseases, distributing approximately 2 billion drugs annually across more than 50 therapeutic areas. They partner with over 3,000 pharmacies and hospitals, and their innovative digital solutions enhance patient interactions, supporting over 130,000 active patients.

companies.description:
Scissero Ltd. is a UK-based legal tech company founded in 2018. It combines AI technology with experienced lawyers to provide efficient legal solutions for financial institutions and their legal departments. The company focuses on addressing transactional, compliance, and operational challenges, aiming to empower clients with human-AI hybrid legal solutions.

Scissero offers several proprietary platforms and tools. MIKE, a virtual paralegal, assists with document drafting, management, and legal research. Scissero GPT is an AI chatbot that automates legal documentation and supports various legal tasks. The Portfolio and Compliance Platform helps manage compliance questionnaires and audits, as well as supports portfolio management. Scissero emphasizes a customer-centric approach and innovative pricing to deliver cost savings while maintaining a diverse and inclusive team across its offices in the US, EMEA, and APAC regions.

Scopely is a global interactive entertainment company based in Culver City, California, founded in 2011. It specializes in creating, publishing, and live-operating immersive games across mobile, web, and PC platforms. With a workforce of around 2,000 employees, Scopely operates in over a dozen markets worldwide, including significant hubs in Barcelona, Spain.

The company has achieved notable success with its portfolio of top-grossing games, including *MONOPOLY GO!*, *Stumble Guys*, and *MARVEL Strike Force*. Scopely's proprietary platform, Playgami, supports its game development and marketing efforts, fostering a player-focused approach. The company has received numerous accolades, including recognition as one of Fast Company’s “World’s Most Innovative Companies” and TIME100 Most Influential Companies for 2024-2025. Scopely continues to grow through strategic acquisitions and investments, enhancing its position in the mobile gaming industry.

Scotch Partners LLP is a consulting engineering firm based in London, UK, specializing in building engineering services. Founded in 2012, the company focuses on delivering sustainable design solutions for high-performing buildings. It operates in the architecture, engineering, and design sector, with expertise in mechanical, electrical, and public health (MEP) engineering, sustainability, acoustics, and building physics.

The firm provides integrated consulting services that emphasize energy efficiency and net-zero carbon solutions. Scotch Partners serves various sectors, including science research, education, and residential co-living, applying its technical knowledge to create future-proof buildings. The company is committed to fostering a strong company culture and building lasting client partnerships while maintaining a hands-on approach to project delivery.

companies.description:
The Scottish Legal Complaints Commission (SLCC) is an independent public body in Scotland that manages complaints against legal practitioners, including solicitors, advocates, and licensed conveyancers. Established in 2008 under the Legal Profession and Legal Aid (Scotland) Act, the SLCC aims to provide a fair and accessible service to the public, funded by an annual levy on legal professionals.

The SLCC investigates service complaints and can award compensation up to £20,000. For serious conduct complaints, it refers cases to relevant professional bodies for further investigation. The organization also promotes best practices in the legal sector, oversees complaint handling by professional bodies, and conducts data analysis to identify trends in complaints. Its services are free for consumers, ensuring that everyone has access to a fair complaint resolution process.

Screenloop is an AI-native applicant tracking system (ATS) and talent operations platform founded in 2021 and based in London, England. It is designed to streamline the hiring process for startups, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and scaling businesses. The platform combines an ATS with AI-powered tools for candidate sourcing, interview analysis, and automation of tasks like reference checks and background verification, making hiring faster and more efficient.

The company employs around 25 people across various countries, including the UK, Portugal, Brazil, Ukraine, and India, and promotes a remote-first culture. Screenloop offers a comprehensive platform that includes features such as applicant tracking, interview intelligence, candidate feedback tracking, automated background checks, data analytics, interviewer training, and AI assistance. These tools aim to enhance hiring efficiency and improve candidate evaluations while ensuring enterprise security and user-friendly interfaces.

Seamflow is a British software startup founded by Yusufhan Kircova and Konstantin Klingler. The company develops an AI infrastructure layer designed to connect the physical world, enhancing innovation, certification processes, and capacity scaling in industries such as aerospace, healthcare, and energy. As a B2B SaaS provider, Seamflow focuses on streamlining physical-world processes through AI workflows.

Incorporated on July 2, 2025, as SEAMFLOW LTD., the company is based in London, England, with an additional office in San Francisco, California. Seamflow has raised $4.5 million from five investors and operates with a small team of eight employees. The company aims to reduce time-to-decision, increase throughput, and optimize expertise by automating routine tasks and improving process efficiency.

Searchable Limited, founded in 2025, specializes in helping marketing teams optimize for the "agentic web" through its expertise in SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). The company is co-founded by Chris Donnelly, a seasoned entrepreneur known for scaling successful businesses. Searchable focuses on capital-efficient operations and growth through established playbooks.

The company offers a platform featuring a comprehensive scoring system that evaluates site optimization across various metrics, including Technical Score, Content Score, and AEO Score. It also provides guides for getting products listed in ChatGPT Shopping, detailing steps for optimizing product feeds and enhancing visibility in AI-driven searches. Searchable maintains an AI Usage Policy that emphasizes editorial standards and guidelines for generative AI use.

Searchland is a UK-based PropTech company founded in 2020, specializing in a SaaS platform designed for sourcing, assessing, and acquiring off-market development sites. The platform integrates property data, mapping tools, and outreach automation to streamline the land sourcing process. Headquartered in London, Searchland has grown rapidly since its launch in 2021, following participation in the Geovation Accelerator Programme.

The core platform features intuitive, map-based tools that aggregate various UK datasets for land identification and analysis. Key functionalities include AI-powered sourcing, site assessment tools, and outreach automation, which help users engage directly with landowners. Searchland serves over 1,500 customers, including property developers, architects, planners, and renewable energy firms, providing them with the resources to navigate competitive markets effectively. The company aims to evolve into a comprehensive CRM-like platform for the property sector.

companies.description:
Seat Unique is a UK-based premium ticketing and hospitality platform founded in 2018 by Robin Sherry and Philippa Hicks. The company connects fans with official premium tickets, VIP experiences, and hospitality packages for live events in sports, music, and culture. It operates as an online marketplace, partnering with clubs, promoters, venues, and rights holders to provide secure access to premium live experiences.

The platform emphasizes fan protection and fair access, aiming to make memorable moments more accessible. Seat Unique has experienced significant growth, achieving a 7,921% revenue increase over four years and ranking among the fastest-growing tech startups in the UK and Ireland. Its core offering includes a digital platform for booking official hospitality packages and curated premium experiences at major events. Recent expansions include the acquisition of Circuit Hospitality, enhancing its offerings at UK events. The company collaborates with renowned venues and sports clubs, including Wembley Stadium and Manchester United, to provide premium access across the UK and beyond.

companies.description:
Seatfrog is a London-based technology company founded in 2016 that operates a SaaS mobile app designed to enhance rail travel. The app allows passengers to bid on first-class upgrades, purchase tickets, and switch train times in real-time. By addressing the issue of underutilized first-class seats, Seatfrog helps rail operators monetize empty premium seats while improving the travel experience for passengers.

The core offering of Semarion is the SemaCyte® platform, which includes mobile, barcoded microcarriers designed to enhance cell-based assays. These microcarriers support cell movement and can be integrated into existing workflows, improving flexibility and efficiency in drug screening processes. The platform features various components, such as the SemaCyte® Cell Assaying Microcarriers and the SemaCyte® Multiplexing Platform, which facilitate high-throughput screening and high-content imaging while maintaining cell morphology. With a team of around 230 employees, Signal AI generates approximately $31.5 million in revenue. Its AI engine, AIQ, processes millions of documents daily to provide insights on trends, risks, and opportunities. This hub uses standardized templates to streamline accounting workflows, ensuring faster and more accurate compliance.

The firm provides legal services in various highly regulated sectors, including asset management, energy, healthcare, and technology. It employs a sector-focused approach and utilizes AI and legal technology to enhance its services. The Solutions International Practice Group consists of data scientists and developers who create innovative legal solutions, while Simmons Wavelength operates as a regulated firm of legal engineers. The company offers a variety of business finance solutions tailored to SMEs, including asset finance, invoice finance, commercial mortgages, and specialist lending options. Simply Asset Finance has funded over 8,000 customers, providing more than £750 million through the British Business Bank's ENABLE Funding programme and surpassing £1 billion in total lending. The company has grown significantly, reaching milestones of over one million global customers and 750,000 active policies in the UK by 2021.

Operating as an online brokerage, Simply Business uses technology and data to provide tailored insurance policies quickly. It offers a variety of products, including public liability insurance, professional indemnity insurance, employers' liability insurance, and landlord insurance. The company is committed to supporting small businesses and has initiatives like the Big Dreams Project, aiming to help 10,000 small businesses start or grow by 2030. Simply Business has received recognition for its customer service and was awarded Insurance Provider of the Year at the British Small Business Awards in 2017.

SimplyPhi is a UK-based certified B Corporation founded in 2014, focused on technology-driven solutions for affordable housing. The company partners with public sector bodies to source, acquire, renovate, and manage properties at scale. Headquartered in Woking, England, with an office in Indore, India, SimplyPhi employs a team of 40 specialists in property, finance, technology, and public sector housing.

SimplyPhi provides comprehensive services for local authorities, housing associations, charities, and investors. Their offerings include property sourcing and acquisition, transaction and project management, renovation and retrofitting, and stock optimization. The company utilizes proprietary software like SimplyFind, a property search engine, and Iris, which manages acquisitions and renovations. SimplyPhi has successfully delivered over 500 affordable homes and aims to reach 1,000 homes by 2025, emphasizing collaboration and partnerships to address the UK housing crisis.

Simpplr is an AI-powered employee experience platform founded in 2014, headquartered in Redwood City, California, with additional offices in the UK, Canada, and India. The company focuses on unifying employee engagement, enablement, and services management to create personalized experiences that enhance productivity and business performance. Simpplr has experienced significant growth, employing around 498-549 people and generating $82.6 million in revenue in 2024.

The company's flagship product, Simpplr One™, is a modern intranet platform designed to replace traditional systems with AI-driven features. It facilitates seamless communication, social connections, document search, and real-time employee sentiment analysis. Simpplr integrates various tools into a single interface, personalizing experiences for distributed workforces and measuring organizational alignment. With over 2 million active users and a high customer retention rate of 95%, Simpplr is recognized as a leader in intranet and employee experience solutions, earning accolades such as #1 in the 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Intranet Packaged Solutions.

Simprints is a non-profit technology company that develops open-source biometric identification hardware and software. Its mission is to enable accurate identity verification in low-resource, offline environments, primarily for NGOs, governments, and researchers focused on poverty alleviation in regions like South Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, and the Pacific. Originating from a Cambridge University research project, Simprints has become a global provider of affordable biometric tools, with over 3.5 million people enrolled across 17 countries.

The company offers a suite of integrated biometric tools, including the SimprintsID app for fingerprint and face scanning, rugged biometric hardware like the Vero Scanner, and configurable biometric algorithms. Simprints also provides backend services for project setup, data aggregation, and analytics. Its solutions are designed to ensure that resources such as vaccines and aid reach the intended recipients, emphasizing privacy and interoperability. Simprints collaborates with various partners to implement its technology effectively, supporting health, humanitarian aid, and development initiatives.

Founded in 2011 and originally known as MemSQL, the company rebranded in 2020. It supports real-time processing and various data models, including structured, JSON, time-series, vector, full-text, and geospatial data.

Sixfold Bioscience is a biotechnology company based in London, founded in 2018. It specializes in RNA therapeutics delivery systems, utilizing AI-driven methods to enhance precision medicine. The company operates from the Translation and Innovation Hub at Imperial College London and has a team of approximately 20 to 27 staff members. Sixfold has received funding from Y Combinator, venture capital, and various grants, including Innovate UK and Horizon2020.

The core technology of Sixfold is the Mergo® platform, a patented system designed for systemic RNA delivery. This modular platform employs AI to create nanoparticles that improve tissue targeting, safety, and efficacy. It supports both siRNA and mRNA payloads and has shown promising results in preclinical studies for RNA delivery. Sixfold is focused on therapeutic development, particularly in oncology, and collaborates with several academic institutions and industry partners to advance its projects. The company aims to license its delivery systems for clinical applications, expanding its impact in the field of biotechnology.

Sizewell C is a nuclear power station project located on the Suffolk coast in the UK. It features two European Pressurized Reactor (EPR) units with a combined capacity of 3.2 GW, capable of generating low-carbon electricity for approximately 6 million homes. The project aims to enhance energy security in the UK and reduce CO2 emissions by about 9 million tonnes annually over a 60-year lifespan.

Managed by Sizewell C Limited, the project is primarily owned by EDF Energy and the UK government, following a buy-out of China General Nuclear Power Group's share. The estimated cost of the project is GBP 38 billion, utilizing a Regulated Asset Base (RAB) funding model to attract private investment and manage costs effectively. Construction is set to begin in 2024, with operations targeted for 2030. Sizewell C is expected to support around 70,000 jobs across UK supply chains and contribute approximately GBP 4 billion to the regional economy over its lifetime.

Skin Analytics is a UK-based healthtech company founded in 2012, specializing in AI-powered medical devices for skin cancer detection. Its primary platform, DERM (Deep Ensemble for the Recognition of Malignancy), utilizes machine learning to analyze skin lesions, identifying malignant, pre-malignant, and benign cases, including melanoma. The company is dedicated to improving patient outcomes and accelerating diagnosis through innovative skin cancer pathways, while also reducing the burden on health systems like the NHS.

The DERM AI platform supports teledermatology and patient triaging, helping to prioritize cases that require dermatologist attention. Skin Analytics has established partnerships with five NHS Trusts, deploying DERM in 25 locations and processing over 25,000 patient cases. The company is headquartered in Cambridge, England, and has a team of around 30 employees. With a focus on expanding internationally, Skin Analytics aims to address dermatology capacity challenges in various health systems.

It provides TV, broadband, and mobile services to over 11 million homes, primarily in the UK and Ireland. Headquartered in Osterley, West London, Sky emphasizes innovation in technology and high-quality content, offering products like Sky Glass, Sky Stream, and Sky Q.

Sky's services include integrated TV packages, ultrafast broadband recognized as the UK's fastest, and mobile plans. The company produces original content, including popular shows and sports programming, and is committed to sustainability and diversity initiatives. Sky aims to become Europe's first net zero carbon entertainment company by 2030 and invests significantly in community impact and representation. The company focuses on developing and operating vertiports, which are specialized landing infrastructures for electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. These vertiports are essential for the emerging electric air taxi industry, enabling safe and efficient urban air transport.

Skyports offers various services, including vertiport development, operational management, and drone services. They design and build vertiports that adhere to industry best practices, ensuring optimal performance for eVTOL operations. Additionally, Skyports manages the operational aspects of these facilities and utilizes drone technology to enhance logistics and data capture across multiple sectors.

The company collaborates with key partners in the AAM industry, including Joby Aviation, Volocopter, Wisk, and Groupe ADP, to advance the integration of vertiports and eVTOL technology. Skyports operates globally, with notable locations in London, Paris, and Singapore, where they test and demonstrate innovative solutions for urban air mobility.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, Skyral focuses on serving government, defense, national security, and enterprise sectors. The company develops immersive synthetic environments, digital twins, and data fusion tools to help decision-makers navigate complex scenarios and identify risks.

The Skyral Core ecosystem includes products like Mirror, Phantom, and Shadow, which support strategic modeling, uncertainty management, and the creation of synthetic environments. These tools enable virtual testing of policies and infrastructure changes, enhancing decision-making across various domains, including urban environments and crisis response. Skyral also offers collaborative technology partnership services to help organizations explore options and gain insights from data.

Skyral's clients include Western defense and national security organizations, UK/US government departments, and NATO partners. The company emphasizes secure and interoperable solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing systems, ensuring minimal disruption for its users.

Skyscanner offers a free metasearch engine that aggregates options for flights, hotels, and car rentals, directing users to providers for reservations. Key features include comprehensive flight searches, hotel booking options, and car rental integration. The platform also provides innovative tools like "Search Everywhere" for finding the cheapest destinations and Price Alerts for tracking fare changes. Slamcore spun out from Imperial College London in 2017 and has grown to employ around 44 people, raising nearly $25 million in funding from notable investors including Amadeus Capital and Toyota Ventures.

Slamcore offers an SDK that integrates visual-SLAM, sensor fusion, and AI to enhance spatial intelligence in various products. Key offerings include Slamcore Aware, a solution for factories and warehouses that improves safety and efficiency by tracking vehicles and detecting people and assets, and Slamcore Alert, which provides real-time alerts to operators. The app was originally launched as Picaboo by Stanford University students Evan Spiegel, Bobby Murphy, and Reggie Brown, before being renamed Snapchat. The company rebranded to Snap Inc. in 2016 to expand its focus beyond the app into camera technology.

Snapchat serves a young demographic and offers features such as Stories, direct messaging, and AR filters. The company also provides an advertising platform with AI-powered tools and developer resources for AR experiences. The app connects to users' bank accounts and credit cards, analyzing transaction data to deliver tailored recommendations, known as "Snoops." Key features include spending breakdowns, alerts for auto-renewals, and suggestions for switching services to save money.

The company has experienced significant growth, with over 1.2 million app installations and a strong user base. The clinic focuses on affordable, preventative care, providing services such as wellness and sick visits, vaccinations, neutering, and basic diagnostics. This model encourages regular check-ups, similar to a gym membership, and aims to address 85% of typical pet needs without high-tech procedures.

Snoots operates from a modern clinic designed with natural materials and greenery, enhancing the overall experience for pet owners. The platform provides a range of capabilities, including event collection and validation, data modeling and analytics, real-time data activation, and identity enrichment. Snyk employs around 1,400 people and achieved unicorn status in 2020, with significant revenue growth projected to exceed $300 million in 2025.

Snyk offers a range of products designed to identify and fix vulnerabilities throughout the software development lifecycle. Key offerings include Snyk Open Source for managing open-source dependencies, Snyk Container for securing container images, Snyk Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for cloud infrastructure configurations, and Snyk Code for static application security testing. The company is dedicated to helping organizations integrate social value into their business practices, emphasizing the importance of balancing people, planet, and profit. As a Certified B Corporation since August 2022, Social Value Portal is committed to promoting social, economic, and environmental wellbeing.

The company offers an online platform that enables organizations to measure and manage their social impact in line with the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012. Key features include measurement and monitoring capabilities, non-financial and financial data reporting, and the TOM System, which is a leading standard for measuring and reporting social value. Sweaty Betty aims to empower women through fitness and community, promoting a spirit of self-expression and confidence.

The brand offers a range of premium activewear and lifestyle apparel, including bestselling Power Leggings and award-winning Zero Gravity Run Tights. Their products are designed for various activities such as HIIT, yoga, and running, featuring technical fabrics and supportive shapes. The platform integrates various communication tools into a single solution, allowing for real-time updates, reporting, and data management. Key features include site-to-office connectivity, flexible pricing for projects of all sizes, and a freemium model to support digitally underserved teams. Synthace aims to streamline lab processes, allowing scientists to focus on their research rather than manual tasks.

The core product is an AI video generator that transforms text and documents into professional videos featuring realistic AI avatars and voiceovers in over 140 languages. Key features include real-time collaboration tools, automatic translation, and brand customization options. The platform supports various use cases, such as training videos, marketing content, and customer service tools. 

In addition to its technology, Synthesia offers professional services to enhance user adoption and return on investment. The platform utilizes agentic AI and generative AI to create high-fidelity test data and automate test case generation across various IT environments. Key services include producing realistic datasets, applying intelligent data masking for compliance, and enabling self-service access to anonymized data. Synthesized also offers dynamic data refresh and predictive maintenance to improve data quality and accelerate cloud migrations. Founded in 2021, the company evolved from Orbit Discovery Ltd and is supported by seed funding from Oxford Science Enterprises. T-Cypher holds exclusive licenses from The University of Oxford for its innovative high-throughput technology that connects T-cell repertoires to disease-specific targets.

The company utilizes a proprietary automated high-throughput microfluidic discovery platform to create target screening libraries and identify T-cell clones from patient disease tissues. T-Cypher's technology, including the T-Cα platform, aims to discover and validate druggable targets for solid tumors. The company is developing a pipeline of TCR-based therapeutics, with plans to initiate clinical studies by the end of 2026. Their building insulation materials meet fire-safety and performance criteria, making them suitable for construction applications. The platform features a modular, plug-and-play vision AI system that includes physical AI agents for tasks such as product counting, quality inspection, and label verification. It allows for real-time monitoring and automation without requiring changes to existing production lines. Thingtrax also offers no-code tools for customizing AI agents and integrates with various ERP systems for comprehensive performance tracking. The company focuses on providing tailored solutions through factory audits and hands-on coaching to help clients optimize their operations and reduce waste.

The company specializes in online one-to-one math tutoring services, which are designed to enhance traditional teaching methods. These personalized sessions utilize intelligent online assessments to identify individual learning gaps, allowing specialist math tutors to focus on developing students' reasoning and problem-solving skills. Third Space Learning also offers a variety of math intervention programs for primary and secondary schools, covering essential topics like division, multiplication, and time tables. Schools using these programs gain access to the Third Space Maths Hub, a comprehensive online resource library. The company has successfully partnered with over 2,000 schools, supporting more than 64,000 pupils, with a significant focus on assisting disadvantaged students.

Its technology combines AI, biometric checks, and human expertise to streamline compliance processes for regulated businesses in the legal, property, accounting, and financial sectors.

With a mission to combat fraud and ensure compliance, Thirdfort has gained the trust of over 1,500 regulated businesses and has verified more than 3 million individuals. The company provides a suite of tools, including document verification, ongoing monitoring, and real-time screening for politically exposed persons. Its user-friendly app and web platform allow clients to complete verifications digitally, significantly reducing turnaround times. Thirdfort's innovative solutions help professionals navigate the challenges of rising fraud and compliance burdens, particularly in property transactions.

The agency provides a range of services, including design and architectural planning, fitout and construction, furniture and furnishings, technology integration, and managed services. By serving both building owners and tenants, Thirdway fosters a feedback loop that enhances its market insights and ensures relevant outcomes. The firm believes that well-designed offices not only boost productivity but also shape company culture and inspire creativity.

As an employee-owned business, all 181 employees are co-owners, fostering a culture of engagement and performance.

The company offers a wide range of services, including tailored business insurance solutions, personal insurance coverage, employee benefits programs, and comprehensive wealth management advice. It also provides health and safety consultancy and employment law services to support compliance and dispute resolution. The core services offered by Thomas Miller include management services for transport and professional indemnity insurance mutuals, managing general agency operations, and professional services such as technical, legal, captive, and claims management. The company also provides investment management for its own entities and other institutions. A key focus area is marine insurance, particularly Protection & Indemnity (P&I) services, through its Specialty Underwriting Agency.

Thomas Miller emphasizes building long-term relationships with clients, ensuring that their culture and governance prioritize client needs. The company's mutual management businesses are central to its operations, supported by owned businesses that enhance service offerings and generate returns for shareholders.

Formed in 2008 through the merger of The Thomson Corporation and Reuters Group PLC, the company combines expertise in legal and financial information with a strong heritage dating back to 1851.

The company offers a range of services, including legal information solutions, financial data and news, tax and accounting resources, compliance services, scientific research information, and media services. Thomson Reuters also provides AI-powered tools designed to streamline workflows for professionals. With a commitment to objectivity and accuracy, the company aims to empower its clients to navigate complex landscapes and make informed decisions.

The company operates globally, with offices in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. Thorogood emphasizes collaboration, ethical standards, and holds certifications like ISO 27001 for information security.

The firm offers a range of services, including data analytics, AI-driven applications, business intelligence, and consulting tailored to complex business challenges. Key offerings involve developing scalable analytics tools for sales data and market trend analysis, creating custom solutions for supply chain management and sustainability reporting, and forming analytics task forces for executive briefings. Thorogood supports ESG initiatives and prioritizes long-term scalability in its solutions, ensuring they deliver meaningful business outcomes. The company serves notable clients across various sectors, including consumer packaged goods, manufacturing, financial services, and insurance.
