Thought Machine is a London-based company that specializes in cloud-native banking technology. Founded in 2014 by Paul Taylor, it focuses on modern core banking and payments platforms. The company's flagship product, the Vault platform, allows banks and fintechs to create flexible financial products using smart contracts and real-time data. Thought Machine operates globally, with offices in major cities including New York, Singapore, Sydney, and Melbourne.

The company has achieved significant milestones, including multiple funding rounds that have raised substantial capital, leading to a valuation of $2.7 billion in 2022. Thought Machine's offerings include Vault Core, which supports the creation of financial products, and Vault Payments, designed for processing global payments. Its technology is utilized by a range of clients, including major banks and fintechs, and it collaborates with partners like McKinsey and Mastercard to enhance banking solutions.

ThoughtRiver is a legal technology company based in Cambridge, United Kingdom, founded in 2016. The company specializes in AI-powered contract review and analysis, aimed at automating legal document processing for in-house legal teams, law firms, and businesses. ThoughtRiver's software utilizes machine learning and natural language processing to enhance contract pre-screening, risk assessment, and insights extraction, significantly reducing review times while maintaining high accuracy.

The flagship product, Lexible®, is a large language model trained by expert lawyers, achieving over 97% accuracy in identifying risks and providing instant answers to contract questions. ThoughtRiver also offers the Contract Acceleration Platform (CAP), which automates contract scans and management, enhancing collaboration and minimizing risks across various sectors, including legal, finance, and real estate. The company has raised approximately $10.77M in funding and employs around 37 people, focusing on delivering efficient solutions for contract management.

ThoughtSpot is a technology company founded in 2012, specializing in a search- and AI-driven analytics platform. The platform is designed to make data accessible to business users through intuitive, natural language search, allowing for self-service analytics without the need for data analysts. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, ThoughtSpot also has offices in Seattle, London, and Bangalore, where it plans to establish an AI Center of Excellence.

The company's core offering is the Modern Analytics Cloud, a cloud-based SaaS platform that supports search-driven, AI-powered analytics. Key features include natural language search for analyzing large datasets, connectivity to various data sources, and embedded analytics for seamless integration into business processes. ThoughtSpot has achieved significant traction, with over 3 million user searches annually and substantial savings in analyst hours and labor costs. The company serves enterprise customers, including many Fortune 500 companies, and has experienced impressive growth in its customer base and revenue.

Threads Styling is a luxury personal shopping and styling service based in London, founded in 2009 by Sophie Hill. The company specializes in chat-based commerce through social media and messaging apps, catering to ultra-high-net-worth clients around the world. With a focus on sustainability, diversity, and innovation, Threads Styling has established a strong presence in the luxury fashion market.

The company offers personalized shopping experiences, sourcing rare designer items and unique experiences from major fashion capitals like London, Paris, and New York. Their services include dedicated bilingual stylists who provide tailored advice and product recommendations, as well as concierge services for gift shopping and bridal styling. Threads Styling is recognized for its innovative approach to social commerce, ensuring clients have seamless access to luxury products and services.

Threads Styling has received accolades for its growth and impact, including recognition as a Tech City UK Future Fifty company and a feature in The Sunday Times Tech Track 100. In 2022, it was acquired by Chalhoub Group, enhancing its global operations and expanding its reach into new markets.

Thredd is an issuer processing company based in London, UK, that modernizes payments for fintechs, digital banks, and embedded finance providers globally. Founded in 2007, Thredd specializes in payment processing solutions, enabling businesses to develop and launch innovative payment products. The company serves over 100 clients across 44 countries and processes billions of transactions annually.

Thredd offers a wide range of payment processing services, including card issuance and processing for debit, prepaid, and credit cards, as well as advanced fraud management and authorization controls. Their solutions encompass features like Visa Token Service, installment payments, and rewards programs. Thredd also provides specialized services for government disbursements, B2B payments, and open banking, along with developer tools for flexible integration. With a strong focus on client support and technology, Thredd maintains high platform availability and is certified by Visa and Mastercard for global transaction processing.

The company specializes in a cloud-based business management suite called Seller 365, designed for e-commerce merchants selling on platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and eBay. With a focus on enhancing profitability, Threecolts serves over 30,000 customers globally, including well-known brands such as Samsung, L'Oréal, and Puma.

The Seller 365 platform offers a range of features, including inventory management, marketing tools, order operations, customer service support, and profit recovery analytics. Threecolts has raised nearly $200 million in funding and has expanded its offerings through strategic acquisitions, enhancing its capabilities in profit recovery and e-commerce solutions.

Thriva is a UK-based health platform founded in 2016 that specializes in at-home blood testing services. The company aims to help individuals monitor and optimize their health through personalized insights and ongoing guidance. Thriva has supported over 200,000 customers, delivering more than 5 million tests. The platform focuses on empowering users to improve their health by addressing modern challenges and providing science-backed testing.

Thriva's core offering includes a personalized at-home blood testing program, where users complete a health quiz to receive tailored tests that track various biomarkers. The process features quick sample collection, detailed results reports with doctor's commentary, and ongoing testing every 3-6 months. Additionally, Thriva provides premium supplements and has launched a Wegovy program that includes blood tests. The company also offers white-label testing solutions for healthcare and enterprise partners, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and providing a seamless integration experience.

Thrive Technologies is a software company based in Marietta, Georgia, specializing in AI-driven inventory optimization and supply chain planning solutions. Founded in 2001, Thrive focuses on helping multi-location wholesale distributors, master distributors, and retailers enhance their inventory management. The company’s solutions aim to reduce lost sales, minimize dead stock, and improve inventory turns without the need for costly ERP system overhauls.

Thrive's flagship products, including Thermostock and Tiltmeter®, utilize machine learning and patent-pending technologies to analyze inventory data and forecast demand. Their cloud-based platform integrates with major ERP systems, providing real-time monitoring and automation for purchase orders and logistics. Thrive's services are designed to enhance profitability through high-accuracy demand projections and systematic improvements in fill rates and inventory efficiency. The company serves various industries, including electronics, apparel, and consumer goods, and is recognized for its innovative approach to supply chain management.

Thursday hosts a variety of weekly gatherings, including bar nights, run clubs, comedy shows, and themed parties. Most events take place on Thursdays, but they also occur on other days, providing relaxed and pressure-free environments for singles to meet. The Tide platform is a mobile-first app that combines business banking with various financial management tools. It provides digital current accounts, credit and funding options, and savings accounts with competitive interest rates. Users can access features such as invoicing, expense management, and payroll services. Tide focuses on a digital-first approach, catering exclusively to business needs, and has secured substantial funding to enhance its services.

The platform supports various industries such as finance, retail, corporate rewards, and digital marketing. It acts as an agent for sellers, facilitating negotiations, processing payments, and managing refunds. The platform features real-time interactions such as live shopping and auctions, and offers daily deals on a wide range of products, including clothing and collectibles. Users can access the marketplace through a mobile app that supports content uploads, browsing, and order tracking.

TORTUS has developed a secure, real-time AI co-pilot that integrates with major electronic health record (EHR) systems, capturing patient consultation audio through advanced speech-to-text technology.

The platform offers features such as automated note-taking, intelligent dictation, and workflow enhancements that can reduce clinical documentation time by up to 25%. It provides guidance on improving credit scores, tracks and monitors credit positions, and explains the reasons behind changes in credit status. Additionally, TotallyMoney partners with lenders to offer a variety of credit products aimed at enhancing customers' financial well-being. The company specializes in developing electronic skin and tactile sensing technology, enabling robots to achieve human-like touch capabilities. With a team of approximately 15 employees, Touchlab focuses on innovative haptics to enhance robotic functions that typically rely on vision.

The company has developed a thin, customizable layer of robotic skin sensors designed for robust touch sensation and high-definition tactile interactions. This technology allows robots to perform manipulation and sensing tasks in environments where visual feedback is limited, such as hospitals. Touchlab has raised $4 million in funding and holds three patents, contributing to advancements in robotics and consumer electronics. The company collaborates with industry partners and is involved in research and development projects, particularly in hospital robotics.

The firm offers a wide range of planning law services, including strategic advice on developments, compulsory purchase orders, public inquiries, and planning disputes. Town Legal is recognized for its expertise in high-profile projects such as urban extensions, residential and commercial developments, and infrastructure initiatives. The firm has received accolades for its talent and responsiveness, being ranked highly by Planning Magazine and The Lawyer. The company operates with an emphasis on data science, engineering, and design, and collaborates closely with Toyota Motor Europe, retailers, and distributors.

TCEU offers a range of services, including a Mobility Services Platform (MSPF) that supports ride-sharing, car-sharing, and remote delivery solutions. It also provides fleet management solutions for businesses, governments, and consumers, along with data-driven technologies aimed at enhancing safety and sustainability in mobility. The company utilizes large-scale mobility data to improve user experiences and engineers scalable platforms for connected vehicles and services. TCEU is committed to advancing Toyota's vision for connected and sustainable mobility in Europe.

Tracelight's AI engine integrates seamlessly with Excel, enabling users to generate formulas, conduct analyses, and validate data using natural language.

Founded in 2024, Tracelight has secured $3.6 million in seed funding to support its mission. Its product features include error-checking, professional formatting, and a chat interface for querying models. Tractable's AI solutions utilize customer-submitted photos and deep learning to deliver instant and accurate appraisals, significantly speeding up the assessment process. Their core offerings include vehicle damage assessments for insurance claims and property damage assessments for disaster recovery. By utilizing open banking APIs and advanced AI workflows, Trade Ledger aims to enhance capital deployment, reduce risk, and improve efficiency for banks and alternative finance providers.

Headquartered in London, TradeBridge offers multi-currency funding and revolving credit facilities tailored to the needs of its clients.

The company provides a range of financial products, including revolving credit facilities, early payment programs, and term financing specifically for Amazon sellers. Tradeteq aims to transform illiquid short-term trade finance assets into scalable, investable products, enhancing workflow automation and real-time processing.

The platform offers a range of services, including a marketplace for primary and secondary trading, securitization as a service, and AI-driven credit scoring and analytics. Tradeteq also provides automated transaction servicing and workflow management, ensuring efficient lifecycle management of trade finance assets. Additionally, it has introduced TRADA Tokens, the first regulated trade-finance-backed fungible security tokens, to improve liquidity for investors. The TypeDB database integrates various data models, including relational, graph, document, and key-value, into a single framework. TypeDB offers several editions, including a free Community Edition, TypeDB Cloud, and TypeDB Enterprise, catering to different deployment needs. The company focuses on applications in fields such as agentic AI, cybersecurity, financial services, and robotics, making it suitable for complex systems where traditional databases may not suffice.

companies.description:
UNDO is a world-leading carbon dioxide removal project developer specialising in enhanced rock weathering. 

Enhanced weathering is a nature-based technology that permanently locks away CO₂ from the atmosphere. The geological process of weathering has happened naturally for millions of years, removing billions of tonnes of CO₂ over Earth's history. UNDO accelerates this natural process by spreading crushed silicate rock with a high reactive surface area onto agricultural land, where plants and microbes in the soil speed up the weathering process. The breakdown of the rock by CO₂ dissolved in rainwater releases nutrients and bicarbonates, which end up in the oceans as solid carbonate minerals, permanently removing CO₂. 
 
Part of Microsoft and Stripe's Carbon Portfolios, UNDO is scaling operations in the UK, Australia and Canada. The rock, a by-product of the aggregate and mining industry, is given to local farmers for free and spread on agricultural land using existing infrastructure.

In addition to permanent, rapid and scalable carbon removals, UNDO's holistic partnership model delivers significant co-benefits such as improved soil health, ocean deacidification and increased profits for farming communities.

companies.description:
The University of Bath is a public research university located in Bath, England, established in 1966. It has a rich history that dates back to the Bristol Trade School founded in 1856. The university spans 200 acres and features modernist architecture. It has invested significantly in new facilities, including accommodation, academic buildings, and sports amenities. The University of Bath is recognized for its teaching excellence, holding a Gold rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework and ranking highly in various university guides.

The university offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in disciplines such as engineering, humanities, management, science, and social sciences. It emphasizes research and education, fostering a supportive and inclusive community. The campus provides various facilities, including student halls and sports venues, and is conveniently located near Bath city center and major transport links. The University of Bath is committed to sustainability and ethical practices, enhancing its role as a leader in higher education.
companies.policy: The university offers sponsorship alongside many of its roles.

companies.description:
The University of Greenwich offers a wide range of apprenticeship programs through its Employability & Apprenticeships department. These programs include Intermediate, Advanced, Higher, and Degree apprenticeships, catering to various educational levels from GCSE to Master's degrees. The initiative combines practical experience with academic education, allowing learners to pursue their career goals while providing employers with opportunities to recruit and upskill their workforce.

Support services are available for both learners and employers. Learners receive initial assessments and induction sessions to prepare for their apprenticeships. Employers benefit from tailored programs that enhance their talent pipeline and assist them in navigating the apprenticeship application process. Upon completion, learners earn qualifications and certificates, including an award from the University of Greenwich and an apprenticeship certificate from the Education and Skills Funding Agency. The university operates across three campuses in London and Kent, offering programs in sectors such as Health, Construction, Engineering, and Science.
companies.policy: The university offers sponsorship alongside many of its academic and technical roles.

companies.description:
The University of Nottingham is a public research university located in Nottingham, England. Founded in 1881 as University College Nottingham, it gained full university status in 1948. The university has its roots in 19th-century efforts to broaden access to higher education, supported by a significant donation in 1875 and the laying of its foundation stone by former Prime Minister W.E. Gladstone.

The university is organized into five main faculties and offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs across various disciplines, including sciences, engineering, humanities, social sciences, medicine, and agriculture. It emphasizes research and has multiple campuses, including the main University Park and Sutton Bonington, which focuses on agriculture. The University of Nottingham has a rich history of academic development and continues to provide quality education and research opportunities.
companies.policy: The university offers sponsorship alongside all roles that satisfy the Home Office's requirements for Skilled Worker/Tier 2 visas (including fixed-term roles) and provides financial support for visa and other associated costs.

companies.description:
The University of Oxford is the oldest university in the English-speaking world, with teaching recorded as early as 1096. It evolved from informal schools into a structured institution with self-governing colleges starting in the 13th century. Notable colleges include University College, Balliol College, and Merton College, which provide residences for students pursuing degrees in various fields such as arts, theology, law, and medicine.

Organized as a collegiate university, Oxford comprises self-governing colleges and a central administration. It offers rigorous undergraduate tutorials and advanced research opportunities across a wide range of disciplines. The university has a strong global reputation and has made significant contributions to intellectual, scientific, and religious advancements throughout its history. Oxford continues to engage with international communities and promotes scholarship through its diverse academic programs.
companies.policy: Sponsorship can be offered to all successful candidates as long as the job meets the government's requirements.

companies.description:
The University of Reading is a public research university located in Reading, Berkshire, England. Founded in 1892, it became a full university in 1926 and is recognized for its strong academic programs and research initiatives. The university operates multiple campuses, including the Whiteknights campus, which features a 24/7 library, and the Greenlands campus, home to the Henley Business School, one of Europe's largest business schools.

With over 50 internationally recognized research centers, the University of Reading excels in fields such as agriculture, biological and physical sciences, and meteorology. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and research degrees, emphasizing practical and research-driven education. The university enrolls over 20,000 students from around 150 countries, with a high percentage of graduates entering the workforce or further study shortly after completing their degrees.
companies.policy: The university offers sponsorship alongside many of its roles and offers detailed information on the routes that can be taken for each role in their job descriptions.

companies.trading_name: University of the West of England Bristol (UWE Bristol)
companies.companies_house_name: University of the West of England
companies.description:
The University of the West of England (UWE Bristol) is a public research university located in Bristol, England. With origins dating back to 1595, it gained official university status in 1992. UWE Bristol operates multiple campuses, including the main Frenchay Campus, City Campus, Glenside Campus, and Hartpury Campus, each serving different academic focuses and student needs.

UWE Bristol offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines, including engineering, health, built environment, and social sciences. The university emphasizes modern higher education and has a strong commitment to sustainability, as seen in its recent infrastructure developments. UWE Bristol's motto is "Light Liberty Learning," reflecting its dedication to education and student empowerment.
companies.policy: The university offers sponsorship alongside many of its roles.

companies.description:
Unlikely AI is a London-based deep tech company founded in 2018-2019 by William Tunstall-Pedoe. The company specializes in neurosymbolic AI, which combines machine learning with symbolic computing to create trustworthy and explainable AI systems for high-stakes industries. Its core innovation, Universal Language (UL), enables precise and auditable decision-making, addressing limitations of traditional large language models.

The company offers a neurosymbolic AI platform that delivers controllable and hallucination-free AI with over 99% accuracy on definitive yes-or-no answers. This platform is designed for scalability and is particularly suited for regulated sectors such as banking, insurance, and healthcare. Key features include a precision engine for high-accuracy tasks and solutions that enhance human capabilities while ensuring compliance and transparency. Unlikely AI has filed 16 patents in areas like artificial intelligence and natural language processing, positioning itself as a leader in delivering reliable automation in enterprise environments.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Unmade is a London-based software company founded in 2014 by Hal Watts, Kirsty Emery-Laws, and Ben Alun-Jones. The company focuses on transforming the apparel industry through technology, enabling demand-driven production. In July 2024, Unmade was acquired by Hi-Tech Apparel, a leading garment manufacturer based in Bangkok, Thailand.

The company's main product is UnmadeOS, a proprietary platform that provides digital infrastructure for apparel and sportswear brands. This platform supports on-demand customization, small batch production, and teamwear solutions. It also features an Order Management System (OMS) that integrates individual and short-run orders into existing production workflows, allowing for personalized items to be produced efficiently. UnmadeOS enhances product variety and speed to market while minimizing operational costs, inventory, and waste.

Unmade serves notable global brands in the sportswear and fashion sectors, including New Balance, Decathlon, and Ralph Lauren. The company has secured over $18 million in investment from various venture capital firms and has received multiple awards for its innovative contributions to the industry.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Unmind is a London-based workplace wellbeing platform founded in 2016. It focuses on supporting mental health through a science-backed, data-driven approach that combines AI, therapy, coaching, and insights. The platform empowers employees to measure and improve their mental wellbeing while helping organizations enhance team performance and foster a culture of openness.

Unmind offers a comprehensive cultural change platform with four core suites: Unmind Wellbeing, Unmind Learning, Unmind Insights, and Unmind Spaces. These include evidence-based tools for managing mental and physical wellbeing, training modules on leadership and emotional intelligence, real-time analytics for measuring mental health impacts, and community features for cultural engagement. The platform integrates human expertise with scalable technology to promote sustainable high performance. Unmind serves a variety of global enterprises, including Virgin Media, Uber, and Diageo, demonstrating significant productivity improvements and enhanced employee wellbeing.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Unum UK is a prominent provider of employee benefits in the UK, specializing in group insurance products that enhance workplace health, wellbeing, and financial protection for employees. The company, operating as Unum Limited, is headquartered in Dorking, Surrey, and is part of the global Unum Group, which has a rich history of over 175 years.

Founded from National Employers Liability Assurance in 1965, Unum UK has evolved significantly, incorporating various products and services over the years. Its offerings include Group Income Protection, Group Life Insurance, Group Critical Illness Cover, and dental and optical insurance. The company also launched Health Plan 360 in 2025, a modern cash plan designed to meet workforce health needs. Unum UK emphasizes innovation and integrates health and wellbeing services, such as the Help@hand app, to support employee happiness and productivity. The company serves UK businesses looking to enhance their employee benefits packages and has established partnerships with organizations like Maggie's cancer charity and Cigna.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
UpSlide is a software company that specializes in a productivity and branding add-in for Microsoft Office applications, primarily aimed at finance professionals. Founded in 2009 and launched in 2011, UpSlide serves over 850 teams across more than 60 countries, including notable financial institutions like KPMG, UniCredit, BNP Paribas, and Citi.

The company offers a suite of over 65 features that enhance Microsoft 365 applications such as PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, Word, and Outlook. Key functionalities include linking Excel content to PowerPoint and Word, a centralized content library for brand consistency, automated table of contents and formatting for presentations, advanced Excel charting, and AI-driven automation for document and reporting tasks. UpSlide prioritizes secure enterprise content management, allowing organizations to maintain control over their data while ensuring high standards of security. 

With a strong company culture that values excellence and employee satisfaction, UpSlide is committed to providing a user-friendly solution that helps financial teams create polished, brand-compliant documents efficiently.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.
The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Upwind Security is a cloud security company founded in September 2022, specializing in a runtime-powered platform that secures cloud infrastructures, applications, and deployments in real-time. The company utilizes technologies like eBPF for continuous monitoring and threat detection. Established by the team behind Spot.io, Upwind combines expertise in DevOps and cloud infrastructure optimization to tackle challenges in modern cloud and AI environments.

The core offering is a runtime security platform that provides real-time monitoring of cloud workloads, applications, and Kubernetes clusters. Key features include continuous threat detection, root-cause analysis for security issues, API security, and identity security. The platform supports multi-cloud and hybrid setups, integrating various tools for comprehensive visibility and compliance. Upwind has gained recognition as one of The Information’s 50 Most Promising Startups for 2024 and has received awards for its innovative solutions. The company serves hundreds of enterprises globally, including notable clients like Wix, Bill.com, and Booking.com.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.companies_house_name: Urban Green Space Ltd T/A Urban Green
companies.description:
Urban Green is a multidisciplinary design and environmental consultancy based in Manchester, established in 2010. The company specializes in landscape architecture, urban design, landscape planning, biodiversity net gain, and arboriculture. With a team of 40 to 74 specialists, Urban Green works on projects throughout the UK, focusing on creating positive impacts on people, places, and the environment.

The firm adopts an integrated approach, collaborating closely with clients from the initial planning stages to project delivery. Urban Green's services include innovative designs for public spaces, schools, residential developments, and infrastructure projects. Their expertise also extends to ecology and tree management, ensuring comprehensive support for environmental enhancement strategies. The team is led by experienced professionals with backgrounds in various sectors, contributing to the firm's commitment to delivering optimal solutions.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Urban Jungle (Urban Jungle Services Ltd.) is a UK-based insurance provider founded in 2016 and headquartered in London. The company specializes in renters' contents insurance, aiming to simplify the home insurance market through fairness and affordability. Urban Jungle uses behavioral data for personalized policies, moving away from traditional demographic-based risk assessments that can disadvantage lower-income groups.

The company operates a direct-to-consumer model with a streamlined application process, offering quotes starting at £5 per month, no cancellation fees, and flexible monthly plans. Urban Jungle is a Certified B Corporation, emphasizing social impact and environmental responsibility. It has served over 300,000 customers, many of whom are first-time insurance buyers, and has received high ratings as a home insurance provider. With a focus on underserved renters, Urban Jungle leverages technology to create a straightforward customer journey and promote financial protection for a new generation.

UrbanTide is a UK-based software company founded in 2014, focused on AI-driven data solutions that promote sustainability across various sectors, including transport, energy, housing, and government. The company aims to create a sustainable world by helping organizations unlock, integrate, and share siloed data, enabling the use of AI to reduce carbon emissions and improve energy efficiency.

The core offering of UrbanTide is the uSmart data insights platform, which unifies data from diverse sources and automates insights for sustainability. Their services encompass data unlocking, IT consultancy, city transformation, and community engagement, all aimed at developing scalable AI solutions. UrbanTide has a notable partnership with Love to Ride, a cycling platform, as part of its sustainability initiatives. With a team of skilled professionals, UrbanTide has been dedicated to integrating people, data, and technology to create smarter, more livable communities.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
V-Count is a global leader in visitor analytics and people counting technology, offering AI-powered solutions for physical locations. With 18 years of research in computer vision and stereo vision technology, V-Count provides privacy-assured analytics through advanced sensors and cloud-based software. The company has a team of over 80 experts and serves more than 900 businesses across 110 countries, including notable clients like Gap, Marks & Spencer, and Sephora.

V-Count's product suite features a range of innovative solutions, including the Nano indoor sensor, Nano Outdoor for outdoor counting, and BoostBI for business intelligence. Their technology boasts high accuracy in people counting and demographic analysis while ensuring GDPR compliance through on-device data processing. V-Count's offerings cater to various industries, helping businesses optimize operations, enhance customer experiences, and improve efficiency through data-driven insights.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
V7 Labs is a London-based AI training data platform and workplace automation company founded in August 2018. The company focuses on helping organizations annotate, organize, and utilize data for computer vision and business process automation. V7 Labs has raised $33 million in Series A funding and employs approximately 80-116 people.

The company offers two main products: the Darwin Platform and V7 Go. The Darwin Platform is designed for data labeling and annotation, allowing users to annotate images, videos, and volumetric series with features like automatic data labeling and model training. It supports various specialized use cases, including medical imaging and video object detection, and can significantly reduce data annotation time. V7 Go, launched in 2024, automates white-collar business tasks by creating searchable indexes of information and generating execution plans for task completion, with applications in finance, legal, and insurance sectors.
companies.policy: Sponsorship can be offered for most roles, and we have excluded any that definitely cannot be.

companies.description:
VICE Media is a global media and entertainment company founded in 1994 in Montreal, Canada. Originally starting as a punk magazine called *Voice of Montreal*, it evolved into a multi-platform corporation producing content across digital, television, film, and print. VICE News, a key part of VICE Media, focuses on current affairs and investigative journalism, delivering daily content through various channels.

VICE News creates a wide range of digital content, including articles, videos, and documentaries, available on its website and social media. It also produces television programming for networks like HBO and VICELAND, as well as documentaries that delve into global issues. The company maintains a print presence with its magazine, which covers alternative culture, politics, and lifestyle topics. VICE Media is recognized for its impactful journalism, having received numerous awards, including Peabody and Emmy Awards.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
VMware is a prominent company specializing in cloud computing and virtualization. Founded in 1998 in Palo Alto, California, VMware gained recognition with the launch of its first product, VMware Workstation, in 1999. This software enabled users to run multiple operating systems on a single computer, significantly impacting software development and testing. Over the years, VMware expanded its offerings, including server virtualization solutions like VMware ESXi and a comprehensive suite for managing virtualized environments known as VMware vSphere.

The company provides a variety of products and services, including VMware Cloud Foundation for cloud infrastructure, VMware NSX for network virtualization, and VMware Tanzu for modern application management. VMware also offers cloud services through partnerships with major cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and IBM Cloud. With a diverse customer base that includes enterprise IT, government agencies, healthcare providers, and financial institutions, VMware is widely adopted across various industries, including many Fortune 500 companies.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Valarian is a London-based technology company founded in 2020, originally as Worldr Technologies Limited in 2019. The company specializes in enhancing digital sovereignty for enterprises and governments through secure communication and data control solutions. It focuses on helping organizations maintain control over data location, encryption keys, and movement, addressing regulatory compliance and privacy needs.

Valarian offers isolation-first infrastructure via its ACRA platform, which includes its flagship product, Worldr for Microsoft Teams. This solution provides encryption key control and flexible data storage for legal compliance. The company also develops broader solutions for secure data control across clouds, AI-powered risk assessment, and jurisdictional data management. Valarian operates in two divisions: Valarian Enterprise, focusing on data security, and Valarian Defense, which provides national security infrastructure. The company has raised significant funding and serves multinational enterprises and government clients, including NATO member states and the U.S. government.
companies.policy: Sponsorship is only offered to "really highly skilled" applicants, and there have been no exceptions made to this approach historically. Lower-cost options (i.e., candidates without visa requirements) generally take priority.

companies.description:
Valkyrie Industries is a UK-based technology company founded in 2017, focusing on patented haptic wearables that combine neuromuscular electrical muscle stimulation (NMES/EMS) with extended reality (XR) and virtual reality (VR). The company aims to enhance muscle training, recovery, and performance while providing immersive experiences. Headquartered in Ingatestone, Essex, Valkyrie Industries has received funding, including a significant investment from ASICS Ventures Corporation, to support its growth and market expansion.

The company's flagship product, the eir bands, is a lightweight EMS/NMES-powered wearable designed for upper arm muscles. It delivers resistance sensations and real-time muscle stimulation in VR/XR environments. Valkyrie Industries also offers the v-health platform, which provides interactive XR therapy for muscle recovery and functional therapy. Their technology serves various sectors, including healthcare, fitness, wellness, engineering, and creative industries, emphasizing human-centered design and adaptive haptics.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Valtech is a global experience innovation company founded in 1993, headquartered in London, UK. With over 6,000 employees across 55 offices in 23 countries, Valtech specializes in technology-driven business transformation, IT services, and consulting. The company focuses on helping clients thrive in the digital era by leveraging data, AI, and technology to drive competitive advantages.

Valtech offers a wide range of services, including digital strategy and transformation, technology enablement, customer experience design, commerce acceleration, data science, and integrated sustainability practices. The company partners with leading brands across various industries, such as financial services, health, luxury, and retail, to deliver innovative solutions that enhance customer experiences and drive growth. Notable projects include the Lexus AI Concierge and the Index Shirt project for Eton Shirts, showcasing Valtech's commitment to experience innovation and business transformation.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Vanquis Banking Group plc is a specialist bank listed on the FTSE All Share index, with a history dating back to 1880. Founded in Bradford, the company aims to provide financial services to individuals underserved by traditional lenders. Today, Vanquis continues this mission through its three main brands: Vanquis, Moneybarn, and Snoop.

Vanquis offers credit cards and loans tailored for customers with diverse financial needs. Moneybarn specializes in vehicle finance, while Snoop provides free credit scores and personalized financial insights. The company serves approximately 1.69 million customers in the UK, focusing on understanding their needs to deliver suitable financial products. Vanquis is also dedicated to community support and has an environmental policy to minimize its impact. Recognized for its commitment to customer satisfaction, Vanquis has won the Moneyfacts Consumer Awards multiple times.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
The Varkey Foundation is a global not-for-profit organization established in 2010 by Sunny Varkey. It aims to improve the quality of education by enhancing the status and skills of teachers worldwide, ensuring that every child has access to a good teacher. The foundation operates across all five continents, focusing on underprivileged children and underserved communities through policy advocacy, program implementation, and partnerships.

Key initiatives include the Global Teacher Prize, which honors exceptional teachers with a $1 million award, and the Global Student Prize, recognizing innovative students. The foundation also hosts the Global Education and Skills Forum, an annual event for education policy discussions. It runs various teacher training programs, such as the Programa de Liderazgo e Innovación Educativa in Argentina, and has developed platforms like Comunidad Atenea to support teachers during challenges like COVID-19. The Varkey Foundation collaborates with organizations such as UNESCO, UNICEF, and the Clinton Global Initiative to further its mission.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Varnish Software specializes in high-performance content delivery through its flexible caching technology, primarily based on Varnish Cache, an open-source HTTP accelerator. This technology enhances scalability and speed for dynamic websites and APIs. The company originated from a project initiated in 2005 by the Norwegian newspaper VG to manage high traffic efficiently. Since its spin-off in 2010, Varnish Software has focused on commercial development while keeping Varnish Cache open-source.

The company offers several products, including Varnish Enterprise, which provides enhanced support and scalability features, and Varnish Controller, a graphical interface for managing traffic. Traffic Router allows for precise request routing control, and they also provide managed CDN services and professional support. Varnish Software serves over 10 million websites globally, powering notable brands like Nikon, Sky, Emirates, and Tesla, and is recognized for its ability to handle high-traffic demands effectively.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
VaynerMedia is a global creative and media agency founded in 2009 by Gary and AJ Vaynerchuk, based in New York City. The agency operates as a social-first digital agency, focusing on consumer-centric strategies, full-funnel media, commerce, and creative services. With around 1,600 employees across 18 offices worldwide, VaynerMedia emphasizes a culture-first approach that combines creativity with real-time data analytics and social commerce.

The agency provides end-to-end digital marketing solutions tailored to both Fortune 500 companies and emerging brands. Their services include creative content development, full-funnel media planning and buying, and consumer-led strategy. VaynerMedia integrates various services such as influencer marketing and retail media to create unified campaigns. The agency manages over $1 billion in ad spend and reported $209 million in revenue in 2023, reflecting a strong growth trajectory. VaynerMedia has been recognized with numerous awards, positioning itself as a leader in the modern marketing landscape.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
VEED.io is a London-based online video editing company founded in 2018 by Sabba Keynejad and Timur Mamedov. The platform offers an AI-powered, browser-based video editing solution that allows users of all skill levels to create professional videos without the need for downloads or complex software. VEED aims to simplify video creation for creators, businesses, and professionals, providing tools for trimming, filtering, rotating, and drawing on videos.

The company has experienced significant growth, securing $35 million in funding from Sequoia Capital by 2022. VEED serves over three million monthly users, including content creators, marketing teams, educational institutions, and businesses. Its user-friendly platform features advanced AI tools for automated subtitles, video generation, and seamless integrations with services like Dropbox. VEED emphasizes accessibility and continues to expand its offerings to meet the needs of its diverse audience.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Vegware is a leading provider of compostable foodservice packaging, based in Edinburgh, Scotland. Founded in 2006, the company operates in over 70 countries, including the U.K., EU, United States, Middle East, South America, and the Caribbean. Vegware offers a variety of plant-based products designed for commercial composting, such as cups, cutlery, tableware, and takeout packaging. Their products are recognized for quality, performance, and design.

In addition to manufacturing, Vegware provides waste management and composting programs. They partner with regional waste sectors in the U.K. and operate "Close the Loop," a composting collection service. In the United States, they offer advice on composting options through their Product and Zero Waste Specialists. Vegware has been acknowledged as Scotland's fastest growing exporter and continues to expand its reach in the sustainable packaging market.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Venari Security is a London-based cybersecurity company founded in 2020. It specializes in cryptographic security, compliance, and encrypted traffic analysis without the need for decryption. The company offers solutions that help organizations monitor and manage risks in encrypted communications, ensuring readiness for post-quantum cryptography and regulatory compliance.

Venari's platform leverages machine learning and AI to provide real-time visibility, risk scoring, and threat detection in encrypted traffic. Its key products include V-Discover, which offers insights into encrypted communications; V-Detect, which identifies threats and anomalies; and V-Comply, which assesses cryptographic risks for compliance. These tools enhance audit readiness, reduce certificate-related outages, and provide strategic insights into cryptographic management.

The company serves regulated businesses and enterprises that require advanced security for their digital assets. Venari is led by a team of cybersecurity experts and operates with a focus on delivering effective solutions to mitigate operational risks.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Veratrak is a UK-based software company founded in 2018, focusing on a blockchain-powered supply chain collaboration platform for the pharmaceutical, healthcare, and life sciences industries. Headquartered in Altrincham, the company originated from the University of Oxford Foundry ecosystem and has grown into an award-winning SaaS provider. Veratrak serves over 150-200 organizations across six continents, aiming to digitize complex supply chains and replace manual processes with auditable digital transactions.

The company's main product is the Hub, a cloud-based platform that provides secure data exchange and document collaboration. It offers features such as real-time visibility, workflow automation, and AI-enriched insights to enhance supply chain management. Veratrak emphasizes operational excellence and customer satisfaction while promoting sustainable work practices. The company has raised funding up to a Series A round and positions itself as a key integration platform for pharma manufacturers, connecting internal systems with external partners.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Vercel is a cloud-based Frontend Cloud platform founded in 2015, originally known as Zeit until its rebranding in 2020. The company focuses on enhancing the front-end developer experience by providing tools for building, previewing, deploying, scaling, and securing high-performance web applications and websites. Vercel's core offering includes the open-source React framework Next.js, which supports both static and dynamic sites, and a cloud platform for deploying front-end applications.

The platform emphasizes ease of use with single-tap deployment, global speed, and accessibility. Vercel also offers AI-powered tools, such as v0, which generates unique user interfaces. The company serves a diverse range of clients, from individual developers to large enterprises like Walmart and Netflix, and has experienced significant growth, reaching a $200 million annual recurring revenue target by 2025. Vercel is backed by notable investors, including Accel and BlackRock, and aims to provide a comprehensive web development solution from idea to production.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Verdant Specialty Solutions is a global specialty chemicals company based in Houston, Texas. Founded in 2021, it has roots dating back to the 1970s as McIntyre Group. The company specializes in surfactants and specialty chemicals for various sectors, including personal care, home care, hygiene, industrial cleaning, and energy. Verdant was acquired by Samyang Holdings in December 2023.

The company employs around 300 people and serves over 1,000 customers worldwide, generating annual revenue of about USD 210 million. Verdant operates production sites in the US, UK, and Germany, along with labs and distribution networks globally. Its product portfolio includes a range of surfactants and specialty chemicals, such as amphoteric and cationic surfactants, emulsifiers, and anti-foaming agents. Verdant focuses on providing sustainable and high-performance solutions that enhance product quality and environmental impact, catering to both consumer brands and industrial processes.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Veremark is a global background screening and reference checking platform based in London, UK. Founded in 2018, it automates employment verification and candidate screening for businesses in various industries, from fast-growing startups to large enterprises. The company aims to help organizations trust faster by facilitating secure, verified, and reusable data in the workplace.

Veremark offers a wide range of background screening services, including employment history verification, academic credential checks, criminal record checks, and identity verification, among others. Their innovative product, Verepass, is a blockchain-based "career passport" that allows candidates to retain and reuse verified check results for future job opportunities. The platform is fully compliant with GDPR and PDPA regulations, ensuring speed, accuracy, and regulatory adherence while enhancing the candidate experience. Veremark serves multiple sectors, including fintech, technology, HR, and professional services, and provides tailored solutions for both growth and enterprise-level organizations.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Verisian Ltd is a UK-based startup founded in 2023 that specializes in software solutions for the pharmaceutical industry. The company focuses on accelerating clinical trial analysis, validation, submission, and review processes. By utilizing graph-based technology and adhering to CDISC standards, Verisian aims to reduce the time it takes for drugs to reach the market through real-time monitoring and transparent study evaluations.

The company's core platform, "Validated by Verisian," enhances clinical trial validation by providing full study traceability and enabling faster, more efficient submissions. Additionally, Verisian offers AI tools, known as "Verisian AI Co-pilots," which assist with tasks such as writing code and generating submission documentation. The company is also developing a "builder" tool to help pharmaceutical companies prepare studies for submission. Verisian's solutions are designed to address the complexities of managing trial data, improving clarity and reliability in clinical programming.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Verkada is a San Mateo, California-based company founded in 2016 that specializes in cloud-based physical security platforms for enterprises. The company integrates hardware, such as cameras and sensors, with AI-powered software to enhance security for people and places. Verkada's software-first approach modernizes building security, providing real-time insights and control to help organizations minimize risks and improve efficiency.

The company offers six integrated product lines through a unified cloud platform, including video security cameras, access control systems, environmental sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management tools. This ecosystem allows for complete visibility over physical spaces, replacing traditional on-premises servers with cloud intelligence. Verkada serves over 20,000 enterprise organizations across 63 countries, including many Fortune 500 companies, and has established a strong presence with over 6,000 resellers.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:
Version 1 is a global business transformation company that specializes in technology consulting and digital services. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, the company has nearly three decades of experience partnering with clients across various industries. Version 1 has a strong presence in multiple locations, including Belfast, Cork, Manchester, Edinburgh, Kent, and Birmingham.

The company offers a wide range of services, including cloud computing, data and AI solutions, application modernization, software asset management, and custom software development. Version 1 also provides international management consulting, managed services, service delivery management, predictive analytics, and digital services. They collaborate with major technology partners like Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, Red Hat, OutSystems, and Snowflake to deliver effective solutions. With a focus on customer satisfaction and a strong retention rate, Version 1 serves large public sector organizations and prominent global private brands. The company emphasizes a balanced approach to its operations, fostering a culture of merit-based recognition and career development for its over 1,300 employees.
companies.policy: The company is a licensed sponsor.

companies.description:

The company operates in over 100 cities across 12 countries, managing a fleet of approximately 110,000 vehicles and facilitating over 100 million rides.

Voi's services are accessed through a mobile app, offering flexible pricing options such as pay-as-you-go, day passes, and monthly subscriptions. With a workforce of approximately 230-260 employees, Volt.io operates in multiple locations, including Krakow and Amsterdam.

The company offers a single integration gateway for real-time A2A payments, allowing merchants to send and receive funds instantly without intermediaries. Key services include "Pay by Bank" for e-commerce, real-time payment orchestration through an API, and a global network infrastructure that connects various payment schemes. Their flagship product, the Calibur3®, is designed for creating larger parts from a variety of materials with enhanced efficiency and accuracy. It provides hands-free audio instructions, customizable routing options, and supports multiple languages. Headquartered in London, Wayve focuses on developing self-driving vehicle systems using end-to-end deep learning and Embodied AI. The company has raised over $1.3 billion in funding from notable investors, including SoftBank, Microsoft, and Nvidia.

Wayve's innovative approach, known as AV2.0, utilizes a vision-based system that relies on a single neural network to process raw sensor data, eliminating the need for detailed maps and complex sensor setups. Their technology includes a range of products such as generative AI models for creating realistic driving scenarios, a photorealistic simulator for training, and tools for analyzing AI behavior.
